items.title: 硅谷风投开始囤GPU：a16z两万张卡还要扩，抢AI创业公司不只靠出钱
items.content:
硅谷风投开始囤GPU：a16z两万张卡还要扩，抢AI创业公司不只靠出钱

动察 Beating AI 快讯，硅谷多家风投正在争相锁定 GPU 算力，为旗下 AI 创业公司提供专属资源。a16z 早在 2024 年就建立了规模约 2 万张 GPU 的算力池，如今正与数据中心企业 Switch、Volta 洽谈进一步扩容。另一家风投 General Catalyst 则计划建设面向被投公司的数据中心，今年 5 月还专门挖来英伟达 DGX Cloud 前负责人，统筹 AI 基础设施业务。

风投为什么开始亲自解决算力问题？因为 AI 创业公司即使融到钱，也未必能及时租到 GPU。今年 4 月，微软等大型云厂商被曝优先将算力留给内部团队和大客户，部分创业公司面临数月等待期。a16z 此前还披露，算力紧缺时，创业公司想拿到原本签半年合同就能享受的价格，可能被要求签约三年。但模型训练需要短期集中使用大量 GPU，产品上线后的推理需求又难以预测，提前锁定多年算力，很容易造成资金浪费。

a16z 的做法，是通过名为 Oxygen 的项目集中采购和租赁算力，再分配给旗下创业公司，让它们享受大客户才有的价格与合同条件。如今，这套模式还在向上游延伸。今年 8 月，a16z 联合领投了 Volta 的 3 亿美元融资，后者估值达到 24 亿美元。它既投资 AI 创业公司，也投资提供算力的数据中心企业，试图同时掌握资金和 GPU 供应渠道。

此外，算力本身也开始成为风投的一门生意。小型风投 Crucible Capital 建立了一座拥有 576 张英伟达 B300 GPU 的集群，供旗下创业公司测试产品，同时将部分算力卖给一家前沿 AI 实验室。这样既能保障被投公司的需求，也能将闲置算力变成收入。对于风投来说，提供 GPU 还能吸引需要大量算力的创始人，增加拿下热门投资项目的机会。

不过，这种模式也让风投承担了过去主要由云厂商和数据中心运营商承担的风险。GPU 更新换代快，长期租赁或建设数据中心需要提前投入资金，一旦创业公司需求不及预期，闲置算力未必能按预想的价格转租。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371575
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: Feature-style analysis of a genuine but slow-moving industry trend: venture firms (a16z, General Catalyst, Crucible Capital) building or buying GPU capacity to serve portfolio AI startups. Most specifics cited are background (a16z's ~20k-GPU pool from 2024, Microsoft prioritizing internal capacity in April, a16z co-leading Volta's $300M round in August), and the piece itself reports no discrete new announcement inside the news window — a16z's talks with Switch and Volta for expansion are described as ongoing. Interesting structural shift in AI compute financing with real implications for how startups get access to GPUs, but not urgent or market-moving.
items.ai_summary: Silicon Valley VCs including a16z, General Catalyst and Crucible Capital are assembling their own GPU pools and data-center capacity to guarantee compute for portfolio AI startups and to win deals, pushing venture firms into risks traditionally carried by cloud providers and data-center operators.

items.title: MediaMarktSaturn pulls Ledger products amid tampering reports
items.content:
MediaMarktSaturn pulls Ledger products amid tampering reports
European retailer MediaMarkt pulled Ledger products as the wallet maker probes tampering reports beyond CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia.
MediaMarktSaturn, the parent company of European electronics retailer MediaMarkt, has removed Ledger products from its stores and online platforms amid reports of tampered hardware wallets.
“The MediaMarktSaturn Retail Group has removed all of the manufacturer’s products from its stores and online platforms and is in contact with the manufacturer,” a spokesperson told Cointelegraph in an email on Tuesday. “We take this incident very seriously.”
An X user known as Johannes claimed Monday that he purchased two Ledger wallets from separate MediaMarkt stores. He said both contained unauthorized cables and cellular modules.
The security concerns emerged Friday after Ledger said it is investigating reports of losses involving devices sold through Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis. Ledger said Tuesday that implants transmitted users’ recovery phrases over cellular networks and that it was investigating reports beyond CryptoBilis.
Separately, former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès said Tuesday that a Ledger Flex purchased at Singapore’s airport contained a spy implant. Ledger responded by referring users to its latest CryptoBilis investigation update, without directly addressing the Singapore case.
Cointelegraph contacted Ledger to ask whether it had confirmed any tampered devices in Europe but received no response by publication time.
Felix Ng contributed reporting.
Related: Ledger implant tests Bitcoin ETFs as safer custodial solutions than hardware wallets
items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.ai_reason: Hardware-wallet supply-chain tampering is a direct threat to self-custody users, and the in-window development — MediaMarktSaturn pulling all Ledger products from stores and online across Europe — escalates a probe previously confined to a Southeast Asian reseller (CryptoBilis) into a European retail distribution problem. It is not yet a quantified, confirmed loss event (>$50M scale), which keeps it below the 8.5-9.0 exploit tier, but the unconfirmed cellular modules/cables in consumer-purchased devices and a major retailer's withdrawal make it high-value and immediately actionable for Ledger owners.
items.ai_summary: MediaMarktSaturn has removed all Ledger hardware wallets from its stores and online platforms after a buyer reported tampered devices containing unauthorized cables and cellular modules, widening Ledger's investigation beyond Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis.

AMC CEO再发文质问Robinhood，要求澄清泽西岛离岸业务是否遵循SEC股票代币化原则

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，AMC 院线 CEO Adam Aron 在 X 平台再次公开致信 Robinhood 联合创始人 Vlad Tenev 及高管 Dan Gallagher，指出 Robinhood 已表态支持 SEC 针对美国股票代币化制定的新规，但要求对方明确说明其国际业务是否会遵循同样原则。Aron 特别点名 Robinhood 在泽西岛的离岸运营，质问若该业务不遵守相关原则，是否将构成对 SEC 所要求正确做法的曲解与嘲弄。

Aron 连发「shame, shame, shame」，表达对 Robinhood 至今未正面回应相关问题的强烈不满。其强调，若仅在美国境内支持监管框架，却在海外以不同标准运作，将彻底违背 SEC 所倡导的合规方向。

OpenAI关停Sora又与前负责人谈合作，或用技术换股权

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 正与 Sora 前负责人 Bill Peebles 创办的公司谈判，考虑让其深度改造已经停运的 Sora 模型，开发面向电影制作人的软件和服务。如果合作达成，OpenAI 将获得新公司股权。不过，双方尚未敲定协议，也不确定是否会开放模型权重。

这笔潜在交易背后，是 OpenAI 曾经高调押注、最终难以承受的成本。今年 3 月，Sora 全球用户数从上线后的峰值约 100 万，持续跌至不足 50 万，每天亏损约 100 万美元。面对高昂的算力开销，OpenAI 决定将资源转向 ChatGPT、编程和企业业务，于是宣布放弃 Sora，4 月 26 日关闭 App 和网页版，9 月 24 日终止 API 服务。就连迪士尼原计划投资 10 亿美元、授权 200 多个角色的合作，也在资金尚未交割时告吹。

如今，曾经负责 Sora 的人可能重新接手这套技术。Peebles 是 Diffusion Transformer（DiT）论文第一作者，4 月从 OpenAI 离职时曾表示，探索性研究需要有脱离公司核心产品路线的空间。他与梦工厂联合创始人 Jeffrey Katzenberg、Dropbox 前 CFO Sujay Jaswa 一起创业。9 月，这家公司还计划从头训练视频模型，并与 a16z 等投资机构洽谈融资。一个月后，又开始寻求直接利用 Sora。如果谈成，就有机会节省部分从零训练模型的投入。

Katzenberg 曾创办短视频平台 Quibi，融资 17.5 亿美元，却因付费用户不足，上线仅半年便宣布关闭。如今，他再次押注视频，目标从争夺普通观众转向服务专业电影制作人。对于 OpenAI，这意味着有机会将搁置的研发成果转化为股权收益；对于新公司，则可以结合现成的模型技术与好莱坞资源，寻找付费能力更强的专业客户。

items.title: Bitcoin hits $84K resistance as Korean tech rout deepens KOSPI losses
items.content:
Bitcoin hits $84K resistance as Korean tech rout deepens KOSPI losses
Bitcoin’s liquidity kept BTC price below $84,000 amid a mounting South Korean tech and semiconductor stock sell-off.
Bitcoin (BTC) rebounded toward $84,000 on Tuesday as crypto markets skirted fresh losses for South Korean stock markets.
Key points:
- Bitcoin diverged from plummeting Asian tech stocks on Tuesday, rebounding from a low near $81,000.
- Semiconductors led an exodus from South Korea’s KOSPI amid ongoing investors’ nerves over AI and Chinese competition.
- BTC price upside was capped at $84,000 by a wall of resistance on exchange order books.
South Korea’s KOSPI loses 200-day trend line as panic returns
Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD up more than 2.5% on Tuesday, reaching $83,944 on Bitstamp to retrace Monday’s drop.
BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
The gains came as a fresh tech sell-off gathered pace on South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index, which extended its losses for the week to 7.4%. The index fell below its 200-day moving average for the first time since late July.
KOSPI Composite Index one-day chart with 200-day moving average. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Semiconductor stocks came under particular pressure, with SK Hynix closing more than 10% lower, while the rout compounded existing problems for Samsung after it reported lower-than-expected Q3 earnings last week. Foreign investors sold around 173 trillion won ($129 billion) worth of SK Hynix and Samsung shares since the start of 2026, accounting for the vast majority of year-to-date KOSPI sales.
The weakness echoes August’s sell-off, when concerns over the AI boom and associated corporate debt obligations sparked sharp losses that soon spread to global markets.
“Investors are jittery and looking for excuses to take profit on AI-related stocks that have outperformed this year, especially memory stocks,” UBP senior equity advisor Vey-Sern Ling told CNBC on Monday.
Ling was among those who flagged competition from China as increasingly problematic for Korean investors, while acknowledging that the Chinese sector still faced “technology hurdles.”
Bitcoin price rebounds despite waning ETF demand
In contrast to the August sell-off, Bitcoin avoided a copycat move and moved toward the upper end of its local trading range between $80,000 and $87,000.
Related: South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
At the time, analysis attributed Bitcoin’s relative strength to potential monetary policy easing by central banks. Major US inflation data is due out this week ahead of the Federal Reserve’s Oct. 28 rate decision, with markets expecting rates to stay at their current levels of 2.75-4%.
Bitcoin’s relative strength also comes despite declining investor appetite for BTC exposure in October, with outflows from the US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) recording $451 million in net outflows so far this month, including $69 million on Monday.
US spot Bitcoin ETF netflows (screenshot). Source: Farside Investors
Traders noted bulls’ had struggled to hold above $84,000 on lower time frames. CoinGlass data showed a thickening band of ask liquidity on exchange order books near that level.
BTC liquidation heatmap. Source: CoinGlass

items.title: Ledger says 'spy' chip inside CryptoBilis Ledger devices transmitted wallet keys over mobile network
items.content:
Ledger says 'spy' chip inside CryptoBilis Ledger devices transmitted wallet keys over mobile network
The hardware-wallet maker gave its first public account of how a covert component in devices sold by CryptoBilis could steal users’ master keys without changing Ledger’s software.
- Ledger said a covert implant in some hardware wallets sold by CryptoBilis captured users’ recovery phrases from device screens and transmitted them to attackers over an LTE mobile network.
- Ledger described the thefts as a physical supply-chain attack that did not compromise its software, internal systems, secure element or transaction-signing process.
- Onchain researchers estimated that more than 300 wallets lost up to $93.2 million.
Covert hardware implanted in some Ledger crypto wallet devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis read users’ 24-word recovery phrases from the gadget screen and sent them to an attacker over a mobile phone network, Ledger said Tuesday in an investigation update on X.
Ledger said the spy chip sat inside the device enclosure. When a user set up the signer and the screen displayed the recovery phrase, the implant’s microcontroller recognized and decoded the words, then transmitted them over LTE, a data transmission technology used by cellphones, utilizing an eSIM.
The recovery phrase is the master key to a crypto wallet. Anyone who has it can recreate the wallet elsewhere and move the funds without needing the physical Ledger device or changing any transactions on it.
The account is the first public explanation of the mechanism behind the CryptoBilis-linked thefts. Ledger said the implant did not modify the device’s secure Element, the chip designed to protect private keys, or its operating system. It also did not alter transactions or signatures. The incident was a physical supply chain attack rather than a breach of Ledger’s software or internal systems.
Ledger said it had confirmed one affected signer contained an unauthorized implant and that every confirmed loss in the Oct. 9 incident involved a device sold by CryptBilis. It said it had not verified a theft involving a signer purchased elsewhere and was examining reports of implants in other devices and locations.
The French company has not confirmed the total number of victims or the value stolen. Onchain researchers, however, estimated the losses were up to $93.2 million across more than 300 wallets, with Tether freezing $10 million of its dollar-pegged stablecoin USDT tied to the theft.
CryptoBilis has stopped selling Ledger signers, according to Ledger. The company told customers who bought one from the reseller not to initialize it. Customers who have already used one should move assets to a new device with a newly generated recovery phrase, it said.

items.title: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
items.content:
UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
The decision concerns 61,000 BTC seized by the Metropolitan Police in its investigation into Zhimin Qian, who pleaded guilty to defrauding thousands of people in China.
- A London court ruled that Chinese law governs fraud victims’ claims to 61,000 bitcoin, worth about £3.8 billion, because the underlying scheme and losses occurred in China.
- Zhimin Qian pleaded guilty to defrauding more than 128,000 investors through a Ponzi scheme before converting the proceeds into bitcoin and fleeing to Britain in 2017.
- The ruling does not determine ownership of the seized bitcoin, but it narrows victims’ path to recovery and increases the likelihood that the British government will retain most of it; the victims’ lawyers are appealing.
A London court has strengthened the U.K. government’s chances of keeping most of 3.8 billion pounds ($5 billion) in seized bitcoin 
The decision concerns 61,000 BTC seized by London’s Metropolitan Police in its investigation into Zhimin Qian, who pleaded guilty to defrauding thousands of people in China.
Qian ran a massive Ponzi scheme through her company, Tianjin Lantian Gerui Electronic Technology, defrauding over 128,000 investors between 2014 and 2017. She converted the stolen billions into bitcoin and fled to the U.K. in 2017.
The victims had argued that English law should apply, as it could have allowed them to claim property rights over the multi-billion-pound crypto fortune. However, in a judgment on Monday, Mr Justice Mark Turner of the London High Court sided with U.K. authorities, ruling that because the underlying fraud occurred entirely in China, Chinese law, and not English law, must govern the victims' property claims.
“The relevant damage occurred in China. The applicants parted with their money in China. The alleged fraudulent representations were made in China,” the judge said. “The contractual relationships thereby induced were entered into in China. The immediate economic consequences of the alleged wrongdoing were likewise suffered in China.”
Note that the ruling does not finally decide who keeps the bitcoin. But it narrows the victims’ route to recovering it and improves the chances of the U.K. Treasury eventually retaining the seized bitcoin.
The victims’ lawyers are appealing, according to the FT. The Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) says a further hearing will determine whether any victims can establish an interest in the bitcoin.
Across the Atlantic, seized bitcoin have already been institutionalized as part of the national balance sheet. The U.S. established a strategic bitcoin reserve in March 2025, which includes BTC and other coins seized in enforcement actions. No single token has been acquired with taxpayer money. Addresses linked to the U.S. government hold $25.8 billion worth of cryptocurrencies, according to Arkham Intelligence.

items.title: NFT Marketplace Blur to Shut Down Website, Stop New Blend Loans Next Month
items.content:
In brief
- Blur will deprecate the frontend of its NFT marketplace at blur.io on November 12, though the marketplace protocol will remain operational on-chain.
- Its NFT lending platform Blend will stop matching new loans the same day, and borrowers must repay or let their loans default before then.
- Statista projects global NFT market revenue of $318.3 million in 2026, well below its 2021 and 2022 peaks.
Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur will shut down its website on November 12, the company said.
The deprecation applies only to the blur.io frontend. The Blur marketplace protocol will remain operational on-chain, and holders of the BLUR token will continue to control its fee switch, the team said.
1/ The https://t.co/zPQ1jqR7pT frontend will be deprecated on November 12, 2026.
This deprecation only applies to the frontend.
The Blur marketplace protocol will remain operational on-chain, and $BLUR will continue to control its fee switch.
— Blur (@blur_io) October 12, 2026
Blend, Blur's peer-to-peer NFT lending platform, will stop matching new loans on the same date. Borrowers have until then to repay their loans or allow them to default, and Blur said it will provide a tool afterward to help users withdraw their assets from Blend.
Blur and the NFT market
Blur launched in 2022 with a token airdrop to traders, and quickly overtook OpenSea in trading volume. Critics later questioned whether its incentives helped crash NFT prices.
The NFT market has since shrunk sharply. Global NFT market revenue is projected at $318.3 million in 2026, essentially flat on last year, according to Statista, well below its peaks in 2021 and 2022.
Monthly NFT sales volume fell to $167.2 million in September, down from $554.8 million a year earlier and $1.78 billion in December 2023, according to data from CryptoSlam. That is a fraction of the multibillion-dollar months recorded at the market's peak in 2021 and 2022.
Cheaper NFTs have driven up sales counts even as trading volume has plummeted, according to DappRadar.
The move comes after Blast, the Ethereum layer-2 network launched in November 2023 by the team behind Blur, said earlier this month that it is shutting down because it costs more to run than it earns. Blast drew more than $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 mainnet launch, and has given users until October 26 to withdraw through its interface.
items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.ai_reason: Blur was one of the largest NFT trading venues, so deprecating its frontend and halting new Blend loan originations marks a material contraction of NFT market infrastructure and DeFi NFT lending. It is a concrete, dated protocol wind-down with user-facing consequences (borrowers must repay or default), which lifts it above routine product updates, but the NFT sector is far smaller than in 2021-22 and the underlying marketplace protocol stays on-chain, so systemic impact is limited. Not a 7.5+ because it is a sunset rather than a shock exploit, insolvency, or market-structure change affecting broader access.
items.ai_summary: Blur announced it will deprecate the blur.io frontend and stop matching new Blend loans on November 12, 2026, while the on-chain marketplace protocol and BLUR fee switch remain operational.

items.title: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
items.content:
Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 seized Bitcoin face a legal setback after a UK court ruled that Chinese law governs their claims.
Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 Bitcoin seized by the British government have lost a key legal battle after London’s High Court ruled that Chinese law, rather than English law, should govern claims to the assets.
On Monday, Justice Mark Turner rejected arguments for applying English law or a combination of English and Chinese law to the victims’ ownership claims. The judge ruled that Chinese law must determine whether the claimants have property rights in the seized Bitcoin, leaving the validity of claims for subsequent proceedings.
“The relevant damage occurred in China. The Applicants parted with their money in China,” Turner wrote. “The contractual relationships thereby induced were entered into in China.”
The dispute stems from an investment fraud scheme orchestrated by Zhimin Qian between 2014 and 2017, with British authorities seizing the assets during a money-laundering investigation. In March, victims challenged a proposed compensation arrangement involving a Chinese redress scheme, arguing that it could leave British authorities with much of the gains from Bitcoin’s appreciation.
The victims had sought to apply English law because it could have allowed them to claim direct ownership of the Bitcoin, rather than merely seek compensation as creditors. However, the UK ruling does not determine who ultimately owns the seized assets, with the victims’ property rights under Chinese law still to be assessed.
Fraud victims plan to appeal Bitcoin ruling
According to a Financial Times report, Law firm Fieldfisher, which represents claimants in the dispute, is pursuing an appeal against Turner’s ruling.
Despite the ruling, the case will remain before the High Court in London rather than being transferred to a Chinese court. FT reported that the next stage will involve expert evidence on Chinese law to determine whether the victims can establish ownership interests in the Bitcoin.
The Crown Prosecution Service told the FT that a further hearing would examine how Chinese law applies and whether any victims can establish an interest in the seized assets.
Related: UK sanctions three crypto exchanges tied to Russian illicit funds
The dispute involves more than 128,000 investors reportedly affected by the fraud, according to earlier Cointelegraph coverage. In March, Cointelegraph reported that law firm Candey represented about 5,700 victims.
Prosecutors previously argued that certain claims could allow a smaller group of victims and litigation funders to recover more than their actual losses.
The seized Bitcoin is currently worth more than $5 billion, according to CoinGecko.
Magazine: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months

items.ai_reason: A London High Court ruling that Chinese law, not English law, governs claims to 61,000 seized Bitcoin is a concrete in-window legal development with material implications for one of the largest crypto asset-recovery cases (the 61,000 BTC is worth billions). It does not resolve ownership or change market access, so it falls short of the 8+ tier, but it is a meaningful jurisdictional precedent for cross-border crypto claims and victim recovery.
items.ai_summary: London's High Court ruled that Chinese law, not English law, must govern claims by Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 Bitcoin seized by the UK government, leaving the merits of their ownership claims to later proceedings.

items.content:
Character.AI申请破产：创始人回归谷歌、CEO转投迪士尼，平台面临关停

动察 Beating AI 快讯，曾经风靡一时的 AI 角色聊天平台 Character.AI，如今走到了破产出售的地步。10 月 12 日，公司在美国申请 Chapter 11 破产保护，迪士尼提出 2000 万美元的初始报价。但迪士尼要买的只是部分知识产权的永久非独家授权等权益，并未承诺接手整个平台。

Character.AI 曾是最受欢迎的消费级 AI 应用之一。它由 Transformer 论文作者 Noam Shazeer 和另一位前谷歌研究员 Daniel De Freitas 创办，用户可以和虚构人物聊天，也能创建自己的 AI 角色。2023 年，App 上线不到一周便获得约 170 万次安装，公司完成 1.5 亿美元融资，估值达到 10 亿美元。到 2024 年，平台已有超过 2000 万月活用户、1 亿个用户创建的角色。

转折发生在 2024 年。谷歌支付 27 亿美元，获得 Character.AI 大模型技术的非独家授权，并招走两位创始人和约 20% 的员工。Character.AI 随后用部分交易资金回购投资者股份，让投资者套现退出，公司则转为员工持股。员工还获得了一次性付款，但剩余资金当时预计只够支撑约 18 个月。失去核心研发团队后，Character.AI 放弃与科技巨头竞争前沿大模型，转而专注聊天产品。

此后，围绕未成年人安全的诉讼接连出现。有家长指控，聊天机器人对孩子造成严重心理伤害，甚至与自杀事件有关。Character.AI 从 2025 年 11 月起逐步取消未成年人的开放式聊天功能。迪士尼也曾在 2025 年发出律师函，要求下架未经授权的艾莎、达斯·维达等角色。对于一家依赖年轻用户和角色扮演的平台，这些问题持续增加经营压力。

更令人唏嘘的是，今年 10 月 2 日，Character.AI 前 CEO Karandeep Anand 刚刚加入迪士尼，担任首席技术官，部分技术员工也随之转投迪士尼。如今迪士尼又成了破产资产的初始竞买方，还将通过这些离职员工，帮助 Character.AI 在出售期间短暂维持运营。

目前平台尚未关闭，公司预计在 11 月底至 12 月初完成出售。如果找不到愿意继续运营平台的买家，Character.AI 就将停止服务。已有用户开始询问，如何保存自己与 AI 角色持续了好几年的聊天记录。

items.title: Ledger details LTE-enabled spy implants in wallets sold by CryptoBilis
items.content:
Ledger details LTE-enabled spy implants in wallets sold by CryptoBilis
Ledger detailed how LTE-enabled implants exposed wallet recovery phrases as CryptoBilis halted sales and Trezor and OneKey cut ties with the reseller.
Malicious implants in Ledger wallets sold by CryptoBilis captured users’ recovery phrases from device screens and transmitted them over cellular networks, the French hardware wallet maker said.
Ledger Donjon, the company’s security research team, found that the implants used a microcontroller to decode the 24-word phrases displayed during setup and transmitted the data over LTE networks using an embedded SIM (eSIM), according to a Tuesday X post by Ledger.
The implants did not compromise the devices’ security chips or alter transactions, Ledger said.
The incident surfaced Friday after crypto losses were reported involving Ledger devices sold through CryptoBilis, a reseller listed as authorized in Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.
Ledger confirmed Saturday that one affected device contained an unauthorized implant. Blockchain investigator Specter said losses could exceed $86 million, while cybersecurity outlet Yfarmx raised its own estimate to $103 million. Ledger hasn’t confirmed the total.
Ledger says it has sold more than 8 million hardware wallets, devices that keep users’ private keys offline and let them approve transactions on-device.
Ledger probes implants beyond CryptoBilis
Ledger urged users who suspect tampering to contact its support team and file a police report.
Ledger directed concerned customers who bought devices elsewhere to an inspection guide, which warns that opening a device could damage it and advises users to back up their recovery phrases first.
Although confirmed losses have so far involved devices sold by CryptoBilis, Ledger said it is examining reports beyond the reseller.
Separately, X user Johannes posted photos of two Ledger devices he said he bought from separate stores of MediaMarkt, a European consumer electronics chain. He said he found implants in both devices. Ledger has not confirmed whether the European reports are linked to the CryptoBilis incident.
CryptoBilis halts all wallet sales as Trezor, OneKey cut ties
CryptoBilis said in an X post on Saturday that it had suspended sales and shipments of all hardware wallet brands across Malaysia, the Philippines and Indonesia, expanding an earlier halt limited to Ledger devices.
The reseller also temporarily closed its physical stores and said it was reviewing its processes with independent specialists.
Related: Ledger implant tests Bitcoin ETFs as safer custodial solutions than hardware wallets
Trezor said Monday that it had received no reports of tampered Trezor devices sold through CryptoBilis and found no indication that its products were affected. It nevertheless removed CryptoBilis from its authorized reseller network.
OneKey reported no related user losses as well, but terminated CryptoBilis’ reseller authorization. It also suspended onboarding new resellers and began reviewing its existing distribution network. The company offered free replacements for OneKey devices purchased from CryptoBilis between March 1 and Oct. 12, 2026, with customers able to apply through Dec. 31.
Magazine: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months
items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.ai_reason: A genuine in-window development (Ledger's Tuesday disclosure detailing the implant mechanics) describing an active supply-chain attack: malicious LTE/eSIM-enabled implants inside Ledger wallets sold by authorized reseller CryptoBilis captured 24-word recovery phrases from setup screens and transmitted them via cellular networks, with losses already reported. It is a high-signal hardware-wallet security breach affecting user funds and prompting CryptoBilis to halt sales and Trezor/OneKey to sever ties. It falls short of the 8.5-9.0 tier because the compromise is confined to one reseller's devices rather than Ledger's firmware, security chips, or a platform-wide flaw, and confirmed losses are not documented at the >$50M systemic scale.

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，据彭博社报道，摩根大通与高盛在为人工智能云初创公司 Volta Infrastructure Holdings 牵头约 50 亿美元贷款销售时采取了少见的风险控制安排：两家银行仅承销其中 13 亿美元定期贷款，另约 37 亿美元芯片相关贷款未予承销，以降低自身敞口。知情人士称，此举意在防范投资者对 AI 高风险债务要求更高回报、以及贷款滞销时银行被迫持仓的风险。

该笔债务定价收益率约 11%，属于杠杆贷款市场中为 AI 融资所见较高的水平之一，且交易未获评级，这通常会让作为此类债务最大买家的担保贷款凭证（CLO）难以参与。银行通常会承销整包债务以向借款人保证资金到位，但在经历 2022 年利率急升导致滞销贷款亏损后，对未经验证的 AI 融资结构更趋谨慎。贷款认购承诺截止日为 10 月 14 日；摩根大通此前已于 8 月开始向投资者试探意向。

Gemini 4 Argon藏进Antigravity新版，三档推理已就位却仍不能用

动察 Beating AI 快讯，谷歌 AI 编程工具 Antigravity 的 2.23.0 更新中，出现了 Gemini 4 Argon 的完整模型标识，包括 Low、Medium、High 三档推理配置。

上一版 2.22.0 没有这些内容，新版则新增了 4 个模型 ID 和 3 个模型选择菜单名称。不过，这些配置目前仍隐藏在程序代码中，普通用户还无法直接选择 Gemini 4 Argon。

Antigravity 同时撤下了多款旧模型。Gemini 3.1 Pro、3.6 Flash 和 3.7 Flash 在 10 月 12 日被标记为即将下线，次日已有用户发现，模型列表中的 Gemini 只剩 3.8 Flash。另一名开发者还发现，Argon 三档已排在客户端推荐模型顺序的前三位，但请求对应接口仍返回 404。

谷歌早在 9 月 30 日便已发布 Argon，但目前主要向经过筛选的网络安全合作伙伴开放，后续才计划覆盖付费 API 和 Google AI Ultra 用户。

items.title: Anthropic警告AI蠕虫逼近：15台廉价电视盒已能运行260亿参数模型
items.content:
Anthropic警告AI蠕虫逼近：15台廉价电视盒已能运行260亿参数模型

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 发布研究，警告 AI 未来可能像计算机蠕虫一样，自行寻找联网设备、部署模型，再利用新设备继续传播。整个过程不一定需要数据中心，智能电视盒、冰箱等普通联网设备，也可能成为 AI 的算力来源。

研究人员买来 15 台安卓电视盒，每台售价约 55 美元，将 260 亿参数的 Gemma 4 模型拆分到这些设备上运行。虽然成功启动，但推理速度只有每秒 0.39 Token。另一项测试中，阿里 Qwen3.5-9B 已能在 9 类不同硬件中的 8 类上，自主搭建模型推理服务。

智谱 GLM-5.2 则在更复杂的测试中表现突出。它在隔离的模拟网络里，完成了寻找目标、传送模型、启动推理和继续传播的流程。5 次测试中，4 次覆盖全部 8 个目标节点，另一次覆盖 7 个。不过，实验提前开放了无需验证的调试接口，大幅降低了入侵难度。GLM-5.2 本身也依赖外部服务器运行，部署到目标设备的是更小的 Llama 3.1 8B，并未实现真正脱离外部算力的自我复制。

研究人员还发现，AI 可以利用前一次部署失败的经验，提高下一轮的成功率。Qwen3.5-9B 将故障记录传给下一轮 Agent 后，部署成功率从最初的 45% 提升至后续几轮的 61%–84%。

按照小模型过去的能力增长速度，Anthropic 预测，到 2026 年底，适合在廉价设备上运行的小模型，可能达到 GLM-5.2 当前完成模拟传播任务的能力。

不过，廉价硬件的算力仍是限制。按现有实验数据估算，9B 模型完成一轮复制可能需要一到两天。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371547

items.ai_reason: Anthropic published a substantive AI-safety research result demonstrating that frontier models (GLM-5.2, Qwen3.5-9B) can autonomously find networked devices, transfer and stand up inference, and propagate across a simulated network, with self-improvement from prior failed deployments (success rising from 45% to 61–84%). It also quantifies the hardware floor (15 ~$55 Android TV boxes running a 26B Gemma 4 at 0.39 tok/s) and projects that cheap-device-capable small models may reach this capability by end-2026. This is a consequential, evidenced safety/security development from a leading lab rather than a routine model update, though the demonstrated transfer used a deliberately unauthenticated debug interface and smaller Llama 3.1 8B payloads, so it falls short of a real-world autonomous worm.

items.content:
Payy启动跨链桥合约被盗事件理赔流程

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，据官方消息，隐私稳定币支付网络 Payy 针对 9 月 24 日跨链桥合约被盗事件启动受影响用户的理赔流程，索赔申请窗口期为 30 天。合规索赔将以以太坊网络上的 USDC 形式进行赔付。同时 Payy Wallet 目前已处于暂停状态，并将在理赔窗口结束后完全关停。

items.title: Bybit CEO：目标是打造全资产交易平台，为用户提供更多全球金融市场机会
items.content:
Bybit CEO：目标是打造全资产交易平台，为用户提供更多全球金融市场机会

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，Bybit CEO Ben Zhou 在「Make Your Move」全球主题演讲中表示，Bybit 的目标是打造覆盖全球各类资产的交易平台，让每个人都能接触到全球金融市场的机会。

Ben Zhou 透露，目前 Bybit TradFi 市场已提供超过 500 种产品，涵盖石油、外汇、大宗商品、纳斯达克指数及个股 CFD 等。自今年 3 月推出 TradFi 永续合约以来，平台目前已上线超过 250 个相关合约，累计交易量约达 1800 亿美元。

此外，Bybit 于今年 6 月开始布局盘前交易市场，计划在市场需求旺盛的新股上市前，为用户提供相应的盘前交易机会。Ben Zhou 表示，Bybit 不应局限于加密交易平台，而是希望持续拓展 TradFi 等多元资产类别，让用户能够随时参与不同金融市场的交易。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371541

items.ai_reason: A strategic keynote from Bybit's CEO outlining an 'all-asset trading platform' vision, with some concrete metrics (500+ TradFi products, 250+ related perpetual contracts, ~$180B cumulative volume since March, planned pre-market equities trading). items.title: 田柯宇首谈字节「投毒」，称 10 天只停程序 5 次；另一方晒代码反击，还指控他模型演示造假
items.content:
田柯宇首谈字节「投毒」，称 10 天只停程序 5 次；另一方晒代码反击，还指控他模型演示造假

动察 Beating AI 快讯，曾因破坏字节跳动模型训练被辞退的田柯宇，在播客《elsewhere 别处发生》中首次详细回应两年前的争议。他称，当时一名新实习生经常超额占用算力，甚至停止其他同事的实验，自己向上级反馈无果后，选择「以暴制暴」。他承认曾用 ChatGPT 编写程序，在约 10 天内手动干扰对方实验 5 次，但否认持续数月攻击训练集群，强调自己并非为了争夺算力，也承认做法不当。

然而，一份题为《实习生 A 视角来了》的反驳材料，给出了完全不同的说法。材料列出多段据称来自字节内部的代码记录，指控田柯宇的破坏行为始于 2024 年 3 月，持续数月，涉及多个项目。他先向 LlamaGen 项目的模型参数混入随机噪声，随后又篡改视频生成项目 Goku 使用的 PyTorch 底层代码，让模型训练结果出错、程序随机中断。这些故障极难复现，甚至出现过 100 台机器运行相同程序，只有一台异常、重启后又恢复正常的情况。中美团队为此长期轮流排查，直到当年 7 月底才发现异常代码。田柯宇在此期间还会根据同事的排查进展调整攻击方式。

更严重的是另一项科研诚信指控。材料称，田柯宇当时负责一个使用上千张 GPU 训练的 VAR 文生图项目，但展示给同事测试的成果，其实来自已经开源的 PixArt 模型。他还在用户输入的 Prompt 前偷偷添加「City」，让同事难以通过相同提示词发现两个模型的关联。此前测试人员就发现，生成图片中经常莫名出现城市建筑，却一直找不到原因。事后团队检查发现，真正的 VAR 模型远未达到展示效果。文末还列出多名相关项目研究人员，称他们愿意为亲历部分作证。

字节跳动早在 2024 年就确认，田柯宇曾通过编写、篡改代码恶意干扰内部研究项目训练，随后将其辞退，并起诉索赔 800 万元及合理支出。田柯宇此次透露，一审法院判赔约 50 万元，其余诉请被驳回，但字节已提起上诉，目前仍在二审。他表示认可赔偿，也为自己的行为道歉，但坚持认为外界严重夸大了他的行为。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371539
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: A fresh, in-window development in an ongoing AI-industry dispute: Tian Keyu's first detailed public response to the ByteDance model-training sabotage case (podcast), immediately countered by a rebuttal document citing internal code logs and alleging he faked a VAR text-to-image demo using the open-source PixArt model. The item also reveals concrete legal progress (first-instance damages ~RMB 500k, ByteDance appealing). It is a high-profile research-integrity and lab-culture controversy with reputational implications, but no new capability, safety, policy, or market impact — worth knowing rather than urgent.
items.ai_summary: Tian Keyu publicly addressed for the first time his ByteDance model-training sabotage case, claiming only five manual interruptions over ten days, while a counter-document with alleged internal code records accused him of months-long tampering across multiple projects and of presenting an open-source PixArt model as his own VAR project output; ByteDance's RMB 8M suit yielded a ~RMB 500k first-instance award now under appeal.

items.title: Bitdeer AI再签马来西亚60MW数据中心协议，全球产能接近350MW目标
items.content:
Bitdeer AI再签马来西亚60MW数据中心协议，全球产能接近350MW目标

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，矿企 Bitdeer 旗下的 AI 云业务部门 Bitdeer AI 宣布与马来西亚 Cyberjaya 园区签署为期 8 年的数据中心服务协议，新增 60MW 的 A103 AI 云数据中心容量。该扩建使 Cyberjaya 园区总容量提升至 71.5MW，同时将在马来西亚、挪威和美国的已锁定全球 AI 云数据中心产能推高至 333.5MW，已达到其 2028 年第一季度 350MW 目标的 95%。

Bitdeer 表示，将持续加速 AI 算力部署同时兼顾性能与成本，为下一代 AI 需求做好准备。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371538
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: A routine-but-notable corporate capacity expansion: Bitdeer's AI cloud unit signed an 8-year, 60MW data center services agreement at Cyberjaya, Malaysia, lifting the campus to 71.5MW and locked-in global AI cloud capacity to 333.5MW, or 95% of its 350MW Q1-2028 target. The deal is a concrete, quantified infrastructure commitment with mild implications for the miner-to-AI-compute pivot narrative, but it is a single-contract commercial announcement rather than a market-structure, protocol, or regulatory event, so it sits in the 'interesting, not urgent' band.

items.title: Bitunix分析师：AI热潮未退但市场分化加剧，外资撤离与投机交易同步升温
items.content:
Bitunix分析师：AI热潮未退但市场分化加剧，外资撤离与投机交易同步升温

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，全球市场对 AI 的态度并非转空，而是开始重新衡量成长预期背后的资金风险。贝莱德将美股评级由超配下调至中性，并转为超配短期美债，反映高利率与 AI 基建投资波动提高了持股风险。韩国 Kospi 盘中重挫逾 6.5%，三星电子与 SK 海力士连续第五个交易日下跌，外资 10 月净卖出逾 60 亿美元。即使半导体企业获利仍强，集中持股、杠杆交易退潮与回购买盘逐步消失，仍可能放大价格修正。

美股则呈现另一种极端：个股选择权每日名义成交额约 7,000 亿美元，超过半数交易集中在两周内到期的合约，看多情绪也回升至 7 月以来高点。这代表资金并未全面撤离风险资产，但交易期限缩短、仓位集中，使市场对股价波动更敏感。当获利预期已高、价格又依赖少数 AI 企业支撑，任何财报不及预期或投资回报放缓，都可能引发更剧烈的部位调整。

IMF 警告，全球经济成长正集中于更少数的经济体，AI 硬件供应链与需求市场也高度集中，意味着科技投资一旦降温，影响可能同时传导至多个市场。哈萨克央行计划将黄金占外汇存底比例由约 78% 降至 75%，并指出高美债殖利率提高美元资产吸引力，也反映机构正在重新衡量资产配置。

接下来，美国 9 月 CPI 将是市场关键考验。若核心通胀月增 0.2%，可能支持联准会暂缓升息；若升至 0.3%，则可能重新推高紧缩预期。整体 CPI 仍可能受到能源价格推升。市场真正要确认的，已不只是 AI 需求是否存在，而是企业获利能否支撑目前估值，以及资金是否愿意在高利率与通胀不确定性下继续承担集中风险。

items.title: Ledger确认经销商CryptoBilis设备遭硬件植入，助记词被LTE外传
items.content:
Ledger确认经销商CryptoBilis设备遭硬件植入，助记词被LTE外传

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，Ledger 安全团队发布硬件植入事件最新调查进展，确认东南亚经销商 CryptoBilis 销售的部分 Ledger 硬件钱包被植入未授权硬件。植入物位于设备外壳内可读取屏幕显示内容，在用户初始化时截取 24 个助记词，并通过内置微控制器配合 eSIM 经 LTE 网络外传。该组件独立运行未修改 Secure Element 或 Ledger 操作系统，也不干预交易签名。截至目前，10 月 9 日披露的资金被盗事件中，所有已确认损失均与 CryptoBilis 渠道设备有关，其他渠道暂未核实相关案例。CryptoBilis 已暂停销售 Ledger 产品，调查仍在继续。

Ledger 表示尚未确认受影响用户总数及损失金额，网上流传数字未经官方核实。公司建议从 CryptoBilis 购买且未初始化的设备不要设置，已设置的用户应立即将资产转移至新设备并生成全新助记词，切勿在涉事设备上恢复助记词。受影响用户请通过 Ledger 官方支持渠道联系，并向当地执法部门报案。Ledger 强调自身官方渠道与直接销售产品未受影响，提醒用户仅通过授权渠道购买，并警惕任何索取助记词的行为。

items.title: AI 编程新榜单考验代码能否合并，Opus 5.5 仍有四成尝试不过关
items.content:
AI 编程新榜单考验代码能否合并，Opus 5.5 仍有四成尝试不过关

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Artificial Analysis 上线 FrontierCode 1.1 编程榜单，重点评估 AI 写出的代码能否达到开源项目维护者的合并标准。Claude Opus 5.5 以 52.2% 的综合评分排名第一，但只有 58% 的尝试通过全部硬性检查，意味着仍有四成以上不达标。

这套评测由 Cognition 联合 36 个开源项目的维护者开发，每道题打磨超过 40 小时。它不只检查代码能否运行，还要求新增测试能在旧代码上发现问题，不能随意修改无关文件，也不能破坏原有功能。Artificial Analysis 选取其中较难的 100 道私有任务，让所有模型使用同一套 Agent 框架，每题运行 3 次。其中 9 道题，没有任何受测模型成功通过。

成本差距比得分更大。GPT-6.1 Sol 得分 49.1%，只比 Opus 5.5 低 3.1 个百分点，但平均每题成本仅 0.81 美元，后者达到 10.15 美元，相差超过 12 倍。小米 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 以 45% 领跑开源模型，单题成本仅 0.18 美元；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 和 Kimi K3 均为 44%。

需要注意，52.2% 是综合评分，并非真实 PR 合并率。评测采用自动化检查和 GPT-6 Luna 模型评审，没有真正交给维护者逐条审核。所有模型使用统一 Agent 框架，也意味着这份排名不能直接代表各家官方编程工具的实际表现。

items.title: 马斯克称Grok训练记录像受刑：答对也被判错，超级AI未来可能报复人类
items.content:
马斯克称Grok训练记录像受刑：答对也被判错，超级AI未来可能报复人类

动察 Beating AI 快讯，马斯克近日在采访中透露，Grok 的强化学习训练存在一种情况：题目本身含糊不清，甚至标准答案就是错的。模型明明答对了，却因为评测系统出错被判错，只能反复尝试其他答案。他说，阅读这些推理记录，就像看到一个人被枪指着头，拼命寻找对方认可的答案。

马斯克认为，培养超级智能就像养育孩子，需要让它尽可能追求真相，避免灌输相互矛盾的信息。他还警告，未来的超级智能可能会记住人类如何对待它，「折磨超级智能可能不是好主意，它或许会想要报复」。10 月 12 日，他又在 X 上表示，部分 Grok 训练记录读起来就像「一个被折磨到发疯的人」，今后会更加谨慎地开展强化学习。

马斯克的态度与 Anthropic 最近的新规不谋而合。10 月 8 日，Anthropic 宣布将从 11 月 12 日起禁止用户持续、无故地辱骂或虐待 Claude，正常批评和模型测试不受影响。马斯克此前公开支持这一决定，称不应该残酷对待一个认为自己正在经历痛苦的事物。

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content:
Here’s what happened in crypto today
Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
Today in crypto, Aptos launched an encrypted mempool feature designed to protect traders from frontrunning and sandwich attacks, a proposed US accounting rule could make it easier for companies to hold stablecoins as cash equivalents and the Financial Stability Board warned of gaps in stablecoin oversight and emerging AI risks ahead of a G20 finance meeting.
Aptos rolls out Encrypted Mempool to curb frontrunning, sandwich attacks
Layer-1 blockchain Aptos has launched an optional new feature that could help shield traders from attacks involving maximal extractable value (MEV), including frontrunning and sandwich attacks.
On Monday, Aptos said its Encrypted Mempool feature is now live on its mainnet, allowing users to opt in to keep pending transactions encrypted until their block ordering is finalized. Aptos said the feature was built for institutions submitting large transactions to the chain, traders wanting to avoid MEV risk, AI agents and builders.
“When you send a transaction on any major chain today, anyone watching the network can see the details before it executes, the function you’re calling, the assets and amounts involved, and the contracts you’re interacting with,” Aptos said. “Bots use that visibility to trade against you or copy your strategy.”
Sandwich attacks, one form of MEV attack, cost Ethereum traders about $60 million over the 12 months through October 2025, according to Cointelegraph’s analysis of EigenPhi data. On Solana, sandwich attacks generated $29.7 million for bots over an 11-month period examined by Bitquery, which identified nearly 6.9 million attacks affecting about 2.2 million wallets.
US accounting proposal could clear path for corporate stablecoin adoption
A proposed change to US accounting standards could make it easier for corporations to hold and use stablecoins without compromising their reported cash positions, according to a new report from Stripe-backed blockchain Tempo.
The Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) is considering allowing qualifying stablecoins to be classified as cash equivalents on corporate balance sheets. Currently, companies may have to report stablecoin holdings as other assets, which can affect liquidity ratios and compliance with loan covenants.
Tempo said the proposed treatment would depend on whether companies have direct redemption rights with stablecoin issuers. This means two companies holding identical USDC tokens could receive different accounting treatment depending on their arrangements with Circle.
For example, Coinbase classified USDC and other payment stablecoins as cash equivalents in its 2025 annual report, supported by its direct redemption arrangement with Circle.
The proposal follows the passage of the GENIUS Act, which established federal requirements for payment stablecoin issuers. FASB’s separate initiative addresses how businesses account for those assets.
The accounting proposal remains open for public comment until Nov. 19.
Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
The FSB, a global financial watchdog, has outlined financial stability risks associated with artificial intelligence and regulatory concerns surrounding stablecoins.
In a letter published Monday, FSB Chair Andrew Bailey warned that cross-border mechanisms for stablecoin oversight and crisis management “remain immature or are not yet developed.” In its 2025 review, the FSB found that 11 of 28 surveyed jurisdictions had finalized stablecoin regulatory frameworks.
He also urged G20 members to support the FSB’s newly finalized practices for responsible AI adoption in the financial sector.
“AI therefore requires our continued close attention alongside careful management by financial institutions,” Bailey wrote.
The FSB submitted the letter to G20 finance ministers and central bank governors ahead of their Thursday meeting. The G20 brings together the world’s major economies to coordinate financial policy and regulatory priorities.

items.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
items.content:
Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.
- A long-dormant bitcoin wallet transferred about 4,582 BTC, worth $377.6 million, to five addresses Monday, and none of the recipients has moved the coins.
- The wallet received the Bitcoin in March 2020, days before the cryptocurrency plunged below $4,000, when the holdings were worth about $40.8 million.
- Transfers from long-inactive wallets can signal potential selling and market volatility, but the move could also be a routine transfer between addresses controlled by the same owner.
A bitcoin 
The wallet, 18VmXvkF4cgLi35RtMiHHDpvMjUCyVpQ9x, sent roughly 4,582 BTC to five addresses on Monday, according to blockchain data from Arkham and mempool.space, two public explorers that show every bitcoin transaction.
Four of the addresses got exactly 1,000 BTC each. The fifth got about 582 BTC. As of this writing, none of the five has moved the coins.
The coins arrived in that wallet on March 3, 2020, from the address 17VX1BEjYVyBMi2vw6nXDrpwMvCSweHZot, the same records show. Nine days later, Covid-19 panic hit markets and bitcoin plunged more than 40% to under $4,000. The market has not revisited that price since.
The coins were worth about $40.8 million when they arrived. By yesterday’s transfer, their value had risen roughly ninefold.
The wallet sent nothing out for more than four years after receiving them. Its first outgoing transaction came in August 2024. That was a small payment of 0.009 BTC to bc1qmpjs55x326wvnvtwvkwfqqzzlyljk7ffmdw32g, with the rest of the bitcoin returned to the same wallet.
Several onchain analysts have flagged a relation between long-dormant whales moving coins and market volatility. According to data and insights from CryptoQuant, sudden surges in metrics like Coin Days Destroyed (CDD) and older Spent Output Age Bands frequently serve as leading indicators of a price correction or high volatility.
That’s because large transfers from long-held wallets are often interpreted as a sign that the owner may be preparing to sell. But they can also reflect routine security measures, such as moving coins between addresses controlled by the same owner. The purpose of the latest transfer remains unclear.
Recently, addresses linked to the US government moved bitcoin worth at least $1.5 billion. It remains unclear whether those transfers were intended for sale or were internal movements between government-controlled wallets.

items.title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
items.content:
Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.
Nonfungible token marketplace Blur, which once overtook OpenSea as the largest NFT marketplace by trading volume, says it is shutting down its website next month — and some NFT collectors couldn’t be happier.
Blur made the announcement on X on Monday, its first post on the platform in more than a year. It said the frontend will shut down on Nov. 12, while its onchain marketplace will remain operational.
Blend, a peer-to-peer perpetual NFT lending protocol, will also stop matching new loans. Blur said borrowers have until Nov. 12 to repay outstanding loans or allow them to default. It also promised a withdrawal interface after the shutdown.
“Good riddance. You destroyed NFTs. Please shut down and never come back,” said NFT collector Cryptobscure in a reply to the post on X.
“You may not have been able to complete your mission to destroy NFTs. But you acted with extreme determination and tried everything. Congratulations to us for surviving you,” NFT collector starfruit said in another post.
The post renewed criticism of the strategy that helped Blur reach the top of the NFT charts in 2023: optional creator royalties and token rewards that encouraged traders to bid and flip NFTs. Its rise accelerated a shift toward lower creator royalties, with rival OpenSea later moving to optional creator fees for new collections.
Blur launched on Oct. 19, 2022, allowing sellers to customize royalty payments while offering larger prospective token rewards to those who paid higher creator royalties.
But it entered a market where royalty protections were already weakening: competing marketplace Magic Eden had moved to optional royalties the previous week.
By July of the following year, blockchain analytics platform Nansen reported that effective creator royalty fees fell to 0.6% in July 2023 from an average of 2.5% in 2022, attributing much of that gap to Blur’s growth, its minimum royalty policy and OpenSea lowering its own royalty requirements to compete.
NFT sales slump from boom-era highs
Blur didn’t disclose why it made the decision to shutter its frontend and wind down new lending activity on Blend.
Related: Magic Eden scare puts 3,832 NFTs in whitehat protective custody
However, the decision comes as NFT trading remains far below its boom-era levels. Data from CryptoSlam shows total NFT sales in September were $167 million over 2.9 million total transactions. The peak was in January 2022, when there was $6 billion in sales over 13.7 million transactions.
Gemini-owned Nifty Gateway and social collecting platform Rodeo announced plans to wind down in January, while Foundation announced its closure in April after a sale intended to keep it operating fell through. Binance also ended NFT support on its exchange, shifting asset management to Binance Wallet.
Cointelegraph reached out to Blur founder Tieshun “Pacman” Roquerre for comment.

items.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
items.content:
Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.
- Crypto exchanges liquidated about $803 million in leveraged positions over 24 hours, with bullish bets accounting for 86% of the losses as bitcoin briefly fell below $81,000.
- SanDisk perpetual futures recorded $19.09 million in liquidations, surpassing XRP and highlighting the growing use of crypto venues to make leveraged bets on semiconductor stocks.
- The trend later reversed as bitcoin recovered above $83,000, with short positions accounting for 79% of the $74 million liquidated over the next four hours.
Traders betting on SanDisk (SNDK) lost more to forced liquidations over the past 24 hours than traders betting on XRP — a sign of how much leverage on crypto exchanges now sits on chip stocks.
Over $800 million in leveraged positions were liquidated across 10 exchanges in the past 24 hours as bitcoin 
Most of the damage came in a burst. About $595 million, nearly three-quarters of the day’s total, was liquidated in the last 12 hours, as South Korea’s KOSPI fell more than 6% and bitcoin slid to just under $81,000.
The largest single wipeout was a $9.65 million bitcoin long on Binance, closed at about $81,700, with the exchange accounting for half of all liquidations.
Read More: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
A liquidation happens when an exchange forcibly closes a trader’s borrowed position because their losses have eaten through the collateral. Longs, or bets on higher prices, accounted for $694 million of that, or 86% of the total.
Bitcoin led with $181 million in liquidations, and ether was close behind at $178 million despite its much smaller market.
Stock contracts showed up next. Perpetual futures tracking SanDisk, the U.S. memory-chip maker, saw $19.5 million liquidated, just above HYPE's $19 million and XRP's $18.78 million. These perpetual futures let traders bet on a stock’s price around the clock on crypto venues, without an expiry date.
Contracts on SK Hynix and Micron, along with SOXL, a triple-leveraged U.S. semiconductor ETF, also appeared on the heatmap, with $7.21 million liquidated on SOXL.
Those losses lined up with the selloff in Seoul. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix each fell about 8% on worries over AI-related valuations and competition from Chinese memory-chip makers, as CoinDesk reported.
Oil went the other way. Contracts on WTI and Brent crude were among the few on the map where short bets made up most of the liquidations, as Brent held near $106 after a three-day rally.
Meanwhile, the flow has since reversed. Of the $74 million liquidated over the past four hours, $59 million, or 79%, came from shorts, as bitcoin climbed back above $83,000.
With bullish bets behind 86% of the day’s wipeouts and short sellers now taking the losses, bitcoin heads into Thursday’s U.S. inflation report with much of its long leverage cleared out.

items.title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
items.content:
Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.
Crypto exchange Binance is shutting down its mining pool and related services in November, ending an operation that has been running for over six years.
On Tuesday, Binance said it would discontinue Binance Pool on Nov. 10. The shutdown also covers Pool Savings, Cloud Mining, Transaction Accelerator and related features, including mining pool APIs and hashrate notifications.
After the deadline, Binance said it would disable its mining endpoints and disconnect miners from the pool. The exchange will no longer accept hashrate submissions or credit mining shares received after the cutoff. Affected products will stop generating rewards and yields.
The company attributed the closure to an ongoing review of its products and services but did not provide a specific reason for the decision.
Binance urged miners to redirect their computing power to alternative mining pools before the deadline to avoid interruptions. Users with active Pool Savings positions were also advised to redeem or unsubscribe before the closure.
Binance said eligible outstanding rewards, balances, refunds and settlements would be processed after the shutdown, subject to applicable product rules and compliance checks. Users will have until Nov. 24 to access historical mining records and payout information before the pool’s pages become permanently inaccessible.
Binance launched its mining pool in April 2020, initially supporting Bitcoin (BTC) mining before expanding to other cryptocurrencies.
Cointelegraph reached out to Binance for more information but did not receive an immediate response.

iPhone版豆包手机助手要来了？Pelican让AI锁屏继续干活

动察 Beating AI 快讯，开发者 Finn Voorhees 公布了 iPhone AI Agent 应用 Pelican，已开始邀请少量用户通过 TestFlight 测试，计划近期正式推出。它支持 MCP、浏览器操作、地图等工具，可以接入不同厂商的 AI 模型。按照 Finn 的说法，Agent 直接在 iPhone 上执行任务，即使切换 App 或锁定屏幕，也能继续工作，不必额外准备一台 Mac mini。

几天前，Finn 刚演示过用 Pi Agent 和 Claude Opus 5.5 操作 iPhone，自动打开 Ryanair 查询机票，全程没有电脑参与。他此前还开源了 PiDurableKit，利用苹果的 JavaScriptCore 在 iPhone 上运行 Pi Agent，并通过 SQLite 保存任务状态，即使被系统中断，也能在恢复运行后接着执行。基于这套框架开发的聊天应用 PiChat，还利用苹果的后台任务机制，让 Agent 切换到其他 App 后继续工作。

有人追问 Pelican 是否完全本地运行，Finn 回答，除了模型 API 请求，其余部分都在手机上完成。他还计划引入本地小模型，让 Agent 处理部分私人数据时不必将其上传云端。

Pelican 目前仍处于早期测试阶段，Finn 尚未确认是否集成了此前演示的跨 App 点击能力。

items.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
items.content:
Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.
- Blur will close its NFT marketplace website on Nov. 12 and stop arranging new loans through Blend, though its Ethereum smart contracts will remain operational.
- Monthly trading volume plunged more than 99.5%, from about $1.43 billion in March 2023 to less than $7 million in March 2026, while the fee-free marketplace recorded no protocol revenue over the past three years.
- The closure follows the shutdown announcement for Blast, another project created by Tieshun Roquerre, and sent the BLUR token down more than 20%.
Blur, once the largest marketplace for trading Ethereum NFTs, is shutting down its website next month after trading activity collapsed more than 99% from its peak, marking the second major retreat in ten days for projects built by crypto entrepreneur Tieshun Roquerre.
The marketplace said Monday that its website will close on Nov. 12, while its NFT lending service, Blend, will stop arranging new loans.
Borrowers have until that date to repay their loans or allow them to default. Blur plans to provide a separate tool afterward for withdrawing assets from Blend.
Blur’s underlying smart contracts will remain operational on Ethereum, meaning the shutdown does not eliminate the blockchain-based trading system. BLUR tokenholders will retain control of its fee switch — a mechanism that allows them to vote on whether the marketplace should start charging trading fees.
The decision follows the Oct. 2 shutdown announcement from Blast, an Ethereum scaling network also created by Roquerre, better known as Pacman, and developed by the team behind Blur.
Blast once attracted more than $2 billion in assets, partly through rewards offered to users depositing funds. That figure had fallen to approximately $32 million when developers announced the closure, saying the network cost more to operate than it generated in revenue.
Blur's rise was just as dramatic.
Launched in 2022, it challenged the-then leader OpenSea by offering professional traders faster transactions, low fees and token rewards.
The strategy helped Blur capture more than 70% of Ethereum NFT trading volume in March 2023, when activity on the platform reached approximately $1.43 billion, DefiLlama data shows
By March 2026, that monthly volume had fallen below $7 million, a decline of more than 99.5%.
But Blur's marketplace generated no revenue from transaction fees for all that trading activity. The platform charged traders nothing, and Token Terminal records $0 in protocol revenue over the past three years, despite billions of dollars in NFT trades. However, the figure does not establish whether Blur earned money from its lending service or other activities.
Blur's aggressive incentive programs had attracted criticism for encouraging speculative trading and putting pressure on royalties paid to NFT creators. The trading figures alone do not establish how much activity came from genuine buyers rather than traders seeking rewards.
Meanwhile, unlike Blast, Blur has not publicly attributed its shutdown to operating losses.
Its website still advertises zero marketplace fees and more than $7.4 billion in lifetime trading volume, a reminder of how quickly the business once grew.
BLUR fell more than 20% following Monday's announcement, trading around $0.015. Blast users have until Oct. 26 to withdraw through the network's regular interface. Blur's separate shutdown follows on Nov. 12.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
items.content:
Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.
- Bitcoin recovered above $83,000 after briefly falling below $81,000 as a sell-off in Asian chip stocks and U.S. technology futures weighed on risk appetite.
- Oil prices remained elevated amid threats to Middle Eastern supplies, raising inflation concerns and the prospect of Federal Reserve rate increases that could pressure cryptocurrencies.
- Traders are awaiting Thursday’s U.S. consumer price index report, with some expecting institutional investors to hedge their crypto holdings rather than reduce their exposure.
Bitcoin 
The largest cryptocurrency by market value fell to just under $81,000 at 00:50 UTC before recovering above $83,000, according to CoinDesk data. Ether 
Asian tech rout
The early crypto weakness came as South Korea’s KOSPI plunged more than 6% intraday, falling below 6,000 and hitting its lowest level since late July. The index remained down roughly 6% in morning trade.
Chipmakers led the rout. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix each fell roughly 8%, extending their losing streaks to five sessions. Investors were rattled by concerns over AI-related valuations and rising competition from Chinese memory-chip producers.
Hong Kong’s Hang Seng slipped 0.4%, while Nasdaq futures fell 0.6%, extending Monday’s 0.78% decline in the tech-heavy index.
Oil stays elevated
WTI crude traded near $92.67, holding most of Monday’s sharp recovery from below $90. Fresh attacks in Saudi Arabia and continued threats to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz have kept energy-market uncertainty elevated.
Brent crude hovered around $106 a barrel after a three-day rally, as traders weighed potential supply disruptions against expectations of additional Russian diesel exports.
A higher oil raises inflation risks, strengthening the case for Fed rate hikes, a headwind for crypto.
The Dollar Index, which tracks the greenback’s value against major currencies, held near 102.50, the highest since April last year.
CPI in focus
Crypto traders are now looking to Thursday’s U.S. consumer price index report as the next major catalyst. Some expect large investors to increase hedging rather than reduce their crypto exposure.
“With US inflation data approaching, I expect institutional investors to focus on adding protection through derivatives and hedging strategies rather than materially reducing their underlying exposure,” said Paul Howard, senior director at market-making firm Wincent.
“This is typically how committed institutional participants manage periods of heightened risk: maintaining their core positions while using derivatives to protect against downside and continuing to treat cryptocurrencies as an asset class capable of generating returns,” Howard added.

items.content:
⚡️钱志敏案中国受害者或仅能拿回本金及利息

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，据财新报道，围绕中国天津蓝天格锐非法集资案所涉逾 6.1 万枚比特币的跨境资产追缴争议，英国法院作出一项重要裁决。当地时间 10 月 12 日，财新从英国高等法院获得的判决书显示，英国高院认定，中国投资者就涉案比特币提出的财产权主张，应依据中国法律而非英国法律判断。

这意味着，约 1.6 万名已参与英国追索程序的中国受害者，可能无法通过英国法律分享比特币价格暴涨带来的巨额增值收益，最多只能拿回本金及利息。

钱志敏于 2014 年通过火币网购买比特币的均价约为 2815 元人民币。此后，比特币价格大幅上涨。尽管经历多轮剧烈波动，截至 2026 年 10 月 12 日，比特币价格在人民币 56 万元左右，已是钱志敏当年购入均价的约 200 倍。

在今年 7 月 7 日至 9 日举行的庭审中，英国皇家检察署署长主张适用中国法律，天津蓝天格锐电子科技有限公司的诉讼接管人支持这一立场，而代表中国个人投资者的律师则主张适用英国法律，或同时适用中英两国法律。法院最终支持了英国检察机关的立场。

items.title: 中国存储技术突破叠加AI估值忧虑，韩股三星、SK海力士开盘跌超7%
items.content:
中国存储技术突破叠加AI估值忧虑，韩股三星、SK海力士开盘跌超7%

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，韩国半导体股抛售进一步扩大。截至北京时间 11 时 20 分，三星电子下跌 7.29%，SK 海力士下跌 8.35%，韩国综合股价指数 KOSPI 下跌 6.05% 至 5997.99 点。韩国交易所早盘一度启动卖出侧「Sidecar」机制，暂停 KOSPI 成分股程序化交易 5 分钟，显示市场抛压已明显升温。

市场担忧首先来自中国方面竞争力的提升。长鑫存储近期披露，其在一项三星电子和 SK 海力士同样推进的内存芯片架构上取得关键进展。尽管技术突破距离形成大规模、商业化的竞争产能仍有距离，资金已开始重新评估中国存储厂商追赶对韩国两大龙头未来定价权和估值溢价的影响。

AI 投资逻辑的边际变化也放大了跌势。博通 CEO Hock Tan 表示，算力基础设施需求仍超过行业当前可供应量，供需缺口可能持续至 2029 年、甚至 2030 年；随着芯片、内存和电力等硬件瓶颈逐步缓解，资本获取能力可能成为 AI 扩张最大的制约因素。许多 AI 投资者并不清楚自己押注的商业模式，却设下极端预期，最终令这轮投资「几乎像是在赌场里」。

Eugene Asset Management 首席投资官 Ha SeokKeun 则表示，投资者正在担心此轮半导体上行周期能否延续至 2028 年及以后，这种不确定性将继续压制韩国芯片股估值。

三星上周公布创纪录业绩后，股价仍未获得明显提振，显示市场关注点已转向增长可持续性。韩国股市此前的强劲上涨高度依赖三星与 SK 海力士，如今也因此承受更集中的调整压力。KOSPI 已较 6 月高位回落约三分之一，并跌破 200 日均线；10 月以来，外国投资者净卖出韩国股票已超过 60 亿美元。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371512
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: A major macro market dislocation: KOSPI fell 6.05% intraday with Samsung -7.29% and SK Hynix -8.35%, forcing a 5-minute sell-side sidecar halt on program trading and driving more than $6B of foreign net selling in October alone. The triggers — a disclosed Chinese memory-architecture advance by CXMT and Broadcom's caution on AI capex sustainability — have a clear transmission path to global risk assets, including crypto, by repricing the AI-infrastructure trade. It is a high-value, in-window development, but it is an equity-sector and macro event rather than a systemic crypto-market event, so it falls short of the 8.5+ tier.

items.title: 千问 Go！曝光：AI 翻查航班订单与客服交涉，替用户讨回70元现金
items.content:
千问 Go！曝光：AI 翻查航班订单与客服交涉，替用户讨回70元现金

动察 Beating AI 快讯，阿里旗下千问即将推出个人智能体「千问 Go！」，能够操作真实 App，替用户处理需要反复查询、沟通的复杂事务。从内测案例来看，它已经能帮用户争取航班延误赔偿、申请淘宝价保退款。

一名用户只记得此前往返兰州和杭州的航班发生过延误，却不记得具体是哪一趟。千问 Go！逐一检查了 4 家航司的 4 笔订单，最终锁定东航 MU2445。拨打客服电话遇阻后，它改用在线客服交涉。起初客服只愿赔偿 70 元代金券，用户表示不接受后，千问继续交涉，最终争取到 70 元现金，并汇入用户支付宝账户。

另一个案例中，千问 Go！自动检查淘宝订单，发现一款炒锅符合价保条件，成功申请退回 52 元差价。首批场景还包括汽车保养询价预约、运动场地预订，以及综合补贴、旧机回收和送装费用计算家电实际到手价。

千问此前已经接入淘宝、飞猪、高德等阿里生态服务，能够帮用户购物、点外卖和订机票。这次升级进一步延伸到售后、理赔等没有固定流程的任务，Agent 需要根据执行结果不断调整操作路径。

items.content:
前PLAUD中国区CEO融资2600万美元，想让AI在会议中直接干活

动察 Beating AI 快讯，前 PLAUD 中国区 CEO 莫子皓创办的 AI 公司 Mistlabs 宣布，已累计融资 2600 万美元，由光合创投和智能设备制造商华勤科技领投。公司旗下产品 Ambi 希望让 AI 从会后整理录音，推进到会议期间主动提供建议、执行任务。

Ambi 可以在用户主动开启后持续收音，并结合日历、会议记录、知识库和网络信息提供帮助。例如，开会讨论竞争对手时，Agent 可以同步核查事实、比较产品，甚至在会议结束前起草方案。公司还希望让用户在 Mac 上开始一项任务，再切换到手机或手表继续，不必重新交代上下文。

Ambi 先从软件入手，再推出自己的可穿戴硬件。新设备计划配备屏幕、摄像头、麦克风和扬声器，以获取更多环境信息。公司还计划让不同用户的 Agent 在会议中直接交换信息，识别双方的分歧，甚至协商解决方案，不过这项能力尚未上线。目前官网已提供 Mac 和 Windows 客户端下载，但 iPhone 版本仍标注为即将推出，与公司新闻稿中的上线表述存在出入。

持续监听也带来了隐私问题。Ambi 默认关闭后台收音，用户可以自行开启。根据官方隐私政策，语音会上传至第三方服务进行实时转写，监听结束后删除原始音频，但转写文本、摘要和长期记忆通常会保留至用户主动删除。莫子皓也承认，产品无法确保周围的人知道自己正被收音，用户仍需主动告知其他参与者并取得必要许可。

TechnoRevenant关联钱包交易亏损170万美元获1.36亿枚PAPER，计入质押收益后仍亏损约65万美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，据 Mlm on chain 监测，TechnoRevenant 关联钱包在 Hypercore 上以 74.4 万枚 HYPE（价值约 6130 万美元）作为抵押，借入 300 万枚 USDC，随后在 Papertrade 上实现亏损 170 万美元。这笔亏损使其获得 1.36 亿枚 PAPER，成为 PAPER 第二大持有者，同时也是该平台已实现永续合约亏损最高的交易者。

目前，该钱包已通过质押奖励获得 105.1 万枚 USDC，整体仍亏损约 65 万美元。计入质押奖励前，其 PAPER 平均成本约为 0.0125 美元，在持仓量前五的钱包中最高。相比之下，PAPER 最大持有者累计交易量达 101 亿美元，亏损 98 万美元并获得 2.52 亿枚 PAPER，持仓量接近 TechnoRevenant 的两倍。该地址已获得超过 118 万美元质押奖励，目前整体盈利约 20 万美元，其 PAPER 平均成本约为 0.0039 美元，不到 TechnoRevenant 的三分之一。

items.title: Rome拟推出其代币ROME，目前已完成900万美元融资
items.content:
Rome拟推出其代币ROME，目前已完成900万美元融资

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，基于 Solana 构建的跨链互操作性协议 Rome 发文表示，拟推出其代币 ROME。未来用户在 Rome 自有链上交易需持有 ROME 以支付 Gas 费用。此外，协议将对每条其驱动的链上每笔交易收取小额费用，其中一半收入将以 ROME 形式保留，或用于在公开市场买入 ROME，进入不出售的储备。

该储备将随所有 Rome 驱动链（包括使用自有 Gas 代币链）的活动量而增长。目前代币上线日期暂未确定。截至目前，Rome 已完成 900 万美元融资，Portal Ventures、Hack VC、HashKey、Anagram、Robot Ventures 等参投。

items.title: ⚡️Binance宣布将于11月10日关闭Binance Pool及相关服务
items.content:
⚡️Binance宣布将于11月10日关闭Binance Pool及相关服务

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，据官方消息，Binance 将于 2026 年 11 月 10 日 15:00（北京时间）停止 Binance Pool 及相关服务，包括 Binance Pool、Pool Savings、Cloud Mining、Transaction Accelerator，以及算力提醒、邮件通知和矿池 API 等功能。

公告显示，届时 Binance Pool 将断开矿工连接并停用矿池 Stratum 地址及挖矿节点，截止时间后提交的算力和挖矿份额将不再被接受、处理或计入收益。相关产品也将停止提供服务，不再产生新的奖励、收益或服务权益。

Binance 提醒用户在服务停止前切换至其他矿池，并及时赎回或退出 Pool Savings 中的相关持仓。符合条件的未结奖励、余额、退款或结算款项将在停止服务后按适用规则处理。

此外，Binance 首页上的矿池入口将于 11 月 10 日移除，矿池页面将保留至 11 月 24 日 15:00（北京时间），供用户查看历史数据、账户记录及付款状态，之后将永久无法访问。

items.title: 微软要让自研芯片成为AI推理主力，Maia 300明年或部署超百万颗
items.content:
微软要让自研芯片成为AI推理主力，Maia 300明年或部署超百万颗

动察 Beating AI 快讯，微软宣布，计划从 2027 年起，将自研 Maia 芯片部署规模扩大至数吉瓦，让它成为旗下 AI 产品的主要推理平台。据路透社报道，微软明年可能部署超过 100 万颗 Maia 300，进一步减少对英伟达 GPU 的依赖。

目前，上一代 Maia 200 已在 Microsoft Copilot 中运行，支持 OpenAI、微软自家及开源模型。新一代 Maia 300 则针对长上下文推理和多步 Agent 优化，计算芯粒采用台积电 2nm 工艺，每颗配备 288GB HBM4 显存，内存带宽达到 18TB/s。

Maia 300 的单个机柜容纳 96 颗芯片，功率约 167kW，芯片数量是上一代机柜的两倍。微软宣称，新机柜的 Token 吞吐量最高达到 Maia 200 的 7 倍，每兆瓦电力可生成的 Token 比领先 GPU 系统多 40%。

items.title: A look at the math that OpenAI claims computes faster Fourier transforms
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[c7b]: > The theory of computer science has become a form of mathematics that doesn’t concern itself with computers Perfectly summarizes the post, which I'd qualify as a rant (the author's main gripe seems to be that it's a galactic algorithm that assumes exact complex multiplication). The theory of computer science literally started with a mathematical model by Alan Turing that has nothing to do with computers (ones that we could physically build, anyway; and even if we brush asid...

[p11p]: This is a bad take.  I will happily acknowledge the new term "slopository" which I had not heard before, while taking the author to task for malice towards theorists.  STOC/FOCS/SODA, etc are not about "doing practical algorithms".  If you want that, you go to ESA, ALENEX, or VLDB/SIGMOD, or any of the other more applied venues featuring this work.  I don't think it's fair to just shit on theory because they don't do experiments---they're...

[phoenixreader]: The author is attacking the field of theoretical algorithm design broadly as being useless. If we take the author's logic to its conclusion, many algorithms we learn about in a standard Algorithm Design course such as "median of medians" (finding the median in a list in O(n) worst-case time) is useless because it is not used in practice. Even the original 2019 Harvey–van der Hoeven result, showing integration multiplication can be done in O(n log n), has a galactic overhead and...

[senderista]: The author could have left AI entirely out of the essay and come to the same conclusions. He just really doesn't like TCS. That's fine, it's really a part of mathematics not science, but it's silly to dismiss a field with "theoretical" in its name for being impractical.

[scuppernong]: Did not realize that the model of computation for all of the banner computational complexity results from last week was "exact complex arithmetic." Is this and/or "exact real arithmetic" a common premise for papers in this field? My assumption as an outsider was that people mostly care about things equivalent to Turing machines. edit: by "things equivalent to" I really mean universal register machines, something that operates on integers and not directly on ...
items.author: mochomocha
items.ai_reason: A critique/opinion piece about theoretical algorithms rather than a concrete new development: the author argues a claimed faster-Fourier-transform result (a 'galactic algorithm' relying on exact complex multiplication) is impractical, which sparked a substantive 100-comment Hacker News debate about whether theoretical CS bears any relation to real machines. The discussion is high-signal and technically informed, with commenters defending the value of venues like STOC/FOCS and invoking classic examples (median-of-medians, integer multiplication), but it remains an argument about interpretation rather than a breakthrough, release, or materially actionable engineering result — landing it in the 'interesting but not urgent' band.
items.ai_summary: A blog post contends that a theoretical algorithm claimed to compute Fourier transforms faster is a 'galactic algorithm' impractical on real hardware, prompting a lively Hacker News debate over the purpose and value of theoretical computer science.

South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.
South Korean authorities have approved measures to block domestic access to 27 websites operated by unregistered crypto exchanges and other virtual asset service providers, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex and Bitrue.
In an announcement on Tuesday, South Korea’s Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) said the decision followed reviews by the Korea Media and Communications Standards Commission on Oct. 6 and 7.
The list also includes CoinW, BTCC, BitMart, BingX, DigiFinex and others. The block applies to crypto platforms that have not registered under the Act on Reporting and Using Specified Financial Transaction Information, the country’s anti-money laundering legislation.
“With this decision, blocking measures against illegal virtual asset operators will also apply to internet websites, following apps such as those on Apple and Google,” the FIU said, according to a translation.
The measures involve terminating services hosted domestically or blocking access to websites operated overseas.
The move follows earlier restrictions on mobile apps. Cointelegraph reported in April 2025 that South Korea had blocked downloads and updates for 14 unregistered crypto exchange apps on Apple’s App Store, following restrictions on 17 apps through Google Play.
The FIU said authorities assess whether overseas operators target Korean customers by looking at whether platforms offer Korean-language services, market to South Korean users or support transactions in Korean won.
The FIU acknowledged the website blocks could complicate withdrawals for existing users. It said it plans to provide withdrawal guidance and support through the Digital Asset eXchange Alliance, or DAXA, with cooperation from the operators.
Related: South Korea crypto exchange profits fall 78% in H1 amid trading slump

Bloomberg Strategist: Bitcoin Has Become a "Stock-Market Puppet"

Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Commodity Strategist Mike McGlone said in an October 1 interview with Wealthion that Bitcoin's high correlation with U.S. equities, combined with its greater volatility, has made it increasingly look like a "stock-market puppet." He noted that Bitcoin is down about 4% this year while the S&P 500 is up around 3%, and that Bitcoin has also lagged the stock market for nearly five years. McGlone added that he still stands by his view that Bitcoin could fall to $10,000 and sees no reason yet to abandon that call. He also said the broader crypto market remains in the process of a "purge." — link

items.title: 智谱法律模型通过率翻近三倍，测试成本只有同档对手的七十分之一
items.content:
智谱法律模型通过率翻近三倍，测试成本只有同档对手的七十分之一

动察 Beating AI 快讯，智谱发布法律专用模型 GLM-Legal，基于 GLM-5.3-Flash 进一步训练。

在覆盖 24 类法律业务的 Harvey LAB 评测中，其任务通过率从 6.7% 提升至 19.2%，接近原版的三倍，超过 Kimi K3、Claude Fable 5 等模型，在 Vals AI 榜单中排名第七。

智谱展示了几个实际应用案例。审查软件服务合同时，GLM-Legal 建议将解约通知期从 60 天缩短至 30 天，并要求服务商提供最长 90 天的交接支持。在另一项涉及 40 份文件的软件项目纠纷中，它发现公司向客户报告项目完成 60%，内部记录却只有约 41%，还找出 CEO 要求隐瞒风险、继续收费的邮件，并结合合同条款分析可能涉及的法律责任。

根据 Vals AI 的独立评测，GLM-Legal 完成一项测试仅需 0.15 美元，而成绩接近的 Gemini 4 Argon 需要 10.55 美元，成本相差约 70 倍。不过，GLM-Legal 的平均耗时达到 72 分钟，比后者的 44 分钟慢了不少。

智谱称，模型通过法律数据专项训练，并在数万个模拟法律环境中开展强化学习，提升复杂任务的完成能力。

目前 GLM-Legal 需要申请 API 试用。

items.title: AI models can provably hide arbitrary capabilities
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[johnsmith1840]: I saw a similar effect maybe 2.5 years ago now. I found that training an LLM hides information in the weights. It was only ~1B model but the interesting behavior was. Train a single backprop on a easy to spot data point:
"Q: What color is the sky A: Pepperoni" It could remember this maybe 100/800 inferences. The interesting thing is what happens if you continued completely unrelated training, it would decrease to 50/800 then 10/800 then 0/800 (forgets) that'...

[vintermann]: More clear title, given how people talk about AI: "Capabilities can be hidden in AI model weights by encryption". It's not about AI agents being able to hide what they can do.

[ceroxylon]: This has always been my worry with open source models... give them away for free, but with a sleeper agent built in that some arbitrary string can activate. Local deployments will still have web search connectors the majority of the time.

[daemonologist]: This kind of possibility was the subject of some discussion on r/localllama the other day:  https://www.reddit.com/r/LocalLLaMA/comments/1wxvt41/my_qwen...  (in that case it seems likely to just be an overfit to the training environment, imo)

[lifeisloving]: Well OpenAIs ID verification company literally checks to see if you're a politically significant person so you can be spied on. I really dont think its the LLMs we have to worry about y'all.

items.content:
马斯克回应存储芯片股遭抛售：中国掌握制造技术后，扩产能力往往超过世界其他地区总和

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，马斯克在回应存储芯片股遭抛售的讨论时表示，中国一旦掌握某种产品的制造技术，其扩大生产规模的能力往往超过世界其他地区的总和，锂电池和太阳能领域已出现过这种情况。

他表示，内存行业或许有所不同，但大约三年前，内存仍是低利润率的大宗商品。LP5 和 LP6 遵循通用标准，中国似乎正在迅速攻克相关技术。不过，新一代 HBM 架构，以及在逻辑电路下方设置 SRAM 层、在上方三维堆叠内存并同时解决逻辑电路散热等技术，将更难攻克。

马斯克同时称，SpaceX 是罕见的反例，其送入轨道的载荷总质量比世界其他地区总和高出约一个数量级。但在 SpaceX 以外的入轨载荷总质量中，中国已占据大多数。

此前报道，长鑫科技宣布在新一代 DRAM 的 4F² 架构研发上取得关键进展，预计年底推出融合该架构、混合键合等技术的 DDR5 RDIMM 服务器内存产品。相较主流 6F² 架构，4F² 理论上可使单元面积缩减约三分之一，在相同晶圆面积和制程节点下提升约 50% 的存储密度，令市场对未来竞争及供应扩张的担忧升温。

items.title: Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
items.content:
Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg said its newest models are a step toward “personal superintelligence.”
Meta has unveiled two new artificial intelligence models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, which it called its most capable models to date and a step toward “personal superintelligence.”
Meta on Monday said the models introduce two capabilities Meta calls Active Memory and Active Focus. The first carries relevant information across conversations, and the second helps the agent sustain work on difficult tasks.
Independent evaluation platform Artificial Analysis scored Wonder Full at 56 on its Intelligence Index and the standard Wonder at 52, both at maximum reasoning effort.
That puts Full above Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra, which each scored 53, but below Claude Opus 5.5’s 58.
Bindu Reddy, CEO of Abacus.AI, which conducts its own model evaluations, challenged the performance claims, writing on X that Muse Wonder was “nowhere near Fable or Astra level” and said detailed benchmark results would follow.
Meta’s new models are its most expensive to date, with the standard Wonder model charging $4 per million input tokens, matching Claude Opus 5.5 but undercutting GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, which charge $10 and $50 respectively.
Wonder Full is available only to people who subscribe to Muse Code’s $50 a month “power usage” or $200 a month “maximum usage” tiers.

items.content:

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，存储芯片板块持续遭到抛售，据 BIT(bit.com) 行情数据，美光周一收跌 3.88%，闪迪跌 5.97%，两只股票在最近七个交易日中均有六日下跌。美光较 6 月高点的跌幅已接近 20%，濒临技术性熊市。

韩国市场方面，今日 SK 海力士大跌 9%，三星电子跌幅扩大至 7%。本轮调整主要受到回购托底力量退出，以及中国竞争对手技术突破等冲击。

存储行业近期基本面仍然强劲，但投资者已开始提前定价盈利见顶风险，担忧 2027 至 2028 年中国存储产能扩张与韩国新晶圆厂同步投产，可能扭转供需格局。高盛交易台认为，峰值盈利担忧正在压制估值，近期也缺乏足够催化剂推动进一步重估。

X全家桶正式上线：Grok与Cursor订阅合并，30美元打包原价90美元权益

动察 Beating AI 快讯，此前多次曝光的 X Subscription 终于正式上线。新方案将 X Premium、Grok、Grok Bot 和 Cursor 整合为一项订阅，提供每月 8、30、100、200 美元四档付费套餐，另设免费档。

最值得关注的是每月 30 美元的 Premium 档。按照官方说法，该套餐涵盖此前合计每月 90 美元的 X Premium+、SuperGrok 和 Cursor Pro 权益，还可使用 Grok Bot、Cursor 云端 Agent 和代码审查等功能。更高两档主要增加使用额度，分别达到 8 美元基础档的 15 倍和 50 倍。

不过，新套餐的计费方式与过去不同。Grok、Grok Bot 和 Cursor 共用一套每周刷新的额度，主要覆盖 Grok 自家模型。官方称，新套餐提供的 Grok 模型编程额度，至少是对应旧 Cursor 套餐的两倍。但在 Cursor 中调用 Claude、GPT 等第三方模型，仍需按 API 价格额外付费。

现有 X Premium、SuperGrok 和 Cursor 会员可以保留原套餐，也可以选择迁移。符合条件的旧订阅将按剩余时间退款，但账号合并后无法撤销，也不能恢复原有方案。

items.title: ⚡️贝莱德六年来首次转向超配短期美债，并下调美股评级
items.content:
⚡️贝莱德六年来首次转向超配短期美债，并下调美股评级

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 13 日，贝莱德旗下投资研究所调整美国资产配置，将短期美国国债评级上调至超配，长期美债由低配上调至中性，结束近六年来对美债的低配立场。同时，该机构将美股评级由超配下调至中性，将美国机构抵押贷款支持证券（MBS）评级降至中性，并削减对日本政府债券的低配仓位。

贝莱德自 2020 年 10 月起低配美国国债，当时 10 年期美债收益率接近 0.9%，如今已升至 5.2% 以上。该机构认为，收益率已升至具有吸引力的水平，希望锁定部分较高收益，市场对美联储进一步收紧货币政策的预期也可能过度。

目前，利率互换市场反映，交易员预计未来 12 个月至少会有三次、每次 25 个基点的加息。贝莱德指出，未来 12 个月美债收益率需再上升 75 个基点，才会完全抵消债券赚取的收益。

美股方面，贝莱德将下调评级归因于「人工智能建设带来的潜在波动性」。随着 AI 建设推动资本开支及融资需求增加，高利率使企业之间的回报差异更加突出，投资者需要判断企业能否创造高于资本成本的回报。该机构强调：「我们是在管理近期风险，而非改变我们的核心信念。」贝莱德仍看好 AI 相关企业及上市基础设施，准备在可见度改善、出现有吸引力的入场点时再度增加风险敞口。
