items.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93M is traced, $10M frozen
items.content:
Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93M is traced, $10M frozen
Ledger said every confirmed case involves devices sold by the Southeast Asian reseller, but critics say the hardware-wallet maker must answer for an authorized sales channel.
- Blockchain analytics firms estimate that attackers stole as much as $94.5 million from hundreds of wallets linked to Ledger devices sold by authorized reseller CryptoBilis, though Ledger has not confirmed the total.
- Ledger found an unauthorized hardware implant in at least one affected device, while Tether froze $10 million in USDT tied to the theft and investigators continued tracing the funds.
- Ledger advised CryptoBilis customers not to set up unused devices and urged those already using one to transfer their assets to a new device with a newly generated recovery phrase.
As much as $93.2 million in crypto was siphoned from wallets linked to the Ledger devices sold by the reseller CryptoBilis, according to several blockchain analytical and intelligence firms.
Tether has frozen $10 million in USDT tied to the theft, while Ledger said Sunday that the investigations into the theft, first reported three days ago, are still underway.
Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in at least one affected device. The company did not say whether the stolen wallet was compromised in the same way or how the devices were tampered with.
Blockchain analysis and intelligence company Bitquery said it traced $93.2 million linked to the Ledger exploit. It said the hackers stole mostly USDT and TRON tokens from 315 wallets across six blockchains. Security research platform YFarmX reported a higher number, saying the attackers siphoned off $94.5 million from 521 addresses across seven blockchains. Both estimates are based on public blockchain data, not a confirmed Ledger loss total.
Ledger did not immediately respond to a CoinDesk request for confirmation of the amount stolen and whether it is considering a reimbursement plan for those affected by the exploit.
The Tether freeze, confirmed by Bitquery, is important because stablecoin issuers can block tokens linked to crime, unlike bitcoin or ether. Bitquery also said roughly $81 million could still be traced onchain as of Oct. 11, while some funds had moved through Tornado Cash and Zcash.
Tether did not immediately respond to a CoinDesk request for comment on the freeze.
Ledger’s effort to characterize the incident as confined to CryptoBilis has drawn pushback because the reseller was listed as authorized on Ledger’s website. “It’s not a CryptoBilis incident, it’s a Ledger incident,” X user MyCryptoParadise wrote. “At least take ownership of this mess.”
The episode is distinct from an April phishing campaign involving a fake Ledger Live app on Apple’s App Store, which drained at least $9.5 million after users entered their recovery phrases. This time, the attacker appears to have obtained the keys needed to directly empty hundreds of wallets.
Ledger advised CryptoBilis customers not to set up unused devices. Those who have already used one should move assets to a new device with a newly generated recovery phrase, it said.

items.title: Thailand wants a piece of the $120 billion Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF market, but on its own terms
items.content:
Quick Take
- Thailand has finalized rules allowing domestic Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs to trade on its stock exchange from a new regulatory framework.
- Restrictions on retail access to foreign crypto ETFs could direct more investor capital toward domestic fund managers.
- The rules take effect Oct. 16, but no ETF has been approved or given a trading date.
Thailand has finalized rules allowing domestic Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs while restricting retail access to competing overseas investment products.
The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) announced on Oct. 8 that 11 regulatory notifications will take effect on Oct. 16, establishing a framework for cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds listed exclusively on the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
Thailand's move follows the success of spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs in the United States, which have attracted about $70.37 billion in combined cumulative net inflows since their launches.
According to SoSoValue data, the funds held about $121 billion in combined net assets as of Oct. 12, illustrating the scale of the market Thailand seeks to enter.
Thailand prioritizes domestic ETFs over foreign competitors
Under the new framework, Thailand will initially prohibit the issuance and offering of investment products linked to foreign crypto ETFs, including depositary receipts that would otherwise allow local investors to gain exposure to overseas funds through domestic securities markets.
Securities companies will also be restricted from facilitating investments in foreign crypto ETFs for clients who do not qualify as institutional or ultra-high-net-worth investors.
The restrictions are targeted rather than a comprehensive prohibition on overseas crypto investments. They primarily affect specified investment products and brokerage services available to ordinary investors.
The SEC said the measures aim to support the development of Thailand's domestic crypto ETF ecosystem and strengthen local financial institutions' capabilities.
The regulator has also expanded the investment options available to existing asset managers.
Previously, Thai mutual funds and private funds could invest in foreign crypto ETFs but not domestic equivalents. Under the revised rules, they may invest in Thai-listed crypto ETFs, subject to existing investment limits.
Together, these changes could establish an additional source of demand for domestic products while reducing the availability of some foreign alternatives.
The framework may also create opportunities for Thai asset managers, custodians and other licensed digital asset businesses to participate in the emerging market.
However, the restrictions could leave retail investors with fewer competing products, making the fees, liquidity and tracking performance of domestically listed funds particularly important once trading begins.
Thailand imposes margin restrictions and investor safeguards
Beyond restrictions on foreign products, Thailand's framework sets operating requirements to limit risk and ensure crypto ETFs function within the country's existing securities market.
Initially, only Bitcoin and Ethereum will qualify as underlying assets, with each ETF required to passively track a single cryptocurrency.
Funds must maintain average net exposure of at least 80% of their net asset value to the chosen asset over each accounting year.
Asset managers must demonstrate adequate personnel, operational systems and service-provider arrangements before establishing a fund. Digital assets held by the ETFs must also be safeguarded by custodians regulated by Thailand's SEC.
Investor protections extend to trading activities.
Securities companies will be prohibited from providing margin loans for crypto ETF purchases, preventing investors from using that form of broker financing to increase their exposure.
Before trading, investors must receive education about the products' characteristics and risks and formally acknowledge their understanding.
Brokers must also emphasize portfolio diversification and investment decisions consistent with individual risk tolerance.
The regulator has separately permitted licensed digital asset fund managers to undertake outsourced investment management functions, while qualified digital asset businesses may apply to serve as mutual fund supervisors.
The final regulations follow consultations conducted between April and September, during which the SEC said most respondents supported the proposals.
The next milestone is Oct. 16, when the regulatory framework becomes effective. The SEC has not yet approved a Bitcoin or Ethereum ETF or announced when either product will begin trading on Thailand's stock exchange.

items.title: Australia proposes leverage caps for crypto-settled derivatives
items.content:
Australia proposes leverage caps for crypto-settled derivatives
ASIC’s proposal would extend leverage limits and protections against negative balances to certain derivatives settled in digital assets.
Australia’s securities regulator wants to extend leverage limits and other retail investor safeguards to certain trading contracts settled in crypto.
On Monday, the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) proposed expanding the rules for contracts for difference (CFDs), which let traders bet on price movements without owning the underlying asset.
The rules generally cover contracts settled in cash or by offsetting obligations between the parties. ASIC wants to add contracts settled by transferring digital assets, including those tracking non-crypto assets, provided they meet the other criteria for a CFD.
ASIC said that certain crypto futures and options with fixed expiration dates would remain outside the CFD rules.
Australia’s existing framework, introduced in 2021, caps leverage and requires providers to close positions when account funds fall below specified levels. Negative balance protection also limits losses to the funds in a client’s CFD trading account.
The regulator is seeking feedback on the proposed extension and amendments until Nov. 9.
Separately, Australia passed legislation in April to bring crypto exchanges and tokenized custody platforms under its financial services licensing framework, with the new regime taking effect on April 9, 2027.
ASIC also required crypto firms relying on temporary enforcement relief under existing financial services law to apply for licenses by Sept. 30 or seek changes to their existing licenses.

items.title: Bitcoin Ranges Near $83K as Traders Look to US Inflation Data
items.content:
In brief
- Bitcoin is trading near $83,330, up 0.6% on the day but down around 3% on the week.
- Analysts say rising Treasury yields and a stronger dollar are weighing on Bitcoin, even as bets on an October Fed rate hike fade.
- U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $21.13 million on Friday after two days of heavy outflows.
Bitcoin inched higher on Monday, trading at $83,327, up 0.6% over the past 24 hours, according to CoinGecko data. The asset is still down 2.9% over the past week.
The cryptocurrency has "struggled against an increasingly challenging macroeconomic backdrop," Daniela Hathorn, senior market analyst at Capital.com, told Decrypt.
"Rising energy prices have reignited inflation concerns, pushing US Treasury yields higher and strengthening the dollar as investors reassess the Federal Reserve's interest-rate trajectory," she said. "Despite its reputation as a potential alternative store of value, recent price action suggests investors continue to treat Bitcoin predominantly as a risk asset rather than a reliable geopolitical hedge."
Traders see a 19.4% chance of a 25-basis-point hike at the Fed's October 28 meeting, down from 22.1% a week ago and 42.5% a month ago, according to CME FedWatch. Prediction markets Polymarket and Myriad both put the odds of a hike at 17% (Disclaimer: Myriad is a prediction market developed by Decrypt's parent company Dastan).
A shift in rate expectations should in principle support Bitcoin, Bitfire's Jade Shi said, but elevated long-term Treasury yields mean broader financial conditions have not fully eased. That helps explain why Bitcoin has held up without decisively clearing resistance, she said.
Yields and ETF flows
The 10-year Treasury yield stands at 5.24% and the 30-year yield at 5.60%, according to CNBC, having hit 52-week highs of 5.37% and 5.73% last week. Yields reached their highest levels in more than two decades, CoinShares head of research James Butterfill wrote on Thursday.
Butterfill argued that if those yields increasingly reflect concerns about U.S. public finances rather than stronger growth, Bitcoin begins to look "less like a conventional risk asset and more like an alternative to government-issued money."
Digital asset fund flows have lost momentum after $11.1 billion of inflows since mid-July, according to CoinShares.
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $21.13 million in net inflows on Friday, after outflows of $487.07 million on Wednesday and $244.13 million on Thursday, according to SoSoValue.
Technically, Bitcoin has been trading mainly between about $80,300 and $87,100, according to Bitfire. A break above $85,600 on stronger volume could open the way toward $87,395, while a drop below $82,000 would raise the risk of a move toward $79,000.
"The recent easing of Middle East tensions has provided some breathing room, but the sustainability of the rebound will depend on whether the improvement in sentiment translates into a more meaningful retreat in bond yields and the dollar," Hathorn said. "Attention now turns towards upcoming US inflation data, which could prove decisive in shaping expectations for the Fed's next move."

items.content:
大摩高管：2030年代币化RWA市场规模将达3万亿至10万亿美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，摩根士丹利数字资产战略主管 Amy Oldenburg 表示，到 2030 年，代币化现实世界资产（RWA）市场规模将达到 3 万亿至 10 万亿美元，这一预测「毫无疑问」。

她指出，行业内的增长动能正在相互推动，当前机构投资者对相关领域的关注和参与热情持续升温，机构市场已出现明显的 FOMO（错失恐惧）情绪。

此前摩根士丹利预计，将于 2027 年第一季度开始在其另类交易系统（ATS）上支持代币化股票交易，较此前公布的 2026 年下半年计划有所推迟。

items.title: 法国议员推动加密资产退出税，未申报自托管钱包最高罚款1万欧元
items.content:
法国议员推动加密资产退出税，未申报自托管钱包最高罚款1万欧元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，法国国民议会财政委员会上周通过多项加密资产税收修正案，拟自 2027 年起将加密资产纳入退出税范围，并对未申报的大额自托管钱包处以最高 1 万欧元罚款。

根据提案，过去 10 年中至少有 6 年居住在法国、离境时持有股票及其他证券总价值超过 80 万欧元的纳税人，目前须就未实现收益缴纳退出税。新修正案拟将比特币等加密资产纳入同一门槛，涵盖海外平台及个人自托管钱包中的资产。相关税率尚未明确，部分迁往欧盟及特定国家的纳税人可递延缴税，若在规定的 2 至 5 年期限内继续持有资产，税款可被取消。

此外，议员还提议，年末自托管钱包资产合计价值达到 10 万欧元或以上的纳税人须主动申报，否则最高罚款 1 万欧元。目前，法国仅要求申报境外加密账户。其他获委员会支持的措施还包括自 2027 年起对加密资产兑换稳定币征税、允许加密资产亏损在未来 10 年内抵扣收益，以及将未按税务机关要求提交文件的罚款从 1 万欧元提高至每次 5 万欧元。

上述措施目前仍未正式生效。由于国民议会财政委员会否决了 2027 年预算案的收入部分，相关修正案须在全体议会重新提出并表决。法国议员预计于 10 月 20 日再次表决预算收入部分，并于 11 月 17 日就整份预算案进行表决。

items.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev sold his Class A stock to zero… again
items.content:
Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev sold his Class A stock to zero… again
Robinhood CEO Vladimir Tenev has sold every share of his Class A stock to zero — the sixth time this year. However, he doesn’t receive regular awards of new Class A stock as executive compensation.
How’s this possible?
A post from October 8, which earned over 200,000 views, framed his latest sell-out as a founder bailing on a $96 billion company. However, Community Notes contributors noted that’s the same zero he’s produced five times already in 2026.
The relevant filing, made with the SEC on October 7, covers his sale dated October 5. When Tenev sold 375,000 Class A shares for roughly $42.6 million, his directly held Class A position after that sale correctly read zero.
Robinhood’s Class A and B
A footnote on that filing explains that Tenev “sold 375,000 shares of his Class B common stock, resulting in an automatic conversion of the shares into Class A common stock upon execution of the sale” under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted September 5, 2025.
In other words, Robinhood converts Tenev’s Class B shares, with 10 votes each, into single-vote Class A shares the moment they’re sold.
Although it’s true that Tenev has zero Class A shares remaining after his sale, he still owns 47,419,572 Class B shares, plus a small Class A position of 6,907 shares in a living trust that aren’t considered directly held.
At the October 9 market close near $109 per share, that stake is worth roughly $5.2 billion and enjoys more than 474 million votes.
Robinhood’s own 10-K, filed with the SEC, describes founders’ voting control plainly.
Founders and “founder affiliates” hold 100% of the outstanding Class B super-voting common stock, giving Tenev and co-founder Baiju Bhatt control of more than half the voting power of Robinhood.
Read more: Nvidia director Mark Stevens sold a record $411M of stock
Tenev sold to ‘zero’ six times in 2026
Each sale by Tenev to “zero” directly held shares of Class A followed the same Class B conversion-and-sell structure, under the same pre-disclosed plan.
Each liquidation left his directly held Class A line at zero while retaining his multi-billion dollar position in the company.
- By January 5, Tenev had sold 375,000 Class B shares that became 375,000 Class A shares. The Class A shares sold for about $45.6 million. Class B holdings after: 49,044,572.
- By April 6, Tenev had sold 375,000 Class B shares that became 375,000 Class A shares. The Class A shares sold for about $26.2 million. Class B holdings after: 48,669,572.
- By July 6, Tenev had sold 375,000 Class B shares that became 375,000 Class A shares. The Class A shares sold for about $43.6 million. Class B holdings after: 48,294,572.
- By September 21, Tenev had sold 259,166 Class B shares that became 259,166 Class A shares. The Class A shares sold for about $32.5 million. Class B holdings after: 48,035,406.
- By September 22, Tenev had sold 240,834 Class B shares that became 240,834 Class A shares. The Class A shares sold for about $30.2 million. Class B after: 47,794,572.
- By October 5, Tenev had sold another 375,000 Class B shares that became 375,000 Class A shares. The Class A shares sold for about $42.6 million. Class B holdings after: 47,419,572.
Across 2026, Tenev has sold approximately 2 million Class B shares via Class A conversions for roughly $220 million — about 4% of his Class B stake.
The sales stripped roughly 20 million votes from his direct holdings, yet his majority voting control alongside his co-founder remains controlling.

items.content:
比特币守住8.25万美元关键支撑，本周美国CPI、PPI数据将引发市场波动

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，比特币周线收盘守住 82,500 美元关键支撑位，暂时避免重新跌入此前 6 万至 8 万美元的长期震荡区间。BTC 周日收于约 83,700 美元，周跌幅约 3.2%。交易员正密切关注本周美国通胀数据，以判断后续市场走势。

美国 9 月 CPI 和 PPI 数据将分别于周三、周四公布。市场预计，CPI 同比涨幅将从上月的 3.4% 升至 3.7%，PPI 月环比涨幅将从上月的 0.2% 升至 0.3%。若通胀低于预期，可能缓解市场对美联储进一步加息的担忧，为比特币、股票及黄金等风险资产提供支撑；若通胀超预期，则可能加大市场压力。

利率方面，CME FedWatch 数据显示，市场预计美联储 10 月 28 日加息 25 个基点的概率为 18.8%，12 月加息 25 个基点的概率为 70.6%。与此同时，美国 10 年期和 30 年期国债收益率分别报 5.24% 和 5.60%。

此外，WTI 原油周一回升至每桶 91.50 美元附近，较日内低点上涨约 2%。交易员认为，若比特币能够持续守住 82,500 美元支撑位，后续或有望延续反弹；若失守该水平，则可能重新面临下探压力。

items.title: 阿里QwenGyre将2.4T模型强化学习耗时缩短44%
items.content:
阿里QwenGyre将2.4T模型强化学习耗时缩短44%

动察 Beating AI 快讯，阿里巴巴千问团队提出 QwenGyre，这是一套专门面向超长任务的 AI Agent 强化学习框架。

随着 Agent 开始承担完整的软件工程任务，一次执行可能持续数小时，涉及数百轮模型调用和工具操作。模型需要从这些任务的实际结果中学习，但传统训练系统容易陷入漫长等待和重复计算。

首先是 GPU 利用率问题。传统同步训练必须等一批 Agent 全部完成任务，才能集中更新模型。不同任务耗时相差很大，先结束的任务会让部分 GPU 长时间闲置。异步训练虽然将任务执行和模型训练分开，却固定了两者的 GPU 配额，难以灵活调配。

QwenGyre 允许 GPU 根据任务进度动态切换用途。随着任务陆续结束，系统将部分 GPU 转入模型训练，剩余 GPU 继续支持尚未完成的 Agent。整个过程无需中断任务，工作区和工具状态也能保留。新加入的 GPU 还可以直接参与当前批次的训练。

另一个问题是训练数据冗余。Agent 反复重试、压缩历史记录或调用子 Agent，会留下大量相互重叠的执行路径。QwenGyre 记录每次模型调用的真实输入和输出，将不同路径整理成共享历史的轨迹树。训练时只选取有限的路径，同一段模型输出不重复计算。即使任务超时，已经完成且能够检验的部分成果仍可用于训练。

团队在 Qwen3.8-2.4T 上进行了验证，单次任务累计处理约 70 万 Token。相同 GPU 预算下，完成 48 步强化学习，QwenGyre 耗时 75.42 小时，传统异步方案需要 134.55 小时，训练时间缩短约 44%。训练后，模型在代码仓库生成测试 NL2RepoBench 上的通过率从 52.48% 提升至 58.54%。论文同时显示，QwenGyre 与传统训练方案取得的训练分数接近。

比特币徘徊于8.3万美元上方，美元走强、美债收益率上升

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，受美元走强及美债收益率上升影响，市场本周开局谨慎。比特币交投于 83,000 美元上方，黄金徘徊于每盎司 4,180 美元附近，二者均下跌约 0.5%。科技股期货小幅走低，WTI 原油升至每桶 92 美元上方，美元指数（DXY）则维持在 102.4 上方。

本周三公布的美国通胀数据将成为市场关注焦点。市场预计，美国核心 CPI 同比增速为 2.5%，整体 CPI 同比增速为 3.7%，若符合预期，将较上月重新加速，可能进一步影响市场对美联储货币政策的判断。

此外，据 The Information 报道，已从比特币挖矿转向 AI 基础设施业务的 IREN 与人工智能公司 Anthropic 达成多年期云服务协议。消息公布后，IREN 美股盘前上涨约 4%。

items.title: QGIS bans AI assisted contributions
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[robertclaus]: At Plotly we are dealing with similar issues. We're doing our best to keep up, but it's genuinely hard not to just cut our losses on passer-by community contributions. 3 page issue writeups nobody has proofread, nobody but a bot to follow up with when we try, huge volume of plausible but weak PRs eating up reviewer time. All while we have core work we really want to be focused on rather than merging another bug fix we don't expect anyone but this bot has really run into.

[mootothemax]: There’s something about geospatial work that seems to break LLMs. I’ve experienced it a lot with latest versions of both Fable and Opus, and it’s the classic nightmare of confidently-spoken-but-wrong. Yesterday, I had a relatively trivial bit of work in play using distance-weighting to measure stuff, and Claude did really well / but right at the end, despite having a success metric and lots of great results matching it, Claude insisted my maths was wrong and needed changing. When i asked...

[jcolot]: Part of this is an alignment problem, but on the human side: the bottleneck is no longer writing code but staying aligned with it, knowing what it does and whether it does what you meant. In my own work, that’s now most of the job, even for code I asked for. For maintainers reviewing large PRs from strangers, it's certainly much worse. A ban is bit harsh, but I understand why they’re rationing their attention.

[throwaway2037]: More LLM allergies. Look at this PR:  https://github.com/qgis/QGIS/pull/67731/files  The code change is so simple that Claude  today  could easily write this code.  How will they know if an LLM wrote the code?  They won't.  And this policy will age like milk: Each passing month, coding LLMs are improving.  It will become more difficult to "detect" an LLM-authored submission. The best LLM policy that I have seen for an open source project is Li...

[leothetechguy]: Why is everybody all the time in favour of AI on HN? This is objectively a good change because it will improve the quality of the code in the long term.
items.author: bwnkl
items.ai_reason: A widely used open-source project (QGIS) formally banning AI-assisted contributions is a meaningful signal about AI's disruptive effect on maintainer workflows, and the HN thread (304 points, 324 comments) is high-signal, with maintainers from other projects (e.g. Plotly) confirming similar review-burden problems. It is a notable developer-community governance decision rather than a technical or market-shaping event, and enforcement is limited to one project, so it lands in the 'interesting, not urgent' band, slightly elevated by the quality and breadth of the discussion.
items.ai_summary: The QGIS project moved to ban AI-assisted contributions to its enhancement proposals, sparking a broad discussion among open-source maintainers about the rising review burden from plausible-but-low-quality AI-generated patches.

Foresight News 消息，据 Euronews 报道，法国国民议会财政委员会于上周五以 31 票对 3 票否决了政府 2027 年预算法案中的收入部分，此前委员会通过的加密资产退出税、稳定币兑换征税等修正案因此均不再保留，需从周二起重新提交。国民议会将于 10 月 20 日再次表决收入部分，并于 11 月 17 日表决整部法案。此外，委员会此前还通过一项提案，要求纳税人申报年末总价值约 11.2 万美元（10 万欧元）以上的自托管钱包，否则最高罚款约 1.12 万美元（1 万欧元）。Foresight News 此前消息，法国国民议会财政委员会通过多项加密税收修正案，拟自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起将加密资产兑换为稳定币视为应税事件，并将退出税扩大至加密资产。

Foresight News 消息，金融稳定委员会（FSB）发布报告称，截至 2026 年年中，稳定币总市值约 3000 亿美元，与一年前基本持平，其中 99% 锚定美元。报告指出，全球稳定币及各国监管框架尚未经历严重压力和破产情景的考验，各国监管如何衔接仍不明确，部分发行方选择在监管宽松的司法辖区运营。FSB 建议加强跨境风险监测与信息共享，并收集应对稳定币危机的预案做法。报告认为，多发行方结构风险较高，关联发行方共同发行同一稳定币但储备分开持有，危机时赎回需求可能集中于单一主体，而储备难以跨境调配，发行方破产时适用哪国破产规则也可能不明确。此外，稳定币全天候交易，而储备资产市场有固定交易时间，挤兑时稳定币可能脱锚，并将冲击传导至传统金融体系。

items.title: BTC price support holds ahead of US CPI data: Three things Bitcoin traders need to know this week
items.content:
BTC price support holds ahead of US CPI data: Three things Bitcoin traders need to know this week
Bitcoin traders braced for inflation-based volatility after BTC price action preserved key weekly support around $82,500.
Bitcoin (BTC) starts the third week of October by defending support at $82,500 ahead of key US inflation data.
Key points:
- US CPI print on Wednesday and PPI data on Thursday provides the week’s major risk-asset volatility catalyst, with markets seeing CPI at 3.7% year-on-year.
- Oil prices react to the US plan to buy Russian diesel, but WTI crude heads higher after dropping below $90 per barrel on Monday.
- Bitcoin seals a weekly close above key support at $82,500, avoiding a drop into its previous 2026 macro range between $60,000 and $80,000.
Markets see September inflation creeping higher
US inflation data is in traders’ crosshairs this week ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee’s Oct. 28 meeting on interest-rate policy.
The September prints of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) will be released on Wednesday and Thursday, respectively.
In August, CPI broadly conformed to expectations at 3.4% year-on-year, with markets now seeing an uptick to 3.7% this month on the back of ongoing military action in the Middle East and associated fuel-price surges. PPI is expected at 0.3% month-on-month versus 0.2% in August.
US CPI 12-month % change by category. Source: Bureau of Labor Statistics
Crypto, stocks and gold traditionally benefit from lower-than-expected inflation readings as these reduce the odds of the Fed tightening policy, allowing for capital inflows to strengthen. Speaking to Reuters about current gold prices and US bond yields, Tim Waterer, chief market analyst at KCM Trade, drew attention to the impact of a surprise move to the downside for CPI and PPI readings in particular.
“In the short term, a cooler-than-expected US inflation reading would be the clearest near-term catalyst, as it would reduce the odds of further Fed tightening and ease pressure on real yield,” he said.
CME FedWatch shows that markets see just an 18.8% chance of a rate hike on Oct. 28 from the current 3.75-4.00% range. The following meeting, in December, is attracting 70.6% odds of the Fed hiking by 25 basis points to 4.00-4.25%.
Fed target-rate probabilities (screenshot). Source: CME Group
Fed chair Kevin Warsh is due to hold a discussion with Kristalina Georgieva, managing director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), at an event in Bangkok, Thailand on Friday.
Oil briefly cools on US-Russia diesel announcement
US bond yields have come off 24-year highs seen last week, with the 10-year and 30-year yields at 5.24% and 5.60%, respectively, on Monday.
US 10-year bond yield one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Stocks futures were green to start the week, with the S&P 500 index up 0.25% and around 30 points off new all-time highs.
S&P 500 futures one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
An announcement by US President Donald Trump over a deal to buy 300,000 tons of diesel from Russia appeared to have only a modest knock-on effect on oil prices, with the plan facing growing bipartisan backlash. Trump also announced an “energy ceasefire” between Russia and Ukraine.
“Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed,” he wrote on Sunday in a post on Truth Social. Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he was unaware of the energy ceasefire.
WTI crude traded around $91.50 per barrel on Monday, up 2% from the day’s low of $89.60. Data from motorist group AAA put the average price of diesel at $6.26 per gallon versus all-time highs of $6.52 seen on Sept. 22.
CFDs on WTI crude oil one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
PVM analyst Tamas Varga told Reuters Russia’s reduced output capacity made the impact of the deal “questionable.”
“However, Moscow has partially lifted its ban on diesel exports, allowing 500,000 tonnes (around 3.7 million barrels) to be released onto the international market, equivalent to roughly one day of US consumption and around 13% of global demand,” he noted.
Bitcoin avoids support breakdown at weekly close
At around $83,700 on Bitstamp, Sunday’s weekly candle close cemented a 3.2% weekly decline for BTC/USD.
Related: Here’s what happened in crypto today
BTC/USD one-week chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
At the same time, the pair preserved a key support level at $82,500 on weekly time frames, thus avoiding a return to its previous long-term range between $60,000 and $80,000. As Cointelegraph reported, $82,500 remains on traders’ radar as a crucial line in the sand for Bitcoin bulls.
Last week, trader and analyst Rekt Capital wrote that a weekly close above $82,500 would mark a “successful” support retest. This in turn could see investors continue to reaccumulate BTC at current levels, opening up the path higher in a manner similar to Bitcoin’s recovery from its 2022 bear market.
BTC/USD one-week chart. Source: Rekt Capital on X.com
In light of Bitcoin’s multiple support retests after its initial breakout in July, trader and analyst Aksel Kibar drew comparisons between crypto and stock markets. Since May, the S&P 500 has seen multiple retests at key levels, initially at 7,300 points and then at 7,600 points.
S&P 500 one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Bitcoin could be experiencing a “hard retest” of support in a similar manner, with the implication that BTC/USD should shift higher if those retests continued to be successful, Kibar wrote in an X post on Sunday.
BTC/USD one-day chart. Source: Aksel Kibar on X.com

items.title: RSI-Anything让AI边做边改进，不换编程模型也能多修Bug
items.content:
RSI-Anything让AI边做边改进，不换编程模型也能多修Bug

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 研究机构 PhAI Labs 发布 RSI-Anything，尝试让 AI Agent 从实际任务中不断积累经验，改进自己的做事方法。这套框架可以用于修复代码、操作电脑和科学研究。

它的做法是给 Agent 配一个「世界模型」，专门预测不同操作可能产生什么结果。Agent 先提出几种方案，世界模型判断哪种更可能成功，再挑选方案实际执行。系统随后对照预测和真实结果，改进 Agent 的操作策略。如果预测不准，也会更新世界模型。新版本通过测试后才能保留，用于下一轮任务。

以修 Bug 为例，写代码的模型一次生成四个修改方案。RSI-Anything 先预测哪种最可能通过测试，只选一个实际运行，再用测试结果改进后续判断。这样可以把有限的测试次数用在更有希望的方案上。

在 200 道 CodeContests 题目中，负责写代码的 ReasonFlux-Coder-7B 全程不变，测试次数也基本相同。采用传统静态验证器时，修复通过率为 26.3%。引入世界模型筛选后升至 29.2%，再通过实际反馈更新世界模型，达到 31.2%。

团队还把这套方法用于电脑操作和科学实验。在实验室规划测试中，一个 4B 模型连续更新五个版本，规划得分从 21.80% 升至 46.01%。

项目代码已经公开。目前不同任务仍使用各自的 Agent 和世界模型。论文也承认，执行策略与世界模型能否在同一任务中长期共同改进，还需要更多实验验证。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371379
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: A research-institution release (PhAI Labs) of an open-source framework, RSI-Anything, that pairs an agent with a learned 'world model' to predict and select which candidate action (e.g., one of four bug-fix patches) to actually execute, then updates both the policy and the world model from real feedback. The reported gains are real but incremental — pass rate on 200 CodeContests tasks rises from 26.3% to 31.2% with the coding model (ReasonFlux-Coder-7B) held fixed, and a 4B planner improves from 21.80% to 46.01% over five self-updated versions — and the paper itself concedes long-horizon co-improvement of policy and world model is unverified. Novel and useful for agent builders with public code, but not a frontier-capability or ecosystem-shaping event.
items.ai_summary: AI research group PhAI Labs open-sourced RSI-Anything, a framework where an agent uses a 'world model' to predict which candidate action is most likely to succeed, executes only the best one, and updates both policy and world model from real results — lifting CodeContests bug-fix pass rate from 26.3% to 31.2% without changing the underlying coding model.

items.title: 全球金融稳定委员会警告稳定币跨境风险，呼吁制定危机应对机制
items.content:
全球金融稳定委员会警告稳定币跨境风险，呼吁制定危机应对机制

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，金融稳定委员会（FSB）在最新报告中警告，全球稳定币尚未经历严重市场压力或破产情景的考验，各国监管框架推进速度不一，跨境协作仍处于早期阶段。FSB 呼吁加强跨境信息共享、风险监测，并提前制定稳定币发行方陷入困境或倒闭时的应对方案。

FSB 特别指出，多发行方结构可能加剧跨境风险：关联公司在不同司法管辖区发行同一种稳定币并分别持有储备资产，但用户可能向集团内任意发行方赎回。一旦赎回需求集中于某一发行方，储备资产却存放在其他地区，危机期间的资金调拨可能受阻，发行方破产时的债权归属及适用的破产法律也可能难以确定。

此外，稳定币全天候交易与底层储备资产市场交易时间不一致，可能导致赎回压力无法及时通过资产出售得到满足，进而引发脱锚。强制出售储备资产及银行存款被集中提取，还可能将冲击传导至传统金融市场。FSB 同时指出，加密交易的匿名性可能增加识别持有者所在地及适用监管辖区的难度。

数据显示，稳定币市场总市值已从 2025 年初的约 2060 亿美元升至约 3060 亿美元，其中大部分为美元稳定币。FSB 的相关建议不具法律约束力，但成员通常会承诺在本国落实相关标准。该报告发布之际，G20 财长和央行行长将于 10 月 15 日举行会议。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371378
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: The FSB is a top-tier global standard-setter and its report flags concrete, underappreciated structural risks in stablecoins (multi-issuer structures, reserve jurisdiction mismatches, 24/7 redemption versus trad-fi market hours) ahead of the G20 finance ministers' meeting on Oct 15. It is a substantive regulatory signal with a clear path to future rulemaking on a $306B market, but the recommendations are explicitly non-binding and no immediate market access or compliance change takes effect, keeping it below the 8+ tier.
items.ai_summary: The Financial Stability Board warned that stablecoins remain untested under severe stress and called for stronger cross-border information sharing, risk monitoring, and pre-planned crisis-resolution mechanisms for failing issuers, highlighting multi-issuer reserve fragmentation and 24/7 redemption risks ahead of the Oct 15 G20 finance ministers' meeting.

items.title: AI基建投资年均占美国GDP的3.6%，表外融资暗藏1.4万亿美元债务风险
items.content:
AI基建投资年均占美国GDP的3.6%，表外融资暗藏1.4万亿美元债务风险

动察 Beating AI 快讯，据布鲁金斯学会最新研究，2025 年至 2032 年，美国 AI 数据中心建设投资总额预计将达到 10.3 万亿美元，年均投资约占美国 GDP 的 3.63%，约为 19 世纪铁路建设高峰期的 1.6 倍、互联网及光纤建设热潮的 3 倍以上。

哥伦比亚大学商学院教授 Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh 指出，AI 基础设施投资规模空前，Meta、Microsoft 等科技巨头的资本开支已超过经营活动现金流，越来越多项目转向租赁、合资企业、特殊目的载体及私人信贷融资，部分债务因此未直接体现在科技公司的资产负债表中。

以 Meta 的 Hyperion 数据中心项目为例，约 300 亿美元的项目资产对应 270 亿美元债务，项目层面债务与资产比率达到 90%。Van Nieuwerburgh 估计，相关融资结构已发行约 1.4 万亿美元债务，其中约 7000 亿至 8000 亿美元由银行持有。

他警告，若 AI 需求、收入或项目进度不及预期，高杠杆项目可能面临股权价值归零甚至债权受损的风险，并通过银行、保险公司及私人信贷机构向金融体系传导。不过，他强调，目前尚不能据此认定 AI 已形成泡沫，现阶段也缺乏衡量相关风险在金融体系中分布情况的完整框架。

Van Nieuwerburgh 建议加强表外债务及或有负债披露，追踪项目资产所有权、债务承担方、租约与担保责任，以提高融资透明度。他认为，监管重点不应是阻止 AI 投资，而是识别潜在风险集中，避免 AI 投资热潮在下行周期中演变为系统性金融风险。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371376
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: This is a substantive research-based analysis rather than a market-moving event: Brookings estimates $10.3T of US AI data-center investment through 2032 (~3.63% of GDP annually), and Columbia's Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh quantifies ~$1.4T of largely off-balance-sheet debt financing, with project-level debt/assets ratios near 90% at Meta's Hyperion. The 1.4T figure and the bank/insurer/private-credit transmission channel give it more concrete analytical value than routine commentary, and it carries a clear macro-financial-stability angle relevant to risk asset pricing, but it is expert warning and framework-building rather than a confirmed new development or policy decision, so it stays in the interesting-but-not-urgent band.
items.ai_summary: Brookings and Columbia research estimates US AI data-center investment will reach $10.3T through 2032 (about 3.63% of GDP annually) while roughly $1.4T of project debt sits largely off tech companies' balance sheets, raising systemic risk concerns if AI demand, revenue or buildout schedules fall short.

items.content:
瑞银预计黄金明年9月升至5400美元，4000美元附近或成重要支撑

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，瑞银表示，尽管美元走强、美国实际利率上升给金价带来压力，且短期投机资金正在削减黄金期货和期权净多头头寸，但黄金 ETF 近期仍持续出现资金流入，显示中长期配置需求尚未退场。

该行预计，金价可能在每盎司 4000 美元附近获得支撑，并于 2026 年 12 月升至 4600 美元、2027 年 3 月升至 5000 美元、6 月升至 5200 美元，9 月达到 5400 美元。

瑞银认为，全球央行持续购金、中国需求保持强劲，以及印度节庆季可能带动实物黄金需求，将为金价提供支撑。与此同时，投资者对公共债务、财政风险及美元长期走势的担忧，也可能增强黄金的配置吸引力。不过，若美元和实际收益率继续走强，金价短期仍不排除进一步回落。

法国农业信贷银行则预计，金价将在 2026 年 12 月达到每盎司 5000 美元。两家机构均认为，央行储备多元化及市场对美联储政策受财政压力影响的担忧，可能成为黄金中长期上涨的驱动因素。

items.title: A Solana wallet tested a fake address with $10, then sent it $30,750
items.content:
Quick Take
- Bitquery counted 4,497,798 Solana wallets targeted over 11 months; this measures targeting rather than confirmed losses.
- In a November 2025 case, a $10 USDT test reached a lookalike before 30,749.80 USDT followed to the same fake address.
- A separate earlier cohort produced $940,106 in qualifying payments from 1,104 wallets under the study’s time and relationship filters.
Lookalike payment addresses targeted nearly 4.5 million Solana wallets over 11 months, according to blockchain-data firm Bitquery’s Oct. 9, 2026 findings. The findings show why a successful small test transfer can still precede a much larger payment to a scammer.
The technique, known as address poisoning, plants a misleading entry in a wallet’s payment history. A tiny incoming transfer puts the sender’s lookalike address near a legitimate payment. If the user later copies that address, they can send money to the wrong recipient.
A Solana test transfer can reach the wrong address
Bitquery describes a Nov. 17, 2025 case in which a wallet first paid $10 in USDT to its Gate.io deposit address. A lookalike sent dust 12 seconds later. The wallet then sent a second $10 test to the fake, followed by 30,749.80 USDT to that same address.
The implication is that a successful test confirms delivery to the selected address, but cannot establish who controls it. If the destination was copied incorrectly, repeating the payment repeats the mistake.
Receiving dust does not itself drain a wallet in this mechanism. The loss occurs when its owner subsequently authorizes a payment to the lookalike.
Bitquery counted 4,497,798 targeted wallets from Oct. 30, 2025, through Oct. 7, 2026. Its rule required a same-day payment of at least $1 in SOL, USDC or USDT, followed by dust or a fake stablecoin token from a different address matching at least three characters at each end of the payee.
The loss analysis used a smaller subset: approximately 3.0 million wallets poisoned through July 9, 2026. Of those, 1,104 made qualifying payments totaling $940,106. The wider targeting count does not mean 4.5 million wallets lost money.
The loss total is a floor. It counts payments of at least $1 within 90 days of the first dust. Beyond that window, a payment could qualify if more dust arrived that day. Wallets poisoned after July 9 and payments outside those rules were excluded. Bitquery also removed likely existing relationships, such as pairs with earlier payments or repayments; some genuine thefts may have been excluded.
Phantom’s address-poisoning guidance advises avoiding addresses copied from transaction history and verifying the address before sending.
Its receiving-payment instructions separate the checks: first confirm the exact recipient address and network, then look up the transaction status on an explorer. Phantom also says it cannot recover tokens sent to the wrong address.

items.title: 【Cardone Capital 拟通过房产再融资增持 500 枚 BTC】
items.content:
【Cardone Capital 拟通过房产再融资增持 500 枚 BTC】

Foresight News 消息，Cardone Capital 创始人 Grant Cardone 在《The David Lin Report》节目中与黄金倡导者及经济学家 Peter Schiff 辩论时表示，其房地产与比特币混合投资平台过去 18 个月吸引约 3000 名投资者，交易规模达 10 亿美元。首个项目以 7200 万美元收购房产，并配置 1700 万美元比特币，目前物业每月约 36 万美元的现金流持续用于买入比特币。该项目计划对房产进行再融资，用贷款再买入 500 枚比特币，届时持仓将增至约 700 枚。该基金收取 1% 管理费，设 8% 优先收益率，超出部分五五分成。Cardone 称，比特币约占其个人投资组合的 20%。Peter Schiff 则质疑该基金结构，认为投资者看好比特币完全可以直接购买，无需支付管理费并让出一半超额收益。Schiff 承认当年放弃在 100 美元以下买入比特币是错误决定，但仍认为比特币未能成为货币，本质上是「数字金字塔骗局」。他表示，未来 3 年黄金翻倍的可能性远高于比特币，并愿就此与 Cardone 打赌。

items.title: 美股三季度财报季即将开幕，「盈利增长是否足以匹配当前估值」成焦点
items.content:
美股三季度财报季即将开幕，「盈利增长是否足以匹配当前估值」成焦点

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，美股三季度财报季即将拉开帷幕。华尔街预计标普 500 成分股盈利同比增长约 29%–31%，其中约三分之二来自 Alphabet、亚马逊、Meta 等大型科技公司，半导体行业盈利增速更快。市场关注点已从「盈利是否增长」转向「盈利增长是否足以匹配当前估值」。投资者将重点寻找三个答案：AI 资本开支能否转化为实际收入和利润、AI 需求能否从科技向更多行业扩散、企业是否开始受到融资成本上升的冲击。

当前 10 年期美债收益率升至 5% 以上，高利率持续压制股票估值，企业需要更强盈利才能维持高位。大型银行将率先发布财报，提供信贷需求、消费者信用质量和利率路径的关键信号。市场最大风险在于盈利预期已充分计入价格，只有明显超预期才能推动估值继续扩张，否则高油价、高收益率和 AI 回报周期的不确定性可能引发更大波动。AI 增长故事能否兑现为 AI 盈利，将成为本轮财报季检验美股上涨逻辑的核心。

items.title: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
items.content:
SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
SWI Group said it would use the proceeds from an 800 million-euro ($894 million) fundraise to transform Genesis Digital Assets, acquired from the FTX bankruptcy, from a bitcoin miner to an AI-focused data center.
- SWI Group raised 800 million euros ($894 million) from institutional investors, valuing the company at 6.1 billion euros, to expand artificial intelligence and data center projects in Europe and the U.S.
- The company plans to repurpose the U.S. and Swedish facilities of Genesis Digital Assets, the former FTX-backed bitcoin miner it now controls as SWI Digital, for AI workloads while selling the unit’s sites in Kazakhstan.
- SWI’s strategy reflects a broader industry shift as bitcoin miners turn power connections and data center capacity into AI and high-performance computing revenue.
SWI Group (SWICH), which controls the former FTX-owned bitcoin 
The Euronext Amsterdam-listed company, an investment firm concentrating on digital infrastructure, said the capital increase values it at 6.1 billion euros. It announced the purchase of about 40% of Genesis Digital in June for $500 million, completing the acquisition in August with 70% of the voting rights and renaming the unit SWI Digital.
The company's strategy illustrates what has become a familiar trade for bitcoin-mining enterprises. Their most valuable asset is no longer their mining machines, but the power connections and the data-center sites that can be repurposed for AI customers. Bitcoin miners have signed more than $70 billion in AI and high-performance computing contracts, as they seek steadier revenue than bitcoin mining currently provides.
The pivot from cryptocurrency mining to processing AI computations puts it in the same race as listed miners such as TeraWulf 
SWI CEO Max-Hervé George told the Wall Street Journal he had “zero interest” in bitcoin mining. The company is selling Genesis Digital Assets’ sites in Kazakhstan and aims to use its U.S. and Swedish facilities for AI workloads instead.
Alameda Research, the crypto trading firm owned by former FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried, invested more than $1 billion in Genesis Digital Assets from 2021 and owned about 20% of the miner, the WSJ said. FTX filed for bankruptcy in November 2022, leaving that investment among the many assets scrutinized by the estate.

items.title: Ghostty作者新终端Rex新增活动视图，集中显示Agent状态
items.content:
Ghostty作者新终端Rex新增活动视图，集中显示Agent状态

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Ghostty 作者 Mitchell Hashimoto 的新终端 Rex 新增 Activity Mode（活动视图），已向公测用户开放。它会在侧边栏集中显示正在运行或暂时空闲的程序和 Coding Agent，并标出任务状态等信息。用户可以快速找到需要处理的任务，直接切换到对应终端。

这项功能使用了此前提出的 OSC 7501 协议，让程序主动汇报自己正在工作、等待用户还是已经完成。不过，Rex 还会结合其他信息和判断规则，决定什么时候显示哪些状态，尽量减少无用提醒。

Mitchell 表示，团队过去一直不喜欢类似的任务通知面板，因为提醒太多，有些甚至比电子邮件还难用。负责开发的 almonk 花了几个星期打磨这些细节，希望做出一套团队自己也愿意长期使用的功能。目前测试用户反馈不错，但仍在持续调整。

Also elephants are pink. How this company can proceed to exist is beyond me. For legal reasons I must emphasize that this is hear-say and should not be trusted ...

[jttnr]: Cyprus and Deloitte, why am I not surprised to see those names mentioned together in connection with alleged tax evasion? For those who don't know, Cyprus is widely regarded as one of Europe's tax havens. And, of cause, Deloitte has offices there.

Mostly they're loose partnerships and local offices and partners have the significant discretion. Even legally they're mostly not structured as a global corporation but rather a loose association of legally distinct  entities. There's a tension between having a brand that reflects trust and institutional rigor and avoiding liability for the actions of partners...

items.title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
items.content:
Smaller tokens are outperforming, with the CoinDesk 80 up around 3% over 24 hours against 1.2% for the CoinDesk 5, as bitcoin trades below $83,500.
CoinDesk research shows bitcoin and ether order books have rebuilt since the Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash, while altcoin liquidity has continued to thin.
U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs recorded $681 million of net outflows last week, the most since June, ahead of Wednesday’s U.S. CPI data.
Small tokens are outpacing the major cryptocurrencies on Monday, with the CoinDesk 80 up around 3% over the past 24 hours, more than double the 1.2% gain in the CoinDesk 5.
Bitcoin BTC$84,155.39 is trading below $83,500, after hitting a high above $84,000 on Sunday, while ether ETH$2,554.96 has added around 2.5% to trade at $2,560.
The gains are coming from the thinnest part of the market. A year on from the Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash, order-book depth for bitcoin and ether has recovered to pre-crash levels in dollar terms, while altcoin liquidity has continued to erode, according to CoinDesk research.
Institutional money is heading the other way, with U.S.-listed spot bitcoin ETFs recording $681 million of net outflows last week, the most since June, according to SoSoValue. Most of the selling came on Wednesday and Thursday. Spot ether ETFs have not had a day of inflows since Sept. 28. The nine-day run of outflows is the longest since June.
Oil has eased, with WTI futures down around 2% to $90 per barrel after President Donald Trump said Russia would supply 300,000 metric tons of diesel to global markets, a partial easing of sanctions. Attention now turns to Wednesday’s U.S. consumer price index.
Derivatives positioning
Futures trading is surging, but leverage isn’t building: Trading volume over 24 hours is $126 billion, up 81%. Open interest (OI), the dollar value of all open contracts, is $145.8 billion, up just 2.44%. Traders are churning through positions faster, but few are opening new ones.
Sellers are no longer dominating taker flow: Longs make up 52% of 24-hour taker volume. Taker volume comes from trades where traders pay to have their orders filled immediately, so it shows which side of the transaction is more eager. Last week the long share was lower at 48%.
ZEC is drawing real futures interest, but little of it is new money: The coin is the fourth-largest cryptocurrency by futures volume at $5.46 billion over 24 hours, behind bitcoin, ether and SOL. Its price is up 6% and OI is up 7%. OI is counted in dollars, so a higher price alone lifts it. Strip that out and only about 1% more contracts are open, a small amount of fresh positioning. Annualized funding is 10%, so longs pay shorts a premium to hold their positions. Cumulative volume delta (CVD), which tracks whether aggressive buyers or sellers dominate, is barely positive.
NEAR’s rally has more fresh positioning behind it: The price is up 10% and OI is up 17%, which works out to about 6% more open contracts. Funding is positive, as with ZEC. NEAR also has the second-highest 24-hour OI-adjusted CVD among major tokens, which suggests buyers are driving the move. The price is at its highest since December.
Bitcoin and ether leverage demand stays low: OI for both has barely changed in 24 hours and sits well below its peaks from early this year. Volumes are normal.
Traders expect calm in bitcoin and ether: Bitcoin’s implied volatility index, BVIV, is struggling to move above 40% after bouncing from year-to-date lows near 34% last week. Ether’s index shows the same. Implied volatility is the market’s forecast of future price swings, and a flat reading means options traders aren’t pricing in a big move.
Oil shorts on Hyperliquid look crowded: In its oil markets, shorts are paying longs funding of 100% or more on an annualized basis. Funding is the fee one side of a perpetual futures transaction pays the other to keep the contract near spot, and shorts pay when they outnumber longs. Such a high fee means short bets are crowded, which can reverse fast if oil rises.
Options traders on Deribit are buying downside protection: Bitcoin puts with strikes from $55,000 to $80,000 dominate 24-hour volume. A put gains value when the price falls, so traders use it as insurance. Ether volume is mixed, with both calls and puts in the top five.
Starknet STRK$0.1038 has risen by 76% over the past week, adding another 54% on Saturday after Friday’s 33% jump, as the network weighs leaving Ethereum to become a standalone, quantum-resistant layer-1. The run has been built partly on leverage, although it did experience profit-taking on Monday as it dropped by 7.7%.
LayerZero ZRO also had a bullish start to the week, notching a 21% gain over 24 hours to $2.41, the highest level since May 2025 as its market cap neared $1 billion. The move appears to be a bounce from an oversold territory as opposed to news-driven.
Zcash (ZEC) has climbed while it features in the laundering trail from the Ledger reseller supply-chain attack. The attacker routed stolen ether through Tornado Cash and then into ZEC via NEAR Intents. Losses from devices sold by Malaysian reseller CryptoBilis are estimated at $86 million to $93 million, and Ledger has confirmed at least one device contained an unauthorized hardware implant.
CoinMarketCap’s “Altcoin Season” indicator is at 66/100, its highest in more than a year as traders take speculative bets while bitcoin consolidates between $80,000 and $88,000.

items.title: UK Freezes $12M London Penthouse of Alleged Prince Group Finance Chief
items.content:
In brief
- UK authorities have frozen the £8.9 million London penthouse of Thet Li, the alleged finance chief of Prince Group, The Times reported.
- Authorities will ask a court on Monday to continue the seizure of Li's watches and jewelry, valued at £10.6 million, and £92,570 in cash.
- The U.S. has sought forfeiture of about $14 billion in Bitcoin tied to Prince Group, which denies any wrongdoing.
UK authorities have frozen a London penthouse overlooking Buckingham Palace that belongs to Thet Li, the alleged finance chief of Prince Group, The Times reported Sunday.
Li, 39, paid £8.9 million in 2022 for the 13th-floor apartment near St James's Park, according to the report. Authorities placed a freezing order on its Land Registry record following a Foreign Office investigation.
The U.S. Treasury sanctioned Li in October 2025 among 146 Prince Group targets, describing him as a "de facto illicit finance CFO" involved in "bulk cash smuggling and managing dirty money."
The UK sanctioned him in March under its global human rights regime, citing his links to Chen Zhi and Prince Group, whose Cambodian scam centers it says subject workers to forced labor and cruel treatment.
UK authorities also accuse Li of being a "key lieutenant" to the group's leader who "managed the Prince Group's international financial network," according to The Times.
UK authorities describe Prince Group as a front for "industrial scale" online fraud, including the romance and investment scams known as pig butchering, per The Times, which cited United Nations estimates that more than 100,000 trafficked workers are forced to work in its operations.
Prince Group-linked London assets
Freezing orders also cover a £12 million mansion in St John's Wood and a £100 million office building in the City of London tied to Prince Group chairman Chen Zhi, the newspaper reported. Chen was arrested in Cambodia and extradited to China.
Assets linked to Chen's alleged second in command, Wu An Ming, including a £30 million Holland Park mansion and a £53 million Belgravia townhouse registered to a woman alleged to be his wife, have also been frozen. Wu was reportedly arrested in Japan in June.
Police raided two Isle of Man homes apparently owned by Li last October in a joint operation with the FBI. Prince Group obtained gaming licenses on the island that were allegedly used to launder the proceeds of its crimes, according to the report.
The U.S. has sought forfeiture of about $14 billion in Bitcoin tied to the group, and a Washington-based Scam Center Strike Force has reported $580 million in crypto seizures and freezes.
The UK has also sanctioned crypto marketplace Xinbi as part of a crackdown on Southeast Asian scam centers, and Interpol has called the scam compound network a global threat.
Prince Group said last year that it "categorically rejects the notion that it or its chairman, Chen Zhi, has engaged in any unlawful activity."
Authorities will apply to a court on Monday to continue the seizure of Li's watches and jewelry, valued at £10.6 million, along with £92,570 in cash.

items.title: QCP：比特币支撑位在8万美元附近，若突破8.7万美元或将上探9.4万美元
items.content:
QCP：比特币支撑位在8万美元附近，若突破8.7万美元或将上探9.4万美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，QCP Capital 发文表示，距离去年 10 月 11 日加密市场创下单日最大清算纪录已过去一年，如今比特币的走势似乎更加稳健。市场此前担忧的大规模重复抛售并未出现，尽管美国政府大额转移比特币引发市场不安，且周末有报道称 Ledger 硬件遭植入攻击，但比特币价格仍保持相对稳定。

比特币多次尝试突破 8.7 万美元未果，但仍维持区间震荡，8 万美元附近存在支撑。隐含波动率维持在较高水平，风险逆转指标显示，看跌期权相对于看涨期权的溢价低于往常，表明市场防御性仓位有所减少，但仍在为价格突破定价。若比特币有效突破 8.7 万美元，市场关注点将转向 9.4 万美元。历史上，10 月通常是加密市场表现较强的月份，去年是一个明显例外，而期权定价显示，这一季节性规律可能再次显现。

本周将迎来多个重要催化因素：周三公布美国消费者价格指数（CPI），周四公布生产者价格指数（PPI），周五则是沃什在国际货币基金组织（IMF）与世界银行年会上的发言。如果他再次释放此前在杰克逊霍尔会议上表达的鹰派信号，可能对风险资产构成压力。目前，市场预计美联储 10 月加息的概率约为 17%，维持利率不变仍是主流预期，但本周公布的数据可能对这一预期形成考验。期权市场也显示出明确的看涨布局：规模较大的 10 月 30 日到期、行权价分别为 9 万美元、9.5 万美元和 10 万美元的看涨蝶式价差策略，是 10 月底到期合约中未平仓头寸最集中的位置。

items.title: Meta Muse次日留存73%，几乎是ChatGPT的1.8倍，但第9天被反超
items.content:
Meta Muse次日留存73%，几乎是ChatGPT的1.8倍，但第9天被反超

动察 Beating AI 快讯，投资人 Deedy Das 分享了市场研究机构 Sensor Tower 的最新数据。Meta 个人 AI Agent Muse 的次日留存率达到 73.3%，远高于 ChatGPT 的 41.3%，领先整整 32 个百分点。

但 Muse 的优势没能持续太久。第 7 天，其留存率仍超过 30%，随后逐渐被 ChatGPT 追上，并在第 8 至第 9 天之间遭到反超。到了第 14 天，Muse 的留存率降至 22.5%，ChatGPT 则保持在 26.8%。不过，Muse 仍高于同期 Threads 的 21.2%、Google Maps 的 18.5% 和 Grok Bot 的 10.4%。

Muse 于 9 月 8 日上线，此前 Sensor Tower 估算，其仅用 22 天便突破 500 万次下载，成为近期增长最快的消费级 AI 应用之一。Meta 也通过 Facebook、Instagram 等旗下平台大力推广 Muse。

这份留存数据统计的是 2026 年 9 月新安装移动应用的用户，覆盖 iOS 和 Android。由于 Muse 当时主要面向美国和加拿大开放，而 ChatGPT 的市场覆盖更广，两者的用户构成并不完全相同。

items.title: Switching from Cryptomus to Heleket leaves the same UK sanctions target
items.content:
Quick Take
- The October 8 UK designation names Cryptomus and Heleket as variations of Xeltox, unique ID RUS3755.
- Separate Chainalysis tracing follows TokenSpot, Grinex and Meer funds to one HTX deposit address; it is a distinct routing example.
- Covered UK transfers may need an exception or issued licence. Canadian registration does not establish eligibility to return funds under UK rules.
The UK placed crypto payment brands Cryptomus and Heleket under the same sanctions designation on Oct. 8, 2026, naming Xeltox Enterprises Ltd. as the target. Switching between the two brands leaves the shared designation relevant to the counterparty assessment.
For merchants choosing a payment processor and customers seeking access to funds, the operator matters as much as the name on the checkout. The Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office's notice lists Cryptomus, Heleket and Certa Payments Ltd. as variations of Xeltox's name.
What changes for payments and UK access
Xeltox appears in the notice under unique ID RUS3755. The UK says it has reasonable grounds to suspect the company has supported or benefited from Russia's government through the Russian financial-services sector, citing its ownership of Cryptomus and activities linked to and continued through Heleket.
The listed measures include an asset freeze, restrictions on trust services, director disqualification, internet-services sanctions and correspondent-banking and payment-processing restrictions.
For the banking measure, the notice prohibits UK credit or financial institutions from establishing or continuing correspondent relationships with the designated person and from processing payments to, from or through it. It also extends the measure to credit or financial institutions owned or controlled by that person.
The internet measure imposes a different obligation. Social-media services, internet-access services and application stores must take reasonable steps to prevent UK users from accessing content, websites or applications supplied by the designated person. The requirement establishes a UK access restriction.
Guidance from the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) says UK financial sanctions apply to people and activities within UK territory and to UK nationals and entities established under UK law wherever they operate. Cryptoassets fall within the broad definitions of funds and economic resources. The effect on a transaction therefore depends on its parties, activity and jurisdiction.
The control question also reaches beyond explicitly named brands. OFSI's ownership and control tests include holding more than 50% of shares or voting rights, having the right to appoint or remove a majority of directors, or a reasonable expectation that a person can ensure an entity conducts its affairs according to their wishes. An unlisted company can therefore fall within applicable financial restrictions because of control.
For a withdrawal within UK sanctions jurisdiction, the transfer's legal basis matters even when the customer is not designated. Whether the transfer is prohibited, covered by an exception or permitted by a license depends on the funds and activity involved.
UK government guidance distinguishes an exception, which applies automatically when its defined conditions are met, from a license giving written permission for otherwise prohibited activity. General licenses also have conditions and can expire, be amended or be revoked. For an otherwise prohibited transfer, moving a customer's funds requires an applicable exception or license. A licensing ground identifies a potential basis for an application; written licensing permission requires an issued license covering the activity.
The current OFSI general-license index illustrates the importance of checking which entities a permission covers. Its Oct. 8 addition, a Zarubezhneft wind-down license, covers that oil company and its owned or controlled subsidiaries.
OFSI also lists a return-of-funds licensing ground for designated money-services businesses that requires UK registration for money-laundering purposes, alongside other conditions. Canadian registration alone does not meet that requirement.
Legal permission and successful execution are separate questions. A provider switch therefore leaves two further requirements: a lawful transfer of the existing balance and a receiving route able to process it.
Separate exchange names can share a route
Separate exchange tracing illustrates a different issue: changing the legal operator may still leave a shared downstream route. TokenSpot CJSC has its own Oct. 8 designation, RUS3758, with the same listed categories of restrictions; its entry designates a separate entity from Xeltox.
Chainalysis reports that downstream funds from TokenSpot, Grinex and Meer converged on one HTX deposit address. Some services reached that destination through intermediary wallets.
In the analysis published Oct. 8, the firm says the address received more than $308 million. This is the address's aggregate receipt total; the narrative gives no observation period or exchange-by-exchange breakdown.
The convergence matters because different exchange brands can send funds into the same downstream route while presenting distinct services to the customer. For a merchant evaluating alternatives, a change in operator and a change in routing are distinct questions: the first concerns the counterparty and legal control; the second concerns where the payment goes after entering the service.
CryptoSlate's earlier coverage of US action against A7 and Iran-Russia settlement links examined the role of payment intermediaries. The new tracing supplies a separate routing example. The described trace concerns TokenSpot, Grinex and Meer. Any connection of Cryptomus or Heleket to this HTX endpoint, or a corporate group with those exchanges, remains unestablished in this analysis.
A Canadian penalty preceded the UK designation
Xeltox also has a Canadian compliance history that predates the UK designation. FINTRAC's Oct. 22, 2025 record says its director confirmed a C$176,960,190 administrative monetary penalty on Oct. 16, 2025, for 2,593 contraventions across six violation types.
The regulator's findings included failures to submit suspicious-transaction reports and comply with Canada's Iran directive. The Oct. 22 record says Xeltox appealed the penalty to the Federal Court.
The UK Sanctions List update log, checked Oct. 11, showed Oct. 8 as its latest update. For a customer considering a switch, the remaining evidence needed is specific to the transaction: the operator, who holds or controls the funds, the route and the applicable permission.

items.title: Kraken parent clears Dubai’s final hurdle for dirham trading rollout
items.content:
Kraken parent clears Dubai’s final hurdle for dirham trading rollout
Payward received full market approval from Dubai’s VARA to expand its digital asset services in the UAE, building on the preliminary approval received in May.
Payward, the parent company of cryptocurrency exchange Kraken, has received approval from the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) for its local entity, Payward FZCO, to provide crypto services.
At launch, Kraken’s clients in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) will be able to access spot and margin trading in UAE dirham (AED)-denominated pairs and make direct deposit withdrawals, Payward announced on Monday. The company is targeting launch in the coming weeks.
VARA’s public register shows that the regulator issued Payward FZCO a virtual asset service provider (VASP) license on Oct. 6, enabling it to offer management and investment services, as well as broker-dealer services.
Payward said the approval allows it to serve retail, professional and institutional investors. It follows its preliminary approval in May 2026.
Dubai’s VARA registry currently lists 58 licensed providers, up from 49 active companies in May 2026.
Banks and brokers are also expanding their crypto offerings under the UAE’s other regulatory regimes.
In September, Standard Chartered launched spot Bitcoin and Ether trading for institutional clients in the UAE through its Dubai International Financial Centre branch, which is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority.
In August, trading platform Capital.com revealed plans to offer spot crypto services to clients in the UAE after its affiliate, Capital Vault, secured a virtual-asset license from the country’s Capital Market Authority (CMA).
Related: Nasdaq invests $100M in Kraken parent at $21B valuation: Report

items.title: Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
items.content:
Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
Standard Chartered has launched custody for Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to let institutions use the tokens as trading collateral.
Standard Chartered has launched institutional custody services for Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin, with plans to expand its use as trading collateral.
The UK-based multinational bank announced Monday it rolled out RLUSD support on the XRP Ledger (XRPL) through its Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) branch, giving eligible institutional clients access to its digital asset custody infrastructure.
Standard Chartered plans to extend its collateral-mirroring model to LMAX Group, an institutional trading company, allowing clients to use RLUSD as trading collateral while keeping the tokens in the bank’s custody.
The model would let LMAX recognize the value of eligible RLUSD holdings without requiring clients to transfer the tokens to its trading platform. Standard Chartered said this could reduce transfer-related risks and help institutions manage their exposure to trading counterparties.
Ripple, the blockchain payments company behind RLUSD, and LMAX Group previously announced a partnership in January 2026 to expand institutional use of the stablecoin.
Standard Chartered said the additional collateral capabilities remain subject to final documentation, testing, regulatory requirements and internal approvals.
Cointelegraph contacted Standard Chartered for further details and will update this article upon receiving a response.
Related: Standard Chartered plans institutional crypto custody in Singapore

items.title: REA是闭源软件的末日？复刻Adobe全家桶的人却拒绝用它
items.content:
REA是闭源软件的末日？复刻Adobe全家桶的人却拒绝用它

动察 Beating AI 快讯，逆向工具 REA 近日爆红，开发者 Matthew Berman 甚至喊出「软件已死」。但正在用 AI 复刻 Adobe 全家桶的 ArtCraft 创始人 Brandon Thomas，却公开表示不会使用 REA。他在 Hacker News 上强调，团队不对商业软件进行反编译，也禁止使用 Ghidra 等逆向工具，担心由此引发版权诉讼。

Thomas 正借助 Claude Opus 5.5，用 Rust 开发一系列免费的开源软件。其中 7 款对标 Adobe 产品，包括 Photoshop、Illustrator 和 Premiere Pro。最近，他又将目标转向微软，推出了分别对标 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 的项目。不过，这些软件距离真正取代原版还有很长的路要走。实测发现，PhotoCraft 无法打开 iPhone 常见的 HEIC 照片，FilmCraft 则连部分基础剪辑操作和音频播放都存在问题。

REA 可以让 Claude Code 等 Agent 调用 Ghidra、IDA 等工具，分析没有公开源码的软件，并根据分析结果重做其中的功能。Thomas 却坚持另一种开发方式：只参考公开的技术文档和软件的实际表现，从头编写代码，不接触原版的内部实现。这种做法被称为「洁净室」开发。

他认为，REA 用于个人研究或研究废弃软件或许没有问题，但如果利用它反编译商业软件，再公开发布仿制品，一旦涉及原版的专有代码，就可能面临诉讼。

items.title: Payward Receives Full Market Approval from Dubai’s VARA; Kraken Plans UAE Launch
items.content:
Payward Receives Full Market Approval from Dubai’s VARA; Kraken Plans UAE Launch in the Coming Weeks

Kraken parent Payward has received full market approval from Dubai’s VARA, allowing regulated virtual-asset services for retail, professional and institutional investors. Kraken plans to launch in the UAE within weeks, with AED-denominated spot and margin trading, direct AED deposits and withdrawals, onchain staking and tokenized stocks via xStocks. Institutional clients will also get OTC spot and Kraken Prime. Crypto derivatives and other products are planned for late 2026 into 2027, subject to further approval. Payward received preliminary VARA approval in May. — link

items.title: South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
items.content:
South Korean bank launches Bitcoin-backed business loans: Report
Jeonbuk Bank reportedly began offering Bitcoin-backed loans to corporate customers, with a third-party custodian holding the cryptocurrency used as collateral.
South Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank, a subsidiary of JB Financial Group, reportedly started issuing Bitcoin-backed loans to its corporate customers.
Local outlet EDaily reported Monday that Jeonbuk Bank became the country’s first commercial bank to accept Bitcoin (BTC) as collateral for won-denominated lending. The bank is reportedly limiting the service to businesses seeking operational capital, while a specialized custodian holds the BTC used as collateral.
The lending arrangement follows amendments to South Korea’s Civil Enforcement Rules that took effect on Oct. 1. According to the Supreme Court, the rules establish procedures for seizing and liquidating claims to virtual assets. In the event of a default, the bank can recover its funds through court-ordered sales.
Jeonbuk Bank has adopted a system that allows it to recover outstanding loans through the proceeds of cryptocurrency sales without directly taking possession of the assets, according to EDaily.
The bank has not publicly disclosed the loan amount, interest rate, or loan-to-value requirements. A bank representative told local outlet Chosun that it had already issued a loan but declined to identify the borrower.
Cointelegraph reached out to JB Financial Group for confirmation, but did not receive an immediate response.
Related: South Korea crypto exchange profits fall 78% in H1 amid trading slump

items.title: Kraken母公司Payward获迪拜VARA全面市场批准，计划进军阿联酋市场
items.content:
Kraken母公司Payward获迪拜VARA全面市场批准，计划进军阿联酋市场

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，Kraken 母公司、综合金融基础设施平台 Payward 今日宣布，在获得迪拜虚拟资产监管局（VARA）的全面市场批准后，计划正式进军阿联酋市场。该批准允许 Payward 以受监管虚拟资产服务提供商（VASP）的身份开展业务，服务零售、专业及机构投资者。

正式推出服务后，阿联酋地区的 Kraken 用户将能够使用以阿联酋迪拉姆（AED）计价的交易对进行现货和保证金交易，并直接使用迪拉姆充值和提现。用户还可使用链上质押、xStocks 以及用于加密资产转账的 Krak 服务；机构客户则可使用场外现货交易服务和 Kraken Prime。

在获得监管批准的前提下，Payward 预计将于 2026 年晚些时候至 2027 年陆续推出更多产品，包括加密货币衍生品以及更丰富的收益机会。此外，Payward 还将通过嵌入式交易服务，向该地区的合作伙伴开放其基础设施。

items.title: Anatomy开源：一句话把技术原理变成会动的机器
items.content:
Anatomy开源：一句话把技术原理变成会动的机器

动察 Beating AI 快讯，开发者 Ryan 开源了一个名为 Anatomy 的 AI 绘图 Skill，目前支持 Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Codex。用户只需用一句话描述想解释的技术概念，AI 就会自行设计一台机器，通过零件的运动展示原理。生成的作品还可以用鼠标或键盘操作。

比如，解释 LRU 缓存（优先清除最久没用的数据），AI 会设计一个能移动书本的书架。解释机械表如何运转，它能画出可以上发条、调节速度和拆解齿轮的机械装置。更复杂的作品包括 SpaceX 星舰使用的猛禽火箭发动机，可以拆成 11 组部件，还能模拟点火。目前官网已展示 33 个主要作品。

Anatomy 会先研究相关原理和参数，再设计零件、绘制图形并加入动画。画面中的运动和数字读数由同一套计算模型控制，操作时会同步变化。它还内置了自动检查工具，可以排查零件穿插、遮挡错误等问题。最终生成的是可以修改的网页代码，既能单独打开，也能嵌入网站。作者还将现有作品打包成组件库，方便开发者直接使用。

项目已按 MIT 协议开源。不过，制作精细的作品耗时良久。作者披露，机械表耗时近 2 小时，猛禽火箭发动机耗时超过 10 小时。3D 功能目前仍处于测试阶段。

items.title: Solana sandwich bots took $29.7 million before costs, mostly targeting Pump.fun
items.content:
Quick Take
- Bitquery estimates $29.7 million in gross extraction from Solana sandwich trades over 11 months, before costs.
- Pump.fun’s launch curve and PumpSwap accounted for 96% of detected attacks; other bots’ trades contributed 39% of gross proceeds.
- Within observed Jupiter routes through those venues, 20%–50% slippage trades were sandwiched 14 times as often as under-3% trades.
Sandwich bots extracted about $29.7 million before costs from Solana trades over an 11-month period, according to blockchain data provider Bitquery. It found 96% of detected attacks on memecoin platform Pump.fun's launch curve and its PumpSwap exchange.
The investigation, covering successful swaps, counted 6,850,144 attacks by 2,545 bot wallets affecting 2,154,994 distinct wallets between October 30, 2025, and October 7, 2026. Those addresses do not represent a count of individual people: other bots' trades accounted for 39% of the estimated gross take.
A sandwich places a bot's purchase and sale around another trader's swap. The first purchase raises the pool price; the intervening buyer receives fewer tokens, and the bot sells into the higher price. The cost reaches the trader through execution, even when the swap completes successfully.
Wide slippage marked greater exposure
Among trades sent by swap router Jupiter through Pump.fun's launch curve or PumpSwap, trades allowing 20%–50% slippage were sandwiched 14 times as often as those allowing under 3%, Bitquery found.
Slippage tolerance sets how far execution can depart from a quote. Jupiter's documentation describes a minimum acceptable output after applying that tolerance. A price move beyond the limit can cause a swap to fail; a wider limit permits a worse fill. That creates a tradeoff between completing a volatile trade and limiting the price concession accepted along the way.
The observed attack rates did not rise uniformly with every wider setting. Trades below 0.5% tolerance were hit more often than those at 1%–3%, while the 50%-or-more band was hit less often than the 20%–50% band.
The slippage comparison is observational and covers Jupiter routes through Pump.fun's launch curve or PumpSwap. Jupiter carried only a small share of all victim trades in the investigation.
The $29.7 million estimate values SOL at the minute of each attack and does not measure net profit. In Bitquery's separate 63-attack fee sample, bots retained 68% of aggregate gross proceeds, and 18 attacks lost money after costs. That sample does not establish net earnings for the full period. The report also identifies inconsistent Pump.fun sale-fee recording that affects its gross estimate by about 3%.
Bitquery used repeated trading patterns to identify bots, excluded round trips beginning in a token's first 10 slots, and reports gaps in exchange and block coverage. Chain records cannot prove a bot saw an order beforehand, and some qualifying wallets may be fast traders.
Slippage limits address the price a trader will accept. A separate research preprint submitted September 23, 2026 examined protected order flow, meaning transactions intended to be shielded from front-running, across six blockchains. Its authors found sandwich patterns extending across trades and blocks and concluded these protections can offer weaker guarantees than users expect.

Unfortunately, Capital’s acquisition of power in the modern Western world has not been accompanied by a commensurate acquisition of confidence. items.title: Tinder母公司AI预算翻倍，CFO开始逐人查Token账单
items.content:
Tinder母公司AI预算翻倍，CFO开始逐人查Token账单

动察 Beating AI 快讯，彭博社采访多家企业 CFO 发现，美国公司开始收紧 AI 费用管理。部分企业给员工设置 Token 额度、实时追踪个人支出，并让简单任务优先使用便宜模型。

Tinder 母公司 Match Group 年初安排了 500 万美元 AI 预算，5 月就翻倍至 1000 万美元。公司实时记录每位员工的花费。想突破额度，得先证明用途有价值。网络安全公司 Sysdig 的 CFO 则每天检查 Token 消耗。

彭博社统计，标普 500 公司财报电话会最近一季提到「Token」157 次，接近一年前的 4 倍。安永调查显示，82% 的受访 AI 投资企业高管担心相关成本，但只有 64% 称公司已监控用量并设置明确预算。安永还估算，算上订阅、基础设施和管理等费用，企业部署 AI 智能体的总成本约为 Token 账单的 3 倍。

但成本压力并未让企业集体缩减 AI 投入。安永调查中，37% 的相关高管表示公司考虑扩大 AI 部署，考虑缩小的只有 15%。企业一边加强成本管控，一边继续增加 AI 投入，开始更严格地衡量哪些用途值得花钱。

items.title: 分析：比特币矿工交易手续费收入占比不足1%，老旧矿机面临盈利压力
items.content:
分析：比特币矿工交易手续费收入占比不足1%，老旧矿机面临盈利压力

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，CryptoQuant 分析师 Axel Adler Jr. 表示，过去 30 天，比特币交易手续费收入平均仅占矿工总收入的 0.64%，较前一周的 0.65% 略有下降，且该指标自 2025 年 8 月中旬以来一直低于 1%。目前，矿工收入仍主要来自新发行的比特币，交易手续费对盈利能力的贡献有限，矿工经营状况因此在很大程度上取决于比特币价格及矿机能效。尽管比特币价格从约 5.9 万美元回升至 8.4 万美元，改善了矿工的经营环境，但老旧矿机在当前电价下仍面临较大盈利压力。

若比特币价格继续上涨，老旧矿机的电费亏损幅度有望收窄，而高能效矿机的盈利空间则可能进一步扩大；反之，若币价下跌，矿工收入将受到冲击。此外，手续费收入占比低于 1% 并不直接意味着矿工正在大规模关机或抛售储备。后续若手续费收入占比持续回升至 1% 以上，或表明交易手续费对矿工收入的贡献有所改善。需要注意的是，上述成本仅计算电费，尚未计入矿机购置、冷却设施、维修等其他支出。

items.title: Zod 4.6.6 compromised by malware?
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[Meneth]: The compromised code is still tagged on Github as of 2026-10-12T10:37:51:  https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/releases/tag/v4.6.6 . See commit d821685.

[jaynetics]: The compromised code wasn't actually released. This write-up has a lot of information:  https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/208477

[yuvalkarmi]: This is 3 weeks back, folks. It WAS real repository compromise - it made it to Zod's main, but not to npm. On September 21, someone used Colin's git credentials to push this compromised code into the project, Colin caught it, and reverted it that same day (PR #6620). He subsequently did release 4.6.6 on October 11, but it did NOT contain the infected code. Btw, Zod wasn't the only package targeted - same attack was attempted against standard-schema and nub. Nub DID make it to n...

[jaapz]: Might is pretty tame, it is infected - EDIT: title was changed, it said "might be infected". The malware seems to inject some JS payload to execute when zod is installed, by fetching it from an ethereum smart contract (if I understand it correctly). Don't forget to flag the version on npm. EDIT: looks like the update never got on NPM:  https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50053253

[luggage_bazooka]: The most recent version 4.6.6 has a very interesting commit (d821685) "Fix bugs and improve performance", that contain the following changes  https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/commit/d821685ea6732436fcd...  I didn't study what packages/mini/meta.test.mjs is doing in particular but it's not looking great
items.author: luggage_bazooka
items.ai_reason: A supply-chain attack on Zod, one of the most widely used TypeScript validation libraries, with a genuinely novel technique: the injected payload reportedly fetched its next stage from an Ethereum smart contract. The discussion (34 comments, 130 upvotes) adds real signal, establishing that the malicious commit reached the main branch via Colin Hicks' stolen git credentials on 2026-09-21, was reverted the same day, and never made it to npm — so the 4.6.6 release of October 11 is clean. Impact on end users is therefore limited and the underlying intrusion is weeks old, but the in-window development is concrete and material to developers: the compromised commit is still tagged and downloadable as v4.6.6 on GitHub as of October 12, and the same actor targeted standard-schema and nub (where it did reach the registry). Real but contained security event, short of a confirmed mass-compromise.
items.ai_summary: Developers flagged that Zod's GitHub release tag v4.6.6 still points at a malicious commit (d821685) pushed with stolen maintainer credentials, part of a supply-chain campaign that used an Ethereum smart contract to deliver its JS payload and also hit standard-schema and nub — but which was caught, reverted, and never published to npm.

提案发起者表示，该措施旨在打击逃税行为。他们援引一项关于高净值人士税收问题的议会调查指出，2021 年法国加密资产资本利得达到 35 亿欧元，但当年向税务机关申报的加密资产持仓价值仅为 4 亿欧元。
