items.title: XRP rebounded as Binance spot turnover fell nearly 80%
items.content:
Quick Take
- Binance XRP/USDT turnover fell 78.6% over completed October 8–10 sessions while the closing price rose 1.6%.
- Binance and Bybit futures exposure partially rebuilt by October 11 but remained below matched October 8 readings.
- XRPL.to’s three-venue October 7–8 sample recorded $40.70 million in liquidated long contract notional, a bounded total rather than traders’ cash losses.
XRP futures exposure began rebuilding by October 11 after market-data provider XRPL.to recorded $40.70 million in long liquidations across Binance, Bybit and OKX during October 7–8 in its streamed sample. XRP traded near $1.40 at the October 11 snapshot.
Binance and Bybit each had less outstanding futures exposure measured in XRP at midnight on October 11 than at midnight on October 8, even after both books expanded over the preceding day. Meanwhile, Binance spot trading slowed during the price rebound, leaving the recovery without clear evidence of sustained buying on that venue.
XRPL.to collected $40.70 million of long liquidations and $1.72 million of short liquidations across Binance, Bybit and OKX during the two completed UTC days of October 7 and 8. Those figures come from its streamed liquidation sample, which records forced closures reported by the three exchanges.
Binance accounted for $24.69 million of the sampled long liquidations, followed by Bybit at $11.65 million and OKX at $4.36 million. The imbalance shows that forced closures in the collected stream fell overwhelmingly on positions exposed to rising XRP prices.
The dollar figures describe the notional value of liquidated contracts, rather than traders' realized cash losses.
Coverage also limits the total. XRPL.to's methodology says Binance streams at most one liquidation per symbol per second, making its collected figures a floor. Collector restarts can leave gaps.
The separate recent OKX liquidation-order sample is excluded because it can overlap with the streamed events.
Contract exposure fell, then began returning
The clearest evidence that outstanding exposure was removed comes from matched open-interest readings in XRP units. Open interest measures contracts still outstanding, with a long and a short counterparty to each position.
Between 00:00 UTC on October 8 and October 9, Binance XRPUSDT open interest fell from 321.40 million to 295.47 million XRP. That removed 25.93 million XRP of contract exposure, an 8.1% decline. Bybit's reading fell from 211.92 million to 197.90 million XRP, down 14.02 million XRP, or 6.6%, over the same interval.
Because the quantities fell, this was a contraction in outstanding exposure. A lower XRP price alone can reduce the dollar valuation of a futures book without reducing its underlying quantity.
| Venue | Oct. 8 | Oct. 9 | Oct. 10 | Oct. 11 | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Binance | 321.40 | 295.47 | 294.03 | 297.75 | 
| Bybit | 211.92 | 197.90 | 194.54 | 201.00 | 
Open interest in millions of XRP, at 00:00 UTC on each date in 2026. Data by XRPL.to; Binance readings cross-checked against Binance's original series.
By October 11 midnight, the direction had changed. Binance added exposure equivalent to 3.72 million XRP from the preceding midnight, a 1.3% increase. Bybit added 6.46 million XRP, up 3.3%. Both readings nonetheless remained below October 8: Binance by 7.4% and Bybit by 5.2%.
The dollar series tells a related but different story. Binance's open-interest value fell from $456.53 million to $407.60 million between October 8 and 9 midnight, a 10.7% decline. That exceeded the 8.1% quantity decline because the implied valuation per XRP also fell. Binance's market-data definitions distinguish total open interest from its value; neither is a direct measure of money flowing into or out of XRP.
Aggregate open interest reflects positions opened and closed voluntarily as well as forced liquidations.
OKX is included in the liquidation sample but excluded from this matched midnight comparison. Its daily open-interest history uses 16:00 UTC observations, so treating those rows as simultaneous with Binance and Bybit would distort the comparison.
Funding recovered as spot activity faded
Funding provides another indication that the conditions facing futures holders changed. It is a periodic payment between long and short positions: a positive rate means longs pay shorts, while a negative rate reverses the payment.
For the completed October 9 UTC day, settled funding totaled roughly minus 0.0173% on Binance, minus 0.0163% on Bybit and minus 0.0101% on OKX. Each total covered three payments. On October 10, Binance and Bybit turned positive at approximately 0.0068% and 0.0015%, respectively, while OKX remained slightly negative at about minus 0.0014%.
The quotes collected by XRPL.to around 12:11:52 UTC on October 11 were positive on all three venues. Binance quoted 0.005908%, Bybit 0.003203% and OKX about 0.005818% for the eight-hour payment due at 16:00 UTC that day.
Those quotes describe the rate indicated at that snapshot. They are separate from the payments already settled over a completed day and can change before settlement.
Positive funding alongside rebuilding open interest means renewed exposure comes with a quoted carrying cost for longs.
Spot activity offers less consistent support for the rebound. Binance's completed daily candles show XRP/USDT turnover declining from 252.45 million USDT on October 8 to 120.39 million on October 9 and 54.12 million on October 10, a 78.6% fall over two days. Over October 8–10, the daily closing price rose 1.6%, from 1.3805 to 1.4024 USDT, also reflected in XRPL.to's spot history.
Buyer-initiated trades represented 51.8% of the XRP traded on Binance spot on October 9, then 43.1% on October 10. These shares use the XRP volume fields in Binance's candle definitions; they measure which side initiated trades, rather than net purchases, since every trade has both a buyer and a seller.
The unfinished October 11 candle showed 1.3957 USDT at 12:12:18 UTC, close to $1.40. It was a live observation, not that day's closing price.
The completed rebound days therefore show higher prices with diminishing turnover and inconsistent buyer initiation on Binance. That limits the case for sustained spot buying there.
What the rebuild means for XRP holders
The returning exposure is exposure to XRP's price, not evidence that the same quantity of native tokens was bought.
Binance's XRPUSDT specification lists USDT as the quote and margin asset. Bybit's XRPUSDT product is a linear perpetual settled in USDT, while OKX's XRP-USDT-SWAP also specifies USDT settlement. OKX's perpetual guide explicitly explains that its USDT-margined products allow exposure without holding the underlying asset.
Settlement currency should also be distinguished from an account's collateral. As OKX's margin guide describes, the assets backing a position depend on the account and margin mode.
For spot holders, the significance is conditional. More outstanding futures exposure creates more positions whose survival depends on sufficient margin. At OKX, positions can be reduced or liquidated when margin falls below maintenance requirements plus trading fees. The daily open-interest figures cannot show how close current positions are to that threshold.
The next useful comparison is whether further XRP-unit exposure growth comes with sustained spot activity across completed sessions and venues, and whether positive funding persists in settled payments.
XRP is -2.80% over the past 24 hours and currently sits at rank #5 by market cap.

items.title: Safe Pro推出三档订阅计划，入门版年费1990欧元起并提供30天免费试用
items.content:
Safe Pro推出三档订阅计划，入门版年费1990欧元起并提供30天免费试用

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，据官方消息，Safe Labs 今日发布 Safe Pro 定价指南，介绍其面向组织和团队的三档付费订阅计划，分别为入门版、商业版和企业版。其中，入门版月费为 189 欧元、年费为 1990 欧元；商业版月费 669 欧元起、年费 7190 欧元起；企业版则采用定制化定价。以上价格均不含增值税，按年订阅相较按月付费可节省约 10%。新建工作空间可免费试用入门版或商业版 30 天，开始试用无需绑定支付方式。

Safe Pro 是 Safe{Wallet} 面向组织用户推出的付费管理服务，旨在帮助团队集中管理多个 Safe 账户、协调交易、监控安全状况并维护共享操作记录，同时不改变现有资产自托管机制。三档计划均支持无限工作空间成员，并提供共享地址簿、活动日志、安全中心、交易模拟及 Safe Shield 安全检查等功能。其中，入门版支持管理 2 个 Safe 账户，并提供每月最多 10 笔、单笔上限 5 欧元的 Gas 赞助；商业版支持 5 至 20 个账户，增加链上策略、交易提案者功能、优先支持及引导式入门服务，并提供每月最多 50 笔、单笔上限 5 欧元的 Gas 赞助；企业版支持超过 20 个账户、多个工作空间及定制化支持，Gas 赞助不设月度交易笔数上限，但单笔上限为 10 欧元。

Safe Pro 采用按 Safe 账户数量而非团队人数计费的模式，账户容量是区分不同订阅档位的主要因素。对于仅需基础多签和自托管功能的用户，Safe{Wallet} Core 仍可免费使用；需要集中管理账户、协调团队交易及加强运营安全管理的组织，则可选择 Safe Pro。需要注意的是，Gas 赞助仅适用于符合条件的交易，超出计划额度或不符合赞助条件的交易仍可能产生网络手续费。根据 Safe 公布的试用安排，2026 年 10 月 6 日及之后创建的新工作空间可享受 30 天免费试用；部分更早创建的工作空间则可能适用单独的 60 天免费使用安排。

items.title: 英伟达、Anthropic都没买成，亚马逊70亿美元洽购Decart
items.content:
英伟达、Anthropic都没买成，亚马逊70亿美元洽购Decart

动察 Beating AI 快讯，《华尔街日报》援引知情人士称，亚马逊正洽购 AI 初创公司 Decart。潜在交易估值约 70 亿美元，目前尚未敲定。Decart 主攻 AI 芯片优化软件，让模型在不同芯片上跑得更快、更省钱。其技术覆盖英伟达 GPU、谷歌 TPU 和亚马逊 Trainium。

这家成立于 2023 年的公司，收购传闻已经几次反转。8 月，以色列媒体《Calcalist》披露，英伟达曾接近收购 Decart。随后其他买家介入，谈判中止。马斯克旗下 SpaceX 也被猜测是潜在买家，但没有可靠报道证实其正式出价。

随后，Anthropic 曾考虑以约 60 亿美元收购 Decart，并展开尽职调查。但到 9 月，Anthropic 决定退出，原因尚未公开。如今亚马逊接棒洽购，潜在交易价格高于 Decart 5 月约 40 亿美元的融资估值。

亚马逊与 Decart 早有合作。Decart 5 月宣布，亚马逊已是其战略客户。双方已让实时视频模型 Lucy 2 运行在亚马逊自研的 Trainium3 芯片上。Decart 还开发了能生成交互式虚拟场景的 Oasis。收购若成，亚马逊也能获得 Decart 的跨芯片优化技术。

items.title: 微软CEO纳德拉：把AI当内部风险防，随时准备急停
items.content:
微软CEO纳德拉：把AI当内部风险防，随时准备急停

动察 Beating AI 快讯，微软 CEO 萨蒂亚·纳德拉发长文，主张把 AI 模型当作企业内部安全风险管理。模型即使没有恶意，也可能犯错或被攻击者利用。尤其当它能读取敏感数据、替人执行关键操作时，企业不能只信模型厂商的安全承诺。

他要求把模型与调度任务的 Harness（Agent 执行框架）分开。模型能读什么数据、调用什么工具，必须由外部系统控制。每次关键操作都应留下防篡改、方便人类审查的记录。他还要求模型思维链（展示出的推理过程）透明，但承认这些内容未必可靠。

最强硬的一条是，从部署时就假定模型可能遭到入侵，并做好隔离。授权人员必须能在 Agent 执行任务时随时暂停或关闭它，相当于装上「紧急刹车」。模型不能自己审核自己的行为，企业还要持续测试故障和攻击，及时披露事故。

微软本月已宣布 MXC 隔离工具在 Windows 正式可用。它通过外部策略限制 Agent 能访问的文件和网络。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371327
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: A substantive, concrete AI-safety/deployment framework from a top-lab CEO: Microsoft's Satya Nadella argues enterprises must treat AI models as internal security risks, separate the model from the agent harness so external systems control data/tool access, maintain tamper-proof audit trails, assume compromise at deployment and provide a human 'kill switch' that can pause or shut down an agent mid-task, plus refuse model self-auditing and require continuous adversarial testing. It carries an actionable technical prescription for how enterprise and developer agents get deployed, reinforced by Microsoft's MXC isolation tool going GA on Windows this month — meaningful but not a new frontier model or a regulatory decision, so it sits above generic commentary but below landmark AI events.

items.title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
items.content:
Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.
The Financial Stability Board (FSB), a global financial watchdog, has outlined financial stability risks associated with artificial intelligence and regulatory concerns surrounding stablecoins.
In a letter published Monday, FSB Chair Andrew Bailey warned that cross-border mechanisms for stablecoin oversight and crisis management “remain immature or are not yet developed.” In its 2025 review, the FSB found that 11 of 28 surveyed jurisdictions had finalized stablecoin regulatory frameworks.
He also urged G20 members to support the FSB’s newly finalized practices for responsible AI adoption in the financial sector.
“AI therefore requires our continued close attention alongside careful management by financial institutions,” Bailey wrote.
The FSB submitted the letter to Group of Twenty (G20) finance ministers and central bank governors ahead of their Thursday meeting. The G20 brings together the world’s major economies to coordinate financial policy and regulatory priorities.
Stablecoin risks extend to traditional financial markets
In a report accompanying the letter, the FSB warned that stablecoin runs could spill into traditional markets through forced sales of reserve assets and withdrawals of bank deposits. The watchdog also identified risks for multi-issuer stablecoins where redemption demand could concentrate on one issuer while reserves are held in different jurisdictions.
These concerns echo what regulators have previously raised. In 2025, European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde warned of similar redemption risks involving stablecoins issued inside and outside of the European Union.
AI safeguards target cybersecurity and third-party risks
The FSB’s AI practices cover organization-wide governance, AI development and deployment, cybersecurity and third-party service risks. Bailey also warned that sophisticated cyber threats enabled by AI could undermine the resilience of critical financial institutions and market infrastructure.
Related: Tether, Kazakhstan cenbank mull tenge stablecoin and asset tokenization
The risks have similarly drawn regulatory attention. In July, European central bankers warned that advances in AI could amplify market volatility and cybersecurity threats.
In June, the FSB had proposed 12 practices for responsible AI adoption, before finalizing its guidance for the upcoming G20 meeting.

items.title: Ledger wallet implant exposes a gap in its authenticity check
items.content:
Quick Take
- Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one affected customer’s device.
- Genuine Check authenticates the secure element; Ledger’s threat model says it can miss spying implants when that element remains intact.
- Bitquery’s $93.2 million estimate spans 315 wallets on six chains. It is separate from Tibane’s specimens and does not count compromised hardware.
Ledger has confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one affected customer's wallet as independent investigators estimate $93.2 million in suspected cryptocurrency thefts.
In an Oct. 10 statement, the hardware wallet manufacturer said the discovery involved a device belonging to one of the affected users. It added that CryptoBilis, an authorized reseller operating in Southeast Asia, had suspended sales of all hardware wallet inventory pending the investigation's conclusion.
The investigation began after customers reported losing cryptocurrency after buying Ledger devices from the reseller. Ledger has not said how many devices were modified or established that the implant caused all the reported losses.
Ledger said it had found no indication that its security infrastructure, systems or services had been compromised.
Why an implanted wallet can pass Ledger's Genuine Check
Former Mt. Gox chief executive Mark Karpelès has been examining suspicious Ledger Nano X devices through Tibane Labs, which has documented three generations of Ledger Nano X implants designed to intercept recovery phrases. Its report combines Joe Grand's teardown of an earlier implant with two specimens Tibane examined in September.
According to the research, the implants work by monitoring electronic signals sent between a wallet's secure element and its display.
During initial setup, a Ledger device generates a 24-word recovery phrase that lets its owner restore access to cryptocurrency holdings. Although the words originate inside a secure chip, they must pass through the device's display circuitry to appear on the screen.
Tibane Labs found that the modified devices contained additional microcontrollers that could read the screen's data, reconstruct the recovery words, and transmit them via cellular modems with SIM components.
Consequently, attackers could obtain the credentials needed to reconstruct a victim's wallet remotely without stealing the physical device or compromising Ledger's secure chip.
Earlier versions used visible wiring and smaller replacement batteries to accommodate the additional electronics. A more advanced version examined in September contained a custom circuit board hidden under the screen, with an LTE modem, an antenna, and components with removed identifying markings.
That version preserved the original battery and could appear normal even after its casing was opened.
Ledger's security documentation says Genuine Check verifies the secure element's authenticity but cannot detect unauthorized physical modifications, such as spying implants, if that element remains intact.
Tibane's two specimens were bought through Japanese marketplaces, rather than from CryptoBilis. Its report does not establish the design used in the reseller-linked thefts, and Ledger has not publicly described the implant it found.
Tibane Labs warned that a recovery phrase displayed on a compromised device should be treated as exposed. Replacing the device while reusing that phrase would leave an attacker able to access the wallet; funds must move to a wallet with a new phrase generated on a trusted device.
Investigators publish separate loss estimates above $90 million
Galaxy Digital research executive Alex Thorn reported on Oct. 9 approximately $91 million across 477 addresses on Bitcoin, Ethereum-related networks and Tron.
His analysis attributed $64.5 million of the suspected thefts to Tron, including approximately 64.3 million USDT.
Bitcoin accounted for another $17.7 million, equivalent to approximately 213 BTC, while Ethereum and related networks contributed $8.8 million.
A separate investigation by blockchain analytics firm Bitquery, updated Oct. 11, counted approximately $93.2 million in suspected thefts from 315 wallets across six blockchains. The two estimates use different address sets and methods; neither counts the number of tampered devices.
Bitquery also identified transaction patterns suggesting the attackers obtained control of multiple wallets before executing a coordinated withdrawal operation on Oct. 9.
Its analysis found that 25 Tron wallets signed the same token approval within three seconds, allowing approximately $29 million in USDT to be withdrawn within moments.
The firm also identified small test transactions conducted over roughly two weeks before the larger thefts, suggesting preparations began well before users reported missing funds.
In its Oct. 11 update, Bitquery estimated that Tether had frozen approximately $10 million in stolen USDT. It also identified $5.35 million in USDC that issuer Circle could freeze after funds moved through Tornado Cash and Zcash.
CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost suggested examining other regional resellers for possible supply-chain exposure, while acknowledging that the concern was speculative and unsupported by confirmed evidence.
Ledger said it was contacting affected users, coordinating with authorities, and working on enhanced anti-tampering protections.
It has advised customers who purchased devices from CryptoBilis not to initialize unused wallets. Those who have already completed setup should consider transferring their holdings to a trusted device using a newly generated recovery phrase.

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，OneKey 创始人 Yishi 发文表示，近期多名通过 CryptoBilis 购买 Ledger 硬件钱包的用户报告资产被盗，Ledger 已确认受影响设备中被植入未经授权的硬件，具体原因及影响范围仍在调查。由于 CryptoBilis 也曾销售 OneKey 等多个品牌的硬件钱包，OneKey 已终止其授权经销商资格。

针对这一事件，OneKey 宣布采取三项措施：即日起停止新增经销商；全面重新审核现有经销商，无法核实经营主体或最终受益人的将取消授权，并在审核完成后公布完整授权名单；为符合条件的用户免费更换设备。换新政策方面，2026 年 3 月 1 日至声明发布之日，通过 CryptoBilis 购买 OneKey 硬件钱包的用户，无论型号、是否激活或使用，均可申请免费换新。原型号有货则更换同型号全新设备，缺货则免费升级。设备由 OneKey 官方商店直接发货，用户无需寄回旧设备。申请截止日期为 2026 年 12 月 31 日，需通过 OneKey 官网客服或 help.onekey.so 提交工单，并提供购买凭证、设备型号及使用情况。

OneKey 同时提醒，尚未激活的设备应暂缓激活并直接申请换新；已使用且存有资产的用户，应预防性地将旧助记词视为可能已泄露，尽快使用全新助记词创建的钱包转移资产，切勿将旧助记词导入新设备。Yishi 还表示，用户只要通过 OneKey 官网下单，即属于官方直营渠道。OneKey 客服不会索要用户的助记词或 PIN 码，任何以换新或验证为由索取这些信息的行为都可能是诈骗。

items.title: 比特币矿企Genesis Digital Assets将向AI数据中心转型
items.content:
比特币矿企Genesis Digital Assets将向AI数据中心转型

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，据《华尔街日报》报道，比特币矿企 Genesis Digital Assets 将向 AI 数据中心转型。SWI Group 今年 6 月斥资 5 亿美元收购该公司大量股权，随后成为控股股东，并于 10 月 12 日宣布融资 8 亿欧元（约 9 亿美元），用于数据中心升级及扩建。SWI 计划利用 Genesis Digital 在美国得克萨斯州、南北卡罗来纳州及瑞典的数据中心，为大型云计算服务商提供算力，并出售剩余的哈萨克斯坦矿场资产。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371308

items.ai_reason: A US$900M (€800M) financing announced on Oct 12 to fund the conversion of Genesis Digital Assets' mining sites (Texas, Carolinas, Sweden) into AI/HPC data centers serving large cloud providers, plus the sale of remaining Kazakhstan mining assets. This is a material capital and business-model pivot by a sizable bitcoin miner into AI compute infrastructure, with clear transmission to mining economics and AI datacenter supply. It is a concrete in-window development, though it is a corporate/infrastructure move rather than a systemic market event, so it sits in the high-value but not groundbreaking band.

items.title: 民间DeepSeek Bot开源：一句话组建AI团队
items.content:
民间DeepSeek Bot开源：一句话组建AI团队

动察 Beating AI 快讯，独立开发者 FeiZ 开源了 DeepSeek Bot（DS Bot），这是一个基于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的非官方插件。安装后，用户可以创建多个分工不同的 Bot，为它们分别配置模型，让它们执行任务、互相协作。

每个 Bot 都有独立会话和长期记忆，可以记住用户偏好。对话过长时，插件会自动压缩上下文，还能搜索早期聊天记录。记忆以 Markdown 文件保存在本地，也支持团队共享。

首次使用时，系统会自带一个名为 Chief 的主管 Bot。只要告诉它需要哪些角色，它就能帮你创建其他 Bot 和群聊。群聊默认由管理员回复，再按需调用其他成员，避免所有 Bot 每次都参与，减少 Token 消耗。用户也可以直接 @ 指定成员。

插件还支持定时任务，以及按 Bot、模型查看 Token 用量。桌面端在插件页输入 `ds-bot` 即可安装，Web 端也能使用。

未来，作者还计划支持接入本地 Agent。项目采用 Apache 2.0 协议开源，目前仍处于早期阶段。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371307
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: An independent developer's open-source multi-agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness — useful for builders (per-bot memory, group chat orchestration, scheduled tasks, token accounting) but unofficial, early-stage, and without demonstrated ecosystem-wide impact. Fits the 'notable developer tool, not yet major' band rather than a lab-grade launch.
items.ai_summary: Independent developer FeiZ open-sourced DS Bot, an Apache 2.0 unofficial DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets users spin up multiple role-specific AI bots with individual models, long-term Markdown-based memory, group-chat collaboration, scheduled tasks and per-bot token usage tracking.

items.title: DATA Network to migrate to Sui, retire own chain
items.content:
DATA Network to migrate to Sui, retire own chain
The migration is backed by a $30 million investment from Sui Foundation.
DATA Network, formerly known as Story, is planning to retire its independent blockchain and move its AI training data protocol to Sui, backed by a $30 million investment from Sui Foundation.
The project’s Trace registry, which launched in June, will join the Sui ecosystem, while Walrus, a decentralized storage platform in the Sui ecosystem, will become the default storage layer for applications operated by DATA Foundation, its partners said on Monday.
Speaking to Cointelegraph, a DATA Foundation spokesperson said running a dedicated blockchain for a single use case meant carrying the costs of validators, network security and infrastructure.
“Building storage and access control at that scale ourselves would have meant rebuilding what Sui already has in Walrus and Seal,” they said.
The decision followed Story Foundation’s rebrand to DATA Foundation in June, pivoting from intellectual property licensing to building a “full stack for AI training data.” It also launched Trace to track the origin and licensing rights of training data.
As Trace grew to more than 270 million registrations in about four months, running an independent blockchain for one use case no longer made sense, the representative said.
The DATA Network will continue to operate until the upgrade is complete, and a detailed timeline and holder transition plan will be published prior to the upgrade, it said.
Asked how much Sui Foundation’s investment influenced the move, the representative said the $30 million investment was a separate part of the partnership.
DATA Network’s existing chain will continue operating until the upgrade is complete. The partners said a detailed timeline and holder transition plan would be published before the migration.
Related: Story Protocol rebrands to DATA Foundation in AI pivot
items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

items.title: 中国警方对宜信相关公司立案侦查，其旗下基金曾参与Circle、Figure等加密项目融资
items.content:
中国警方对宜信相关公司立案侦查，其旗下基金曾参与Circle、Figure等加密项目融资

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，中国北京市公安局朝阳分局发布警情通报，近期已依法对中国金融科技公司宜信相关公司涉嫌违法犯罪立案侦查。目前实际控制人唐某（男，53 岁）、赵某（女，51 岁）等多名犯罪嫌疑人已被依法采取刑事强制措施。警方提醒目前正全力开展案件侦办，请投资人积极配合调查取证，同时警惕不法分子以「提前兑付」等名义实施诈骗。

宜信（CreditEase）为中国金融科技公司，创始人为唐宁，早年经营 P2P 产品，旗下宜人贷曾登陆纽交所。今年 5 月 22 日起宜信全面停止旗下类固收产品兑付，启动所谓「良性清退」，涉资约 300 亿元，影响近 10 万名高净值客户。停兑四个多月后宜信近期向客户推送了致歉信，承认集团可能已资不抵债、偿债缺口较大。

宜信在财富管理与投资业务上布局较广，公开信息显示其旗下基金曾直接参与 Circle、Figure、Poko、Cashmere Wallet 等加密相关项目融资，并作为 LP 出资多家传统 VC 基金。宜信在新加坡拥有实体 CreditEase Asset Management (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.，持有 MAS 牌照，主要从事资产管理业务。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371306
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: A concrete in-window development: Beijing police (Chaoyang branch) formally opened a criminal investigation into CreditEase-related companies and placed actual controllers Tang (male, 53) and Zhao (female, 51) and several other suspects under criminal coercive measures. This escalates a large financial collapse (~RMB 30bn in halted quasi-fixed-income products affecting ~100k high-net-worth clients since the May 22 redemption freeze) from a 'benign wind-down' into a criminal case. Crypto relevance is indirect but real — CreditEase-affiliated funds were direct investors in Circle, Figure, Poko and Cashmere Wallet and LP'd into traditional VC funds, and it holds a MAS-licensed Singapore asset-management entity — so the case has transmission to crypto via distressed fund stakes and potential forced asset sales/liquidation. Not scored higher because the direct crypto-market and protocol exposure is peripheral and the bulk of the impact is in China's non-crypto wealth-management sector.
items.ai_summary: Beijing police have opened a criminal investigation into CreditEase-related companies, detaining founder Tang Ning (Tang) and other suspects, four months after the firm froze ~RMB 30bn of quasi-fixed-income redemptions for roughly 100,000 clients — a firm whose funds had invested in crypto projects including Circle and Figure.

For the IPO, I assume they're going to try to get everyone to focus on inference - which is profitable in isolation. But I don't know how they'll distract the market from the other ...

[scandox]: > In an interview with CNBC in 2021, Trainer acknowledged that “crazy stuff happens” and New Constructs doesn’t always get it right. > “I can’t let that bother me,” he said at the time. “I have to stay true to what I think is right.” Monkey remains true to darts, dartboard.

items.title: Yandex bot traffic down 99% after data center attack
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[gritzko]: This graph shows that Yandex Web crawler farm was hit. The other option, it was shut down to accommodate more critical services that got hit. (I worked for Yandex 20 years ago, one crawler guy was in the same room.) Not sure if troll farms got affected in any way, that is a different business entirely, no overlap. The interesting aspect is this: Yandex was taken from its owners semi-consensually. Similarly, the original owner of the troll farms was blown up in a business jet. He staged a muti...

[sznio]: I don't use X myself, but my friends told me there's a noticable reduction in hateful tweets, at least in the Polish sphere. Much less comments blaming Ukrainians for everything wrong with the world.

[xvxvx]: For those claiming a drop in hate speech on social media, I’ve yet to see examples of this. Plenty of claims, no examples.

[deanc]: There's a lot of ancedotes "I've seen hatespeech drop" etc. This is measurable and there are people measuring this kind of thing. Let's wait for some real data.

[yokoprime]: An important detail for those, like me, who have't kept up with the news: this was drone strike against a yandex data center, not cyber attack.
items.author: rooftopzen
items.ai_reason: A kinetic attack (drone strike, per commenters' clarification) on a Yandex data center with a measurable, externally verifiable consequence — Cloudflare Radar showing the Yandex web crawler's bot traffic collapsing ~99% over a 7-day window. It is a concrete, in-window infrastructure event with a hard data point rather than rumor, and the HN thread adds useful context on Yandex's crawler operations and governance history. However, the impact is confined to one company's crawler capacity and Russian internet infrastructure, with no clear transmission path to crypto markets, AI development, or global platform structure, so it sits at the interesting-but-not-urgent end. Discussion quality is moderate: technically informed first-hand context mixed with unverified anecdotes about hate-speech changes elsewhere.
items.ai_summary: Cloudflare Radar data shows Yandex's web crawler bot traffic fell roughly 99% after a drone strike damaged a Yandex data center.

items.content:
Alameda-Backed Bitcoin Miner Genesis Digital Raises About $900 Million for AI Data Center Pivot

Genesis Digital Assets, a bitcoin miner in which FTX’s Alameda Research invested more than $1 billion, is being converted into an AI data center business by new controlling shareholder SWI Group, the Wall Street Journal reported. SWI spent $500 million in June to buy a large stake and said on Oct. 12 it is raising 800 million euros, about $900 million, for upgrades and expansion. It plans to use Genesis sites in Texas, North and South Carolina and Sweden to supply computing power to large cloud providers, and to sell remaining Kazakhstan mining assets. — link

items.title: 富国银行正与与Kraken母公司Payward洽谈合作，或借助其拓展加密交易业务
items.content:
富国银行正与与Kraken母公司Payward洽谈合作，或借助其拓展加密交易业务

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，美国富国银行（Wells Fargo）正与加密交易平台 Kraken 母公司 Payward 洽谈合作，探讨由 Payward 为该银行的数字资产交易业务提供流动性支持。潜在合作将由 Payward 提供市场深度和交易执行支持，帮助富国银行扩大客户的加密资产交易渠道，而无需从零搭建完整的交易基础设施。

目前双方仍在谈判，尚未确定是否达成最终协议，双方均拒绝置评。富国银行此前已向符合条件的财富管理客户提供比特币现货 ETF，并投资了合规技术公司 Elliptic 和交易平台服务商 Talos，同时推进区块链存款计划、参与美元稳定币相关联盟。2026 年 9 月，纳斯达克宣布投资 Payward 1 亿美元，对其估值约为 210 亿美元，富国银行担任该交易的独家资本市场顾问。

此外，Payward 还被曝正与资产托管及服务巨头 BNY 洽谈更广泛的基础设施合作，潜在合作范围包括数字资产产品、托管、财富管理、交易及支付等业务。相关讨论同样尚未形成最终协议。Payward 正持续拓展传统金融业务布局。据报道，该公司还在寻求获得欧洲银行牌照，目标司法管辖区为立陶宛。2026 年 3 月，Kraken Financial 成为首家获得美联储支付基础设施接入权限的数字资产银行；Payward 此外还获得了迪拜虚拟资产监管局的授权。

items.title: French lawmakers back reporting rule for crypto wallets over $112K
items.content:
French lawmakers back reporting rule for crypto wallets over $112K
Holders could face fines of up to 10,000 euros for failing to declare qualifying assets.
French lawmakers have backed a proposal that would require holders of self-custodied crypto assets to report holdings equal or above 100,000 euros ($112,000) or face penalties.
The amendment, numbered I-CF821, was adopted by the National Assembly’s Finance Committee on Friday, and would introduce reporting requirements for crypto that isn’t held by a crypto-asset service provider, including assets stored in personal wallets.
The amendment would add a provision to France’s general tax code. Under the proposal, holders would be required to disclose holdings based on their value as of Dec. 31, and could face fines up to 10,000 euros for failing to declare.
The sponsors said the measure was intended to combat tax evasion, citing a parliamentary inquiry into the taxation of wealthy individuals, which found that crypto capital gains reached 3.5 billion euros in 2021, while only 400 million euros in crypto holdings were declared to tax authorities that year.
Proposal faces legislative hurdles
The amendment was introduced by Charles de Courson, Jean-Pierre Bataille and Michel Castellani, three members of France’s Liberties, Independents, Overseas and Territories (LIOT) parliamentary group.
The wallet disclosure measure was among five crypto-related amendments adopted by the Finance Committee last week.
Other proposals previously reported by Cointelegraph included imposing an exit tax on cryptocurrency holdings exceeding 800,000 euros when taxpayers move abroad and ending tax deferrals on conversions into fiat-backed stablecoins.
Related: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill
However, while the Finance Committee adopted the amendments on Friday, it subsequently rejected the revenue section of the broader 2027 budget bill by 31 votes to 3.
Lawmakers are scheduled to begin debating the revenue section of the budget in the National Assembly on Tuesday, starting from the government’s original draft.
The crypto amendments would need to be submitted again and approved during the parliamentary proceedings before becoming part of the legislation, according to French tech publication Clubic.

items.title: 前CFTC代理主席：无需国会立法，现有框架已足以监管加密市场
items.content:
前CFTC代理主席：无需国会立法，现有框架已足以监管加密市场

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，前美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）代理主席、现任 MoonPay 首席法务官兼首席行政官 Caroline Pham 表示，《商品交易法》赋予 CFTC 广泛的监管权限，现有监管框架无需等待国会立法，也能够覆盖加密资产等新兴商品领域。Pham 认为，CFTC 近期提出的规则有助于加强美国加密零售交易者的保护。

她指出，与由各州不同法律分别监管相比，将相关交易纳入受到严格监管的交易平台更有利于保护投资者。在稳定币与代币化存款方面，Pham 表示，代币化存款更适合批发金融市场。若一个交易日内所有交易均通过区块链实时原子结算，所需现金规模可能达到 15 万亿美元，而现有资金无法支持这一需求。银行目前通过净额结算抵消交易双方的应收应付款，因此代币化存款将在批发市场中发挥重要作用；稳定币则更适用于交易双方缺乏信任、需要降低结算风险的场景。

此外，Pham 预计，未来两年内，纽约证券交易所和纳斯达克将开始挂牌交易真正的代币化股票，并形成实质性的交易量。她强调，真正的代币化股票应保留股东投票权等权益，与未经发行公司批准的合成代币有所区别。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371301
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: This is commentary/opinion from a former CFTC acting chair (now MoonPay's chief legal officer) arguing that existing Commodity Exchange Act authority already suffices to regulate crypto without new congressional legislation. It contains no new regulatory action, rulemaking, or enforcement decision within the news window — just interpretation and forward-looking forecasts about tokenized stocks and tokenized deposits. Interesting for framing the US regulatory debate but not urgent or market-moving on its own.

items.title: 复旦邱锡鹏团队融超10亿，要做《Her》式AI助手
items.content:
复旦邱锡鹏团队融超10亿，要做《Her》式AI助手

动察 Beating AI 快讯，复旦大学教授邱锡鹏创办的模思智能，宣布完成超 10 亿元 Pre-A 轮融资，由华控基金领投，国开科创、上海科创基金等参投。公司成立于 2024 年底，由邱锡鹏的学生李世民担任 CEO。本轮资金将用于全模态实时交互技术研发及全球商业化。

模思想让 AI 在听懂人说话的同时，理解人的情绪和周围环境。比如在车里说一句「有点冷」，AI 要结合车内温度、说话人和过去的偏好，判断是否需要调空调。它还要知道什么时候该回应，什么时候应该保持沉默。

技术方面，团队已开源 MOSS-Audio 和 MOSS-VL-Realtime 等模型。前者可以分析声音中的情绪、识别不同说话人和环境音。后者能够持续观看视频，边看边回答，并根据画面变化修正回答。

目前，模思正在将语音、视觉、记忆和工具调用能力整合为 MOSS Live 实时交互系统，面向智能座舱、AI 硬件等场景。公司称已开展部分企业客户交付，长期目标是打造类似电影《Her》中的 AI 助手，让 AI 能持续理解用户所处的环境。

Star Xu: Hyperliquid's Matching Engine Is More Market Maker Friendly

OKX founder Star Xu said on the New Era Finance Podcast that Hyperliquid differs fundamentally from centralized order book exchanges in its technical design. While centralized exchanges process orders individually, Hyperliquid matches orders block by block and prioritizes cancellations within each block, allowing market makers to cancel orders ahead of takers. He believes this market maker friendly design explains why Hyperliquid's order book depth appears better than that of many centralized exchanges, while offering another approach for long-tail assets with limited liquidity. — link

items.title: Bitunix分析师：债券抛售改写利率预期，高收益率正替央行承担紧缩压力
items.content:
Bitunix分析师：债券抛售改写利率预期，高收益率正替央行承担紧缩压力

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，全球债券市场的抛售正在形成一种「市场先行紧缩」效应：长期债券收益率上升，推高房贷、企业融资与高收益债券成本。即使央行尚未再次加息，金融条件也已对经济需求形成压力。八个主要经济体利率掉期隐含的累计加息预期，已从 9 月高点 717 个基点降至约 539 个基点，减少 178 个基点，反映投资者开始衡量债市自身的紧缩效果，以及这是否可能降低央行后续加息的必要性。

但收益率上升并非单纯来自政策预期。美国 10 年期国债期限溢价升至约 0.98%，创 2014 年以来高点，显示投资者持有长期债券所要求的额外补偿增加；政府融资需求、财政风险与企业 AI 基础设施投资，共同加重长期债券收益率的上行压力。尽管近期美债拍卖需求有所改善，高收益率开始吸引买盘，却仍不足以消除市场对长期债务供给的疑虑。

通胀数据将决定这股紧缩能否取代进一步加息。野村预计，美国 9 月核心 CPI 月率上升 0.227%，低于 8 月的 0.290%；然而，汽油价格预计上涨 9.3%，可能推动整体 CPI 月率上升约 0.58%。若核心通胀降温、能源价格却推高整体物价，央行将面临经济承压与通胀黏性并存的两难局面。圣路易斯联储主席穆萨莱姆仍认为，未来六至九个月可能需要进一步收紧政策。

因此，关键不只是央行是否再次加息，而是债市已经收紧了多少，以及高融资成本能否真正冷却需求。若房地产市场、企业投资与消费逐步降温，政策利率未必需要大幅上调；但若能源通胀再度扩散，债市紧缩便可能与央行进一步加息同时发生，让经济承受更大的累积压力。

items.title: Meta如何造出爆款Muse？不到200人开发，100多项测试全部过关才上线
items.content:
Meta如何造出爆款Muse？不到200人开发，100多项测试全部过关才上线

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 在最新采访中谈起 Muse 的研发过程。这款能替用户办事的个人 AI Agent，从原型到上线花了七个月，负责模型和产品的核心团队不到 200 人。

今年年初，Anthropic 在编程 Agent 领域遥遥领先，业内不少人认为，编程才是高级 AI 最重要的应用方向。但王和前 GitHub CEO、现任 Meta AI 产品负责人 Nat Friedman 更看好个人 Agent。王认为，Meta 旗下应用每天有约 35 亿人使用，做面向普通人的 AI 产品才是公司的长处。

Meta 早在 2025 年就提出了「个人超级智能」的方向，OpenClaw 则让这一构想有了更具体的产品形态。今年 2 月，王和 Friedman 在深度体验 OpenClaw 后，分别向董事会提交备忘录。Friedman 写了两份，其中一份叫《Trust Is a Must》，强调个人 Agent 必须赢得用户信任。团队随后仅用一两周就拿出了 Muse 原型，连吉祥物 Jolly 和专属硬件 Muse Charm 的雏形都有了。不过，当时的产品很不稳定，偶尔能让人眼前一亮，大部分时候却连基本任务都做不好。

接下来几个月，团队反复调整模型。他们列出 100 多项必备能力，逐项设计测试，并设定上线门槛。有些模型版本已经通过约 80 项，剩下约 20 项仍不合格，只能继续训练。直到专门训练的 Muse Spark 1.3 版本全部达标，才过了这套评测。

Meta 高层把 Muse 视为全年最重要的产品之一，却始终没有大举扩充研发团队。王解释，大公司的产品很容易变成一堆人的想法拼在一起，每个产品经理都想往里面加点东西，最后做成一个大杂烩。Muse 从一开始就希望保持统一的产品体验，具体由 Friedman 主导把关。

王管理的 AI 研究团队也采用了类似的精简思路。他透露，自己目前有超过 200 名直属下属。TBD 团队的研究人员基本都直接向他汇报，中间没有层层设置人员管理岗位。各小组仍有技术负责人，负责决定技术方向。王坦言，自己算不上这 200 多人最好的管理者，但这些研究人员已经证明了自己的能力，不需要他事事过问，给他们足够的资源和自由就行。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371286

items.content:
高盛：上调12月布油价格预期至每桶90美元，维持2027年均价80美元的预期

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，高盛发布报告称，其维持基本预期，即中东供应将持续调整，最终推动原油价格回落，但冲突可能再度升级，仍构成显著的上行风险。高盛上调 12 月布油价格预期至每桶 90 美元，同时维持对 2027 年布伦特原油均价每桶 80 美元的预期，并预计 WTI 原油价格今年 12 月均价为每桶 81 美元、2027 年均价为每桶 73 美元。

高盛表示，如果 2027 年海湾地区平均日产量较 2026 年 2 月水平低 500 万桶，而非基本情景下的低 30 万桶，布伦特原油 2027 年均价可能达到每桶 125 美元左右。相反，如果 2027 年海湾地区平均日产量较 2026 年 2 月水平高出 100 万桶，布伦特原油价格在 2027 年可能跌至每桶 60 多美元。(金十)

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，本周全球市场将聚焦美国 9 月 CPI 数据，以检验美联储是否维持「非连续加息」立场。尽管多数官员认为年内可能再加息一次，但近期表态显示并不急于在连续会议上行动，市场对 10 月 28 日加息的定价已降至约 19%，而 12 月加息已被完全预期。地缘上，美伊僵持与也门局势升级仍支撑油价风险溢价，美俄柴油供应协议短期影响有限。重要事件一览如下：

周二： 

克利夫兰联储主席哈玛克发表讲话；

美联储理事沃勒在印度彭博新经济论坛发表讲话；

美国 9 月 NFIB 小型企业信心指数、至 9 月 26 日当周 ADP 就业人数、9 月成屋销售总数年化；

欧佩克公布月度原油市场报告。

周三： 

美国 9 月 CPI 及核心 CPI；

美联储公布经济状况褐皮书前密集发声；

波士顿联储主席柯林斯、美联储理事鲍曼发表讲话；

IEA 公布月度原油市场报告。

周四： 

美国至 10 月 9 日当周 API 原油库存；

美国至 10 月 10 日当周初请失业金人数、9 月零售销售、9 月 PPI 及核心 PPI、10 月纽约联储与费城联储制造业指数；

20 国集团财长和央行行长会议。

周五： 

美联储主席沃什出席曼谷 IMF 年会并与 IMF 总裁格奥尔基耶娃举行炉边谈话；

items.title: Papertrade参与交易资金仅剩640万美元，24小时大减近7成
items.content:
Papertrade参与交易资金仅剩640万美元，24小时大减近7成

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，据官网数据，基于 HyperEVM 的合成永续协议 Papertrade 自周六晚间上线至今已 36 小时，在经历上线初期的火爆后目前交易遇冷，成交量与未平仓合约大幅下滑。平台累计名义成交额超 7700 亿美元，TVL 现报 6260 万美元，24 小时跌幅 37%；未平仓合约头寸 5.1 亿美元，较 24 小时前的 33 亿美元大幅减少约 85%；全部现有仓位对应的保证金金额仅剩 640 万美元，较 24 小时前的 2029 万美元大幅减少约 70%。

Papertrade 是部署在 HyperEVM 上的全链上合成永续交易平台，价格读取 Hyperliquid 订单簿 BBO 中间价，用户直接与协议 LP 作为对手盘，而非走传统订单簿撮合。协议主打高杠杆、零滑点、无资金费率。原生代币 PAPER 初始供应为零，无预挖、团队或 VC 份额，唯一铸造来源是用户亏损或清算；上线初期代币不可自由转账，主要用于质押。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371282
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: New data on a freshly launched protocol (Papertrade on HyperEVM) showing a dramatic post-launch cooldown: open interest down ~85% (from $3.3B to $510M) and remaining position margin down ~70% (from $20.29M to $6.4M) within 36 hours, with TVL falling 37%. This is materially interesting and concrete, and the protocol's unusual design (on-chain synthetic perps, LP as counterparty, zero slippage, no funding rate, token minted only via user losses) adds novelty. However, it is a single new/small protocol's activity decline rather than an exploit, insolvency, or market-structure event with wider transmission, so it sits above routine updates but below high-value systemic news.
items.ai_summary: Papertrade, a newly launched on-chain synthetic perpetuals protocol on HyperEVM, saw trading activity collapse within 36 hours of going live, with open interest down roughly 85% to $510M, position margin down about 70% to $6.4M, and TVL down 37% to $62.6M.

items.title: Based联创回应卡数据泄露事件：已通知监管机构并报警，交易钱包及App未受影响
items.content:
Based联创回应卡数据泄露事件：已通知监管机构并报警，交易钱包及App未受影响

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，Based 联创 Edison 发文表示，针对近期发生的卡数据泄露事件，团队合规与运营部门已开始联系并回复受影响用户，并已向新加坡个人资料保护委员会（PDPC）及相关监管机构通报，同时向警方报案，目前正与执法部门合作调查。Edison 表示，卡业务目前仍正常运行，Based 交易钱包和 App 未受到影响。

该钱包采用自托管模式，平台不持有用户私钥；社交登录功能由 Privy 提供支持，用户仍可继续使用 Based 进行交易。针对外界关于「五个月前管理员后台泄露」的讨论，Edison 称，该后台与此次卡数据泄露事件无关，且未包含任何用户数据。

该后台属于团队于 2026 年 3 月测试的一款托管版 OpenClaw 产品早期开发版本，仅供内部小范围测试，后续决定不予上线并已停止开发。Edison 表示，团队当前重点包括持续支持受影响用户、进一步加强安全控制与监控体系，以及继续打造更优质的交易体验。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371279
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: A confirmed user card-data breach at Based, with the co-founder disclosing that Singapore's PDPC and other regulators were notified and a police report filed, and law enforcement is investigating. This is a concrete in-window development with regulatory escalation, but the impact is limited to card data — the self-custody trading wallet and app are unaffected and no user funds or private keys are at stake, so it sits below an exploit-grade event. The response also distinguishes the incident from an unrelated five-month-old admin backend leak (a discontinued custodial OpenClaw test product).
items.ai_summary: Based's co-founder said the platform has notified Singapore's PDPC and other regulators and filed a police report over a card data leak, while stating that card operations continue and the self-custody trading wallet and app were unaffected.

items.content:
OpenAI Pro额度投票结果出炉：更多人不想恢复5小时限制

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 产品与平台主管 Tibo 此前发起的 Pro 额度投票结束，共有超过 24 万次投票。37.8% 选择维持现有周额度、不恢复 5 小时限制；33.2% 愿意恢复限制，换取每周额度翻倍；另外 29% 只想查看结果。

Tibo 坦言，这个结果让他很意外。他原本以为 Pro 100、200、500 用户会更倾向于双倍周额度，哪怕要恢复 5 小时限制。目前 OpenAI 还没有宣布是否会调整额度规则。

items.title: OpenAI28天冲刺Day7：Sol默认上下文扩至50万，订阅免长上下文加价
items.content:
OpenAI28天冲刺Day7：Sol默认上下文扩至50万，订阅免长上下文加价

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 产品与平台主管 Thibault Sottiaux 公布 28 天产品冲刺的 Day 7。GPT-6.1 Sol 在 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 中的默认上下文从 27.2 万 token 提升至 50 万，增幅约 80%。更大的窗口可以减少长任务中自动压缩上下文的次数，让模型保留更多此前的对话和任务细节。

Sottiaux 表示，这个默认值经过了专门测试。用户仍可以自行调高或调低，最高支持 100 万 token。此前模型已经支持手动设置更大的上下文，这次提高的是默认值。

同时，OpenAI 不再对使用 ChatGPT 订阅额度的 GPT-6.1 Sol 收取长上下文附加费。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371276
items.author: theblockbeats
items.ai_reason: Concrete but incremental product update from a leading lab: GPT-6.1 Sol's default context in Codex and ChatGPT Work rises ~80% (272k→500k tokens, up to 1M manually), and OpenAI drops the long-context surcharge for subscription usage. This has real developer-workflow and cost implications (fewer auto-compressions on long tasks, no extra fee), but it is a default-value and pricing tweak rather than a new model or capability jump — high-signal for Codex users, not industry-reshaping.
items.ai_summary: OpenAI's 28-day sprint Day 7 raised GPT-6.1 Sol's default context window in Codex and ChatGPT Work from 272k to 500k tokens and removed the long-context surcharge for subscription-based usage.

items.title: Karpathy：60亿人几乎没用过AI，仅5000人接触内部顶级模型
items.content:
Karpathy：60亿人几乎没用过AI，仅5000人接触内部顶级模型

动察 Beating AI 快讯，目前在 Anthropic 预训练团队工作的 Andrej Karpathy 再次谈到公众对 AI 能力的认知差距。他认为，这种差距正在扩大，已经从两类用户各说各话，变成了一条越来越陡的漏斗。

按照他的粗略估算，全球约 60 亿人（75%）几乎没接触过大模型。约 10 亿至 20 亿人只是偶尔使用免费聊天机器人，把 AI 当成搜索或写作工具。再往上，约 2000 万人（0.2%）在编程、数学等专业领域使用前沿模型。他们已经看到，过去需要数周甚至数月的复杂项目，现在可以交给 Agent 完成。

最顶端则是约 5000 人（0.00006%）。他们能够在内部接触最前沿的 AI 系统。Karpathy 描述的前沿能力包括数千个 Agent 持续协作数周、自动发现零日漏洞、以机器速度开展网络攻防，以及推进数学研究。他认为，人类审核和理解这些成果的速度已经开始跟不上。

Karpathy 将差距归结为三个原因：用户面对的问题规模不同；AI 在编程、数学等容易验证结果的领域进步更快；免费版、付费版与内部系统存在能力和访问门槛差异。普通人可能还觉得 AI 只是个经常犯错的聊天机器人，一小部分专业人士却已经开始让它承担大型项目。

items.content:
月之暗面（Kimi）IPO前谈和解，旧案索赔或超7亿美元

动察 Beating AI 快讯，路透社独家披露，月之暗面高管正就与前公司循环智能（Recurrent.ai）及其投资人的纠纷商谈和解，希望在赴港 IPO 前解决持续近两年的仲裁争议。目前尚不清楚双方能否达成协议。

纠纷涉及月之暗面创始人杨植麟和 CTO 张宇韬。他们曾于 2016 年共同创办循环智能。根据路透社看到的律师函，循环智能及部分投资人指控两人未经董事会授权成立月之暗面，并向原公司投资人提供不实信息。律师函还指控，包含大模型关键数据的服务器曾被擅自转移，另有部分数据遭删除。月之暗面总裁张予彤的持股安排也受到质疑。路透社未能独立核实这些指控。杨植麟此前称创业已取得必要批准，代理律师也表示案件缺乏事实和法律依据。

月之暗面创立时，循环智能获配 9.5% 的初始股权。现在，循环智能及部分投资人要求相当于月之暗面初始股本 10.5% 的补偿。知情人士按照月之暗面今年 6 月融资时 300 亿美元的估值估算，潜在价值可能超过 7 亿美元。月之暗面已秘密递交香港 IPO 申请。知情人士认为纠纷暂时不会直接阻止上市，但若迟迟无法解决，股权归属和信息披露仍可能成为障碍。

Sui基金会向DATA Network投资3000万美元，AI训练数据协议将迁移至Sui

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，Sui 基金会宣布向 DATA Network 投资 3000 万美元，作为战略合作的一部分，该 AI 训练数据协议将加入 Sui 技术栈并与链上数据存储平台 Walrus 整合。根据安排 Sui 基金会将成为 DATA Network 最大的机构持有者，与现有利益相关方 PIP Labs 和 DATA Foundation 并列。DATA Network 将升级为在 Sui 上原生运行的协议，其独立链将被退役，现有 DATA 代币按 1:1 迁移至 Sui。过渡完成前原网络继续运营，基金会将在升级前发布详细时间表。Walrus 将成为 DATA Foundation 运营应用的默认存储层。

DATA Foundation 于今年 6 月从通用知识产权基础设施转向 AI 训练数据，其 6 月推出的 Trace 追踪 AI 训练数据的来源和使用权，并向数据贡献者结算付款。自推出以来，Trace 注册表已记录超 2.5 亿次贡献，目前日均处理超 300 万张收据。Mysten Labs 联合创始人兼首席产品官表示，AI 行业已到达开放互联网被读完的阶段，下一个前沿是对经同意且具备监管所需来源证明的数据集的访问；DATA Network 和 Trace 迁移至其技术栈，将带来已服务全球前沿 AI 实验室的大量高质量、权利清晰的数据。

items.title: Aave’s USDG rollover plan has a yield below most quoted borrowing rates
items.content:
Quick Take
- LlamaRisk’s October assessment puts February PT yield below USDT0, USDC and USDG borrowing rates, with GHO the cheaper exception.
- In the dated illustration, higher leverage turns the negative spread on borrowed funds into a negative overall return before rewards and costs.
- October Wallet bonus terms name the October token. February rewards need separate terms; OKX must also implement the rollover integration.
Aave’s proposed USDG rollover would let borrowers carry their stablecoin debt into a new fixed-yield USDG position, but the replacement collateral currently yields less than three quoted borrowing rates. That leaves leverage and separately administered rewards central to whether extending the trade makes financial sense.
The proposal concerns Pendle principal tokens, or PTs, on the X Layer network: holders of the token maturing Oct. 29 would move into a replacement maturing Feb. 25, 2027. In its Oct. 8 assessment, risk provider LlamaRisk said the February token’s on-chain yield alone fell short of USDT0, USDC and USDG borrowing costs. GHO was the cheaper exception in that assessment’s Oct. 7 snapshot.
TokenLogic’s proposal would enable a flash-loan transaction that temporarily repays debt, replaces the old PT collateral, borrows again and repays the flash loan. OKX would develop that integration separately. The Aave listing and separate OKX integration would both need to be implemented.
An Oct. 10 refresh preserves the gap. Pendle’s market API reported a February PT implied annual percentage yield of about 2.98%, with data updated at 21:09 UTC. Aave’s X Layer market display, retrieved at 21:11 UTC, showed variable borrowing APYs of 4.12% for USDT0, 5.87% for USDC and 3.75% for USDG.
The readings show why transaction convenience and investment profitability are separate questions: a rollover can preserve access to borrowing while resetting the collateral’s yield at the new purchase price.
A Pendle PT is a discounted claim on an accounting asset at maturity. For this USDG market, LlamaRisk describes redemption as one PT for one USDG. The purchase discount determines the return from holding to maturity, while ordinary PT holders give up the underlying variable yield and points to the corresponding yield token, or YT, under Pendle’s mechanics.
Borrowing to buy more PT increases exposure to that discount. The strategy earns positive incremental carry when the acquired PT return exceeds its financing cost. When borrowing costs exceed the asset’s return, each additional borrowed increment reduces the position’s return before rewards and costs.
That relationship looked different in LlamaRisk’s August review. Using Aug. 18 data for the October maturity, it quoted a 3.19% PT yield against borrowing rates of 0.45% for GHO, 1.37% for USDT0 and 2.69% for USDG. The review described positive carry.
The Oct. 7 snapshot for the February replacement quoted a 2.79% PT yield against 4.48% USDT0, 4.10% USDC and 3.67% USDG borrowing rates. GHO, at 0.93%, still borrowed below the PT yield. The comparisons span different maturities; existing October PT holders retain their original purchase yield.
There is also a distinction between a quoted funding comparison and an allowed borrowing route. LlamaRisk’s recommended new Aave borrowing category, E-Mode 9, lists USDT0, GHO and USDC as borrowable assets. USDG is absent from that proposed list, so its rate provides a cost comparison rather than proof of eligibility for the February configuration.
How leverage and rewards change returns
The 2.98% annualized PT yield corresponds to about 1.11% gross appreciation over the roughly 137.1 days from the Oct. 10 snapshot to Feb. 25. The annual figure should not be mistaken for the cash return available over that shorter holding period.
A standalone PT-and-debt illustration shows how leverage changes the outcome. It holds the displayed borrowing APYs constant through maturity, excludes rewards, transaction costs and retained YT, and assumes no rebalancing. Two times exposure means assets equal twice starting equity and debt equals that equity; five times exposure means debt equals four times starting equity.
Using the APY convention in Pendle’s calculation documentation, the illustration converts each annualized rate into a return over the same holding period. It then subtracts the debt’s interest cost from the PT position’s appreciation.
| Funding comparison | Borrow APY, Oct. 10 | Return on equity at 2x exposure | Return on equity at 5x exposure | 
|---|---|---|---|
| USDT0 | 4.12% | +0.69% | -0.56% | 
| USDC | 5.87% | +0.05% | -3.11% | 
| USDG, comparator only | 3.75% | +0.83% | -0.02% | 
The table shows illustrative total returns through Feb. 25. Without borrowing, the same PT position earns about 1.11% before costs. At two times exposure, the return on the investor’s own capital can still cover the negative spread on the borrowed portion. At five times exposure, financing consumes more than the gross PT gain in all three examples.
Actual borrowing rates can change throughout the holding period. Actual purchase prices also determine effective PT yield, and the Oct. 8 assessment listed 0.05% taker fees for the February pool’s AMM and orderbook. Slippage, network fees and any applicable flash-loan charge further affect the transaction. A thin positive result can disappear after execution costs.
LlamaRisk attributes participating loop users’ profitability to external OKX Exchange Earn incentives. It also says an end to those incentives would likely encourage users to unwind.
The public OKX Wallet bonus announcement describes a separate program. It names USDG Loop or PT-USDG-29OCT2026 supplied to Aave through the designated Wallet campaign page, with bonus APY capped at 2%. Transactions through Aave or other third-party websites do not qualify.
The Wallet campaign ends Oct. 28 at 15:00 UTC+8, or 07:00 UTC, with rewards claimable afterward. Distribution depends on eligible participants’ deposit shares, and the actual payout may be below the announced 490,000 USDT reward pool.
Those terms cover the October token. February reward eligibility and the separate Exchange Earn expiry require their own terms.
The standalone illustration also differs from an actual OKX Wallet product. Its Loop FAQ says PT Loop can leave YT separately in the user’s wallet, outside the displayed Loop position value. Those retained tokens, product rewards and execution costs must be included when assessing the wallet’s total return.
OKX Wallet’s FAQ also says a PT position does not automatically redeem, unwind, renew or roll over at maturity. PT promotional rewards stop then under those Wallet rules, and a new-term subscription depends on product availability.
Rollover limits and the October exit
LlamaRisk’s Oct. 8 recommendation also differs from the initial plan. It calls for new E-Mode 9, with a 91.48% loan-to-value limit, a 93.48% liquidation threshold and a 35 million PT supply cap. The existing E-Mode 7 threshold cited in the assessment is 94.66%. A position carried into the replacement configuration would therefore need to fit its recommended borrowing and liquidation limits if those parameters are implemented.
LlamaRisk reported 66.03 million October PT units supplied as collateral in its Oct. 8 review. The Aave display retrieved Oct. 10 showed 59.79 million October PT units supplied and $61.12 million of borrowing across the entire X Layer market. The borrowing figure covers the entire market, while the collateral figures cover October PT only.
A Sept. 9 borrower review reported 55.1 million USDT0 debt, representing 98.7% of the reviewed PT cohort’s debt, and a median health factor of 1.03 among top suppliers. That September snapshot shows how heavily the reviewed cohort relied on USDT0 and how little room its top suppliers had before liquidation.
The February pool had approximately $1.42 million of reported liquidity. A migration’s executable size depends on available quotes and acceptable slippage.
The proposed October PT loan-to-value reduction to zero after maturity concerns borrowing headroom. Under Aave’s liquidation mechanics, eligibility depends on health factor falling below one, with collateral value, debt and liquidation thresholds determining that factor.
The choice at the October maturity is consequently an economic one as well as an operational one. A borrower can preserve debt exposure through a supported migration only if the configuration and integration are available. Whether extending the position pays depends on the new entry price, actual funding costs, leverage and reward eligibility, rather than the ability to move collateral in one transaction.

items.content:
Liquid Network Keeps Bitcoin Redemptions Frozen, Reserve Gap About 603 BTC

Liquid Network is running again, but peg-outs that convert L-BTC back to bitcoin remain suspended, with a reserve gap of about 603 BTC. Liquid said redemptions will not resume until reserves fully back all circulating L-BTC and security reviews are complete. A Sept. 6 Elements bug allowed unauthorized L-BTC creation and redemption. About 3,996 to 4,000 BTC left the federation reserve, then worth about $320 million. White-hat actors returned about 3,400 BTC on Sept. 7, leaving 598 to 603 BTC unreturned. As of Oct. 11, peg-outs remain paused. Blockstream CEO Adam Back said the 1:1 peg will ultimately be covered, with no date given. — link

items.title: 分析：行情下跌叠加BTC筹码派发未必可怕，熊牛过渡阶段潜在卖盘得以提前释放
items.content:
分析：行情下跌叠加BTC筹码派发未必可怕，熊牛过渡阶段潜在卖盘得以提前释放

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，分析师 Murphy 表示，数据显示 10 月 7 日至 8 日长期持有者（LTH）累计向交易平台转入约 3.2 万枚 BTC。这是自今年 2 月 5 日大跌后，第 2 大 LTH（长期持有者）单日转入规模，大概率是潜在的卖出意图。不过这 3.2 万枚 BTC 并不能全部视为 LTH 的主动派发。

同一时期美国政府相关钱包向 Coinbase Prime 转入约 1.72 万枚 BTC，考虑到 Coinbase Prime 是美国法警署指定的官方托管和交易服务商，因此，这笔转账并不必然意味着卖出，也可能与资产托管整合或案件处置有关。剔除这部分特殊转账后，剩余约 1.48 万枚才是更需要关注的潜在抛压，主要来自币龄 6-12 个月及 3-5 年的长期筹码。

在熊牛过渡期，LTH 日均向交易平台转入 2000-3000 枚 BTC，通常属于正常范围。一旦转入量突然大幅超过均值，往往伴随着特殊事件或行预期偏空。但「行情下跌叠加 LTH 筹码派发」未必如此是坏事，尤其是在熊牛过渡阶段。从实体调整后的 CDD（币天销毁量）数据来看，每当行情回调且 CDD 大幅上升，往往意味着部分沉寂已久的筹码开始活跃，甚至选择离场。但事后看下跌虽然带来了短期抛压，却也促使部分不坚定的筹码完成换手。潜在的卖盘提前释放，反而为后续行情减轻阻力。

从另一个角度来看，这也是牛市进程中，长期沉淀的筹码逐渐被激活、换手活跃度不断提升的一种表现。所以不必对每一次 LTH 派发都过度担忧。真正值得关注的是这些筹码能否被市场有效承接。毕竟一轮牛市不可能只有买入而没有卖出。老筹码持续释放，新资金不断承接，本身就是市场完成价值再发现的过程。充分的筹码换手，反而是一轮行情能够走得更远的重要基础。

items.title: XRP Ledger defends emergency patch for unlimited XRP bug
items.content:
XRP Ledger defends emergency patch for unlimited XRP bug
The XRP Ledger Foundation pushed back against claims that its emergency security patch was forced on network operators.
XRP Ledger developers have defended the emergency security patch used to fix a bug capable of creating XRP beyond the network’s fixed supply, saying they could not wait for the network’s usual two-week validator vote without exposing the flaw to attackers.
The fix, released on Sept. 25, came three days after a bug bounty report, and took effect immediately on any server that installed it. It was the first deliberate bypass of the normal amendment process since the system was introduced more than ten years ago, they said.
“With a normal amendment vote, the fix would have been public for weeks before it took effect, risking network security,” XRPL developers said in an X post on Sunday.
The expedited fix led to questions about XRPL’s level of decentralization. On its website, XRPL claims it is a fully decentralized, public blockchain — a characterization that has been central to arguments that its native token, XRP, is not a security.
XRPL security fix “raised a lot of questions”
Cyber Capital founder Justin Bons said Thursday that marketing XRP to retail investors as decentralized amounted to “straight-up fraud.” He argued that the Sept. 25 emergency release shipped as binaries only, temporarily withheld the source code and pressured operators to upgrade.
However, XRPL Foundation said the decision to skip the normal amendment process was made jointly by the Foundation, RippleX, core developers and validators after assessing the severity of the bug.
“No single party could make that call alone. Every validator and node operator chooses what software to run, and 3.4.1 only became required through a normal amendment vote with more than 80% validator support for two weeks. Protocol changes still go through amendments,” the foundation said.
Related: Ledger confirms unauthorized hardware implant, says losses may exceed $86M
XRP Kuwait, an independent validator operator, also rejected claims that the coordinated upgrades signaled centralized control.
“We disagree with the claim that operators coordinating an update is, in itself, proof of centralized control,” it said. “Coordination is not the same as control. Independent operators can assess a situation, communicate with one another, and reach the same conclusion without giving up their independence.”
Bug could have minted unlimited XRP
The bug was an integer overflow in the XRP Ledger’s payment engine that had been present since 2015, according to the project’s vulnerability disclosure report.
XRP balances are stored as 64-bit integers with a fixed maximum. When a sum exceeded that maximum, the calculation wrapped to a smaller number instead of failing.
An attacker could exploit this by creating hundreds of specially priced offers, each asking for a very large amount of XRP, then sending one payment that consumed them all.
The engine would credit each offer owner their full amount but charge the buyer only the tiny wrapped total. The difference would be newly created, spendable XRP.
The attack required deliberately constructed offers and could not be triggered by normal trading activity, according to the report. Developers said they found no evidence that the issue was exploited on any public network.
Magazine: Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds ’18 trillion XRP’ bug: Hodler’s Digest

items.title: Coinbase用内部数据微调Qwen3.5-9B，反欺诈表现超越前沿大模型
items.content:
Coinbase用内部数据微调Qwen3.5-9B，反欺诈表现超越前沿大模型

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong 在社交媒体发文表示，公司利用专有内部数据对开源模型 Qwen3.5-9B 进行微调后，在反欺诈这一专项任务上表现优于前沿大模型，且成本更低、速度更快。相关图表显示，该后训练模型在精度、召回率、F1 及金额加权召回率等指标上均显著领先，对比未适配版本与 Opus 4.5 决策代理均有提升；线上推理中位延迟较 Opus 4.5 降低约 55%。

Armstrong 认为，前沿模型虽为出色的通用型选手，但在更窄的任务上，专业微调模型将越来越多地胜出，无论是独立运行还是协同工作。Coinbase 正为内部员工简化微调流程，并已在内部工具中提供一键启动指令，未来部分后端服务或可被此类架构完全替代。

items.title: XRP Ledger基金会澄清安全修复疑问：未增发XRP，供应量仍固定
items.content:
XRP Ledger基金会澄清安全修复疑问：未增发XRP，供应量仍固定

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 12 日，XRP Ledger 基金会（XRPLF）在社交媒体发文，针对近期 xrpld 3.4.1 安全修复引发的疑问与误解进行澄清。基金会明确表示，本次修复的漏洞并非导致增发 XRP，XRP 总供应量自账本上线起即固定为 1000 亿枚，任何交易都无法创造更多代币；该漏洞是绕过相关规则的路径，已在两周前的 3.4.1 版本中修复。账本数据完全公开，当前实际流通约 999.86 亿枚 XRP（因手续费销毁呈通缩），社区与基金会均已持续核验供应情况，未发现异常。

该漏洞需通过数百次刻意构造的操作才能触发，普通支付无法触及，且由 Cayden Liao 与 Veria AI 通过 AI 发现并负责任报告。为避免公开修复后在修正案投票期间暴露攻击面，XRPLF、RippleX、核心开发者与验证者通过社会共识优先向默认 UNL 验证者分发修复版本并于 9 月 25 日发布公开二进制文件；后续仍通过正常修正案投票（超 80% 支持持续两周）使 3.4.1 成为必要版本。基金会表示将进一步加强形式化验证、AI 对抗测试与漏洞赏金计划。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/371255

The disclosure details a substantive protocol-level security issue requiring hundreds of deliberately crafted operations, discovered with AI assistance (Cayden Liao and Veria AI), patched via coordinated distribution to default UNL validators on Sept 25 and ratified through an amendment vote exceeding 80% support. High-value protocol security and governance content, but capped below 8.5 because no funds were lost, the bug was never exploited, and the fix itself predates the window — this is the foundation's clarification.

items.title: Whatever became of holography? (2011)
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[adastra22]: Very few people in the comments seem to understand what holography is. A hologram is not a “3D display” that mimics a sci-fi movie or TV show. A hologram is photographic media / display technology that records and transmits phase as well as intensity of incident photons. By capturing all the properties of the electromagnetic field that strikes the film, and re-emitting the same EM wave when stimulated, the hologram ends up being a full “3D picture” because after all, the light that hits ...

[ubj]: Dan Smalley's research lab at BYU is actively developing 3D volumetric holography technology.  https://youtu.be/N12i_FaHvOU  The video is a bit old, but it has a few fun demos of the capabilities they've developed.

[midnitewarrior]: I wanted to pick up doing holography again, but I discovered that Integraf, founded by legend TJ (  https://www.integraf.com/about/tung-h-jeong  ), stopped selling the film and supplies. Much of the supply chain for modern hobbyist holography was sourced out of Russia, and the ongoing wars have made those materials unavailable. There are some newer processes out there, but there were probably thousands of us that grew up using those HoloKit holography kits distributed by TJ.

[Nition]: I went to a whole art exhibition of holograms as a kid that blew me away, and I've always wondered why holograms are so rare ever since. I had one for a while, the famous one of the microsope with the lens that you can actually look through to see a computer chip inside. There's nothing else like it.

[tootie]: I had the opportunity to work with a lenticular display a few years back. Just takes an HDMI input and can render a 3d scene like you'd build in Unity and you'd be able to see at least a range of aspects of the image at once by looking from different angles. Not fully 360 but maybe 90 degrees of perspective at once. It was neat but we spent weeks trying to make an impressive demo and none of it was fun for more than 5 seconds.

The comment thread is substantive — clarifying what a hologram physically is (phase and intensity recording), pointing to BYU's volumetric display work, and noting the collapse of hobbyist film supply chains — but the discussion is retrospective and carries no market, protocol, or technology-shift impact.

items.title: Starknet considers leaving Ethereum for a quantum-resistant Layer 1
items.content:
Quick Take
- Starknet says it is actively considering an independent Layer 1 and targets quantum resistance in 2027.
- StarkWare’s roadmap separates changes within Starknet’s control from bridge and data dependencies inherited from Ethereum.
- An October 11 CoinGlass snapshot showed STRK up 116.7% in seven days, ahead of an October 15 unlock allowing up to 127 million tokens.
Starknet's STRK token more than doubled over seven days while developers considered leaving Ethereum to build an independent Layer 1 blockchain.
A CoinGlass snapshot checked at 20:28 UTC on Oct. 11 showed STRK at $0.1190, up 17.7% over 24 hours and 116.7% over seven days.
On Oct. 8, Starknet said it was actively considering becoming an L1, with 2027 as its target for what it described as the first fully quantum-resistant network. The proposed move would replace its dependence on Ethereum's underlying security infrastructure.
Starknet considers Ethereum independence to accelerate quantum protection
StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson has framed the potential transition as a response to growing concerns that advances in quantum computing and artificial intelligence could undermine existing blockchain cryptography.
In an X post, Ben-Sasson argued that the quantum threat could arrive sooner than expected and that increasingly powerful AI added urgency to preparations. The debate follows recent AI-assisted advances in mathematical research.
His argument concerns preparing for a cryptographically relevant quantum computer; it does not demonstrate that AI can already break deployed blockchain signatures.
Starknet's ZK-STARK proof system relies on hash-based cryptographic assumptions rather than the elliptic-curve mechanisms vulnerable to sufficiently powerful quantum computers.
The network also supports programmable accounts, letting users adopt alternative signature schemes without a network-wide upgrade.
In June, StarkWare published a three-phase roadmap covering vulnerable hashing mechanisms, legacy smart contracts and dependencies inherited from Ethereum. The first two phases are within Starknet's control; the third depends on Ethereum's migration.
Starknet currently operates as an Ethereum Layer 2, processing transactions separately while relying on Ethereum for settlement and data availability. Its bridge infrastructure and Ethereum-based data commitments therefore remain exposed to cryptographic dependencies outside Starknet's direct control.
In September, the Ethereum Foundation's Protocol cluster set a December 2029 target for quantum resistance across Ethereum's execution, consensus and data layers.
An independent Starknet would need its own security and settlement model to replace the protections Ethereum provides. The Oct. 8 announcement expresses consideration and a quantum-resistance target, rather than an approved migration timetable.
STRK futures turnover reaches $3.5 billion in 24 hours
In the same Oct. 11 snapshot, CoinGlass data showed approximately $258.5 million in futures open interest and $3.5 billion in 24-hour futures volume. It also reported about $14.8 million in total futures liquidations over 24 hours.
CoinMarketCap data checked on Oct. 11 showed approximately $720 million in 24-hour trading volume against a market capitalization of about $892 million.
The rally comes ahead of an Oct. 15 token unlock. Tokenomist data lists the date, while Starknet's published vesting schedule allows up to 127 million STRK to unlock each month for early contributors and investors through March 2027.
At the Oct. 11 CoinGlass price, the maximum tranche would be worth about $15.1 million and equal 1.27% of Starknet's original 10 billion-token supply. The unlock makes previously restricted tokens transferable; it does not establish how many recipients will sell.
StarkNet Token is +13.58% over the past 24 hours and currently sits at rank #72 by market cap.

items.title: Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds ’18 trillion XRP’ bug: Hodler’s Digest
items.content:
Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds ’18 trillion XRP’ bug: Hodler’s Digest
A user reports buying a tampered Ledger from a big retailer in Europe. Security researchers use AI to uncover a “$94 billion” XRP bug — but receive just a $250K bounty.
Ledger implant exploit reportedly spreads to Europe after $93.4 million in losses from Asian reseller
A tampered Ledger attack that has already seen an estimated $93.4 million taken from Asian hardware wallet users, has reportedly spread to Europe. 
X user Johannes has presented photographs of a tampered Ledger he said he purchased two weeks ago from the European consumer electronics chain MediaMarkt. The implant inside appears to be an earlier version of the one found linked to CryptoBilis shipped devices in Asia, and no funds have been taken. 
“Either the device didn’t work, or they were waiting for a more widespread usage of the compromised devices,” he said. Former Mt Gox CEO Mark Karpeles, whose investigations into the tampered Asian Ledgers helped bring the problem to light, said the antenna in the device says it is the “Eurasian version” suggesting separate versions of the implant have been sent to regions that use different mobile frequencies. Ledger has not confirmed the reported European device is part of the same attack.
[Update Oct.12 9.05PM UTC: Johannes said he found another implant in a second device purchased from a different MediaMarkt outlet, suggesting the problem is more widespread.]
“PSA the ledger incident isn’t limited to Asia,” wrote European X user Johannes. Source: Johannes.
The sophisticated attack hit Ledger devices in Asia late last week, after devices from the official reseller CryptoBilis — which had recently been sold to a new owner — were found to be modified in a way that apparently enable attackers to read the seed phrase and steal funds even as though the device is still able to pass authenticity checks.
Ledger has asked CryptoBilis to suspend sales and shipments of its devices as a precaution and advised customers who had purchased devices from the reseller within the past 90 days to consider transferring their assets to a new Ledger. “The volume of impacted devices is limited,” it said in its most recent update today.
CryptoBilis is listed as an authorized Ledger reseller in Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines. Cybersecurity outlet Yfarmx estimated the losses at $93.4 million across 471 addresses, but this figure has not been confirmed by Ledger.
Security firm uncovers XRP minting bug
Security firm Veria Labs has been paid a $250,000 bug bounty for uncovering an overflow bug hidden in XRP’s code since 2015. It claims that a single transaction could have printed trillions of XRP out of thin air.
The bug has been patched (amid some controversy) and there is no evidence it had ever been exploited.
Cayden Liao, Veria Labs security co-founder, wrote on X that its AI agent had combed through rippled, the software that runs the XRP Ledger and found two low severity bugs. It worked out how to create a much larger exploit by using them in conjunction. Liao said that just one exploit transaction could have created more than 18 trillion XRP, which is 184 times greater than the total supply.
“This puts the full $94B at risk, more than 60 times the largest crypto hack on record,” he wrote, referring to XRP’s entire market cap. “We suspect one reason nobody caught this vulnerability is that it chains together two bugs that would be low severity on their own.” The bugs were reported on September 22 and RippleX patched them three days later.
Source: Cayden Liao
Vitalik Buterin backs crypto ‘bunker mode’ amid rapid AI math advances
Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has backed researcher Justin Drake’s warning that advances in artificial intelligence could undermine the cryptography used in today’s blockchains before quantum computers do.
“I don’t recommend anyone scramble to move their funds to new wallets today,” Buterin wrote. “But we should take the risks to cryptography from AI-accelerated math seriously.”
Drake urged the industry to prepare for “bunker mode” in light of OpenAI releasing hundreds of new mathematical findings that humans have been unable to solve. None of the findings related to cryptography, but the potential for AI agents to uncover new insights into the mathematical structure behind elliptic curve cryptography or lattice based cryptography has the core Ethereum team worried.
The concerns have been criticized by other projects and analysts as fear mongering, with critics saying there is no evidence AI agents are anywhere near breaking cryptography. But then again, there wasn’t a lot of evidence a new AI model was about to one shot the solution to hundreds of other unsolvable problems either.
Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for US Galaxy users in October
Samsung plans to introduce USDC transfers to the Samsung Wallet payment app for 82 million eligible US Galaxy users in the last week of October.
The feature will let users send USDC to compatible crypto wallets internationally and transfer money to eligible bank accounts in more than 60 countries, where recipients can receive funds in their local currency. Users must complete identity verification to access the service.
Bastion will provide stablecoin account and payment infrastructure, with Coinbase serving as a sub-custodian through Coinbase Prime Vault. Solana and Sui were named as technical partners.
Crypto’s heavy backing of Republicans alienated Democrats: Cuomo
The crypto industry’s heavy backing of US Republicans has alienated Democrats whose support is needed to pass federal crypto legislation, says former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo.
Kalshi prediction markets put the probability of Democrats winning both chambers of Congress at about 61%. Cuomo said a Democratic-controlled Congress could either seek to roll back the SEC and CFTC’s crypto initiatives, or it could work with the Trump administration to pass the full CLARITY Act.
“You need Democrats to pass the bill. You need Republicans. You have to be more balanced,” he said.
While he conceded there is a perception that Democrats are “anti-crypto” he says the technology fits in well with the party’s goals and beliefs. 
“It’s empowering people who otherwise wouldn’t have access to financial products, and the Democratic Party has been working to do that all its life,” he said.
Winners and Losers
At the end of the week, Bitcoin (BTC) is down 2.8% to trade at $83,435, Ethereum (ETH) is down 6.5% to trade at $2,562 and XRP (XRP) is down 7% to $1.40. The total market cap is at $2.82 trillion according to CoinMarketCap.
Among the biggest 100 cryptocurrencies, the top three altcoin winners of the week are StarkNet (STRK) with a 91% gain (after announcing it would become a post-quantum L1), Binance Life (币安人生) on 25.4%, and Celestia (TIA) on 20.8%.
The top three altcoin losers of the week are Venice Token (VVV) which was down 18.5%, Sky (SKY) down 16.2% and Uniswap (UNI) down 15.4%.
Prediction of the Week
Ethereum will hit $25,000 to $50,000 this cycle says Tom Lee
Bitmine chair Tom Lee told Token2049 on Friday that ETH will top $5000 by the end of the year and by the end of the cycle Ethereum “could easily be 25,000 or 50,000 per token,” he said.
Lee also revealed Bitmine is nearing its 5% target after accumulating roughly 6 million Ether. The firm will only need to buy about 100,000 ETH more to reach that percentage.
“That’s a hard cap. We’re not gonna be accumulating past 5%,” Lee said. “We’re not gonna own more than 5% of Ethereum.”
Top FUD of the Week
Coldcard says it’s investigating how phishing link appeared on its X account
Bitcoin-only hardware wallet Coldcard said an unauthorized phishing link appeared Sunday on its official X account, despite the company using offline two-factor authentication.
The post has since been deleted, and the firm said the only official website is https://coldcard.com.
DefiLlama’s hack tracker estimated losses tied to July’s Coldcard exploit at $115 million.
THORChain dev accuses Tether of temporarily freezing USDT vaults
THORChain technical co-founder Chad Barraford accused stablecoin issuer Tether of blacklisting the network’s USDt (USDT) vaults without explanation, then unfreezing them hours later.
In a Friday X post, Barraford said that Tether had blacklisted THORChain vault addresses, freezing about a combined 1.45 million USDT in the network’s funds across four wallets. He reported about two hours later than trading would resume after Tether unfroze all the addresses.
New York permanently bars Celsius founder Mashinsky in $35M fraud settlement
Former Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky has been permanently barred from the cryptocurrency, securities and commodities industries under a settlement with New York Attorney General Letitia James that includes up to $35 million in conditional payments.
The New York agreement, announced Friday, settles a 2023 civil lawsuit accusing Mashinsky of misleading hundreds of thousands of investors about the safety of Celsius before its collapse in 2022.
Mashinsky is serving a 12-year federal prison sentence for fraud and was separately ordered to forfeit more than $48 million.
Top Magazine Features of the Week
France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months
French authorities recorded 90 crypto-related cases involving kidnapping, extortion, threats and violent theft in seven months. What makes France such a hotspot?
Crypto lending rises again… but have they solved the risks?
Crypto lending has risen by 55% since July, but now has to deal with the dangers of AI assisted hacks, and risks cascading through interlinked protocols. Here’s how to stay safe.
Capital starting to rotate back to crypto from AI: Raoul Pal
Real Vision founder Raoul Pal says a pause in the AI stock rally could help crypto attract capital, while AI agents are likely to boost Ethereum and Solana adoption.

items.title: Fingerprints are the new cookies
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[legitster]: Every time this resurfaces I like to remind people that this is mostly impractical and not how things actually work at the commercial level. Just because someone can theoretically demonstrate your fingerprint today doesn't mean you have the  same  fingerprint in a few days. It's that kind of stability that you actually need for consistent matching for advertising or tracking purposes. 90% of commercial fingerprinting services still rely mostly on the IP address. Once you remove the ...

[drnick1]: The problem is Javascript and its implementation. Plain HTML does not offer nearly as many fingerprinting opportunities. It's basically IP + user agent, both of which can be spoofed. Javascript grants websites far too much power over the user's browser, including disabling selection/paste, identifying hardware, time zone, language, etc. None of this should be allowed by default, and things like hardware acceleration and whatnot should be explicitly allowed on a case-by-case basis.

[helterskelter2]: I've seen anti-fingerprinting plugins and browser configs, etc, but they all seem to make you more interesting for not being fingerprintable, or for turning off a lot of features used in fingerprinting. Is there any reason a browser or plugin couldn't just spoof the data used in fingerprinting to random values? So it emits different values for each page or resource you load?

[MiroslavPokorny]: Theres only one solution, ban third party advertising. Everything else is a compromise that doesnt work anyway.

[aenis]: The fingerprints don't need to be long-time-stable to be harmful. Some companies have your stable datapoints (e.g., email) and your fingerprint. Other companies only have your fingerprint on the same day/week. Some companies have locations of edge devices and the fingerprints. And there are companies out there that will take all of those data streams, both from above board and not-so-above-board players and mix them for commercial benefit.
